text.title: 暗藏的猛兽
text.objectives: 消灭英雄难度祖尔格拉布中的花翼巢穴女王、沉睡者托尔图恩和一个加兹兰卡的失落后裔。
text.description: <鲜血杀手塔莱看了你一会儿。>$B$B哈卡败亡之后，古拉巴什遗城也逐渐破败坍塌，丛莽覆盖了祖尔格拉布的大部分地区。现在，一些强大的猛兽正潜伏在这座古代都市的残垣断壁中。$B$B我们已经见到过那些古拉巴什牧师的力量——他们利用剧毒调和物，让植物成为我们的敌人。英雄们，请赶快行动，除掉那些猛兽，不要让它们失去自我意识，成为金度以及其爪牙的奴仆！
text.completion: You done well. We gonna rest easy tonight knowin' Jin'do an' Zanzil ain't gonna bind dem powerful beasts against us.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

english.title: The Beasts Within
english.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: <Bloodslayer T'ara eyes you for a moment.>$B$BAfter de fall of Hakkar, de city of de Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and de jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Some powerful beasts now be livin' in da cracks an' hollows of de ancient city. $B$BWe seen de powers dem Gurubashi priests wield - dey turn de very plantlife against us wit' venomous concoctions. You tink you be strong? Dispose of dese beasts, before dey become mindless agents of Jin'do.
english.completion: You done well. We gonna rest easy tonight knowin' Jin'do an' Zanzil ain't gonna bind dem powerful beasts against us.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

text.title: 第二目标
text.objectives: 在英雄难度的祖尔格拉布消灭搬运者伽乌里马、撕裂者莫尔雷克和死亡丧钟莫尔塔克斯。
text.description: 古拉巴什巨魔已经召集起他们最强大的盟友，重新建起祖尔格拉布，占据了荆棘谷。$B$B他们的头领是两个巨大恐怖的巨魔：搬运者伽乌里马和撕裂者莫尔雷克，以及一个被称为莫尔塔克斯的强大窃魂者。$B$B虽然他们并不是祖尔格拉布的统治者，但打败这些强大的巨魔爪牙能够有力地帮助我们阻止古拉巴什崛起。
text.completion: Jin'do's empire crumbles around him like da ruins of dis forsaken city.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: Jin'do has powerful allies.

english.title: Secondary Targets
english.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: Da Gurubashi trolls gathered dere most powerful allies ta rebuild Zul'Gurub an' re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among dem be two monstrous trolls: Kaulema da Mover an' Mor'Lek da Dismantler, an' a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BDey don't be leaders of da Gurubashi, but killing dem powerful minions gonna help us prevent da rise of da Gurubashi.
english.completion: Jin'do's empire crumbles around him like da ruins of dis forsaken city.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: Jin'do has powerful allies.

text.title: 毁灭性打击
text.objectives: 消灭祖尔格拉布中的伽布和古拉巴什厨师长。
text.description: 祖尔格拉布这种城市就像你在这里看到的那些参天大树。$B$B也许它的树干粗大坚固，树冠遮天蔽日，但如果没有遥远下方的根系提供营养，这棵树就会枯萎死亡。$B$B金度的军队给养很大一部分来自于两个古拉巴什巨魔小分队。切断这些根系，这座城市就只能崩塌了。
text.completed: Speak to Al'tabim inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

english.title: Break Their Spirits
english.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.
english.description: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BThe trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.$B$BJin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.
english.completed: Speak to Al'tabim inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

text.title: 毁灭性打击
text.objectives: 消灭英雄难度祖尔格拉布中的伽布和古拉巴什厨师长。
text.description: 祖尔格拉布这种城市就像你在这里看到的那些参天大树。$B$B也许它的树干粗大坚固，树冠遮天蔽日，但如果没有遥远下方的根系提供营养，这棵树就会枯萎死亡。$B$B金度的军队给养很大一部分来自于两个古拉巴什巨魔小分队。切断这些根系，这座城市就只能崩塌了。
text.completion: Da great Gurubashi empire begin ta wither already. It be only a matter of time, now.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

english.title: Break Their Spirits
english.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: A city like Zul'Gurub be similar ta one of de many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BDe trunk may be thick, and de canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from de roots far below, de tree gonna wither and fall.$B$BJin'do's army be fed largely by de actions of a couple a' minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever dem roots, and de city gonna fall.
english.completion: Da great Gurubashi empire begin ta wither already. It be only a matter of time, now.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

text.title: 逝去的酋长
text.objectives: 带领你的孤儿前往赤色石，访问凯恩·血蹄的火葬堆。如果你的孤儿不在身边，就召唤他过来。
text.description: 监护员巴特维尔说，凯恩·血蹄死去之后，部落失去了一个“睿智的声音”。我不知道这是什么意思，但我一直都希望能见到他。另一些孤儿甚至还有他的蹄子印呢。$B$B你愿意带我去莫高雷吗？我们的老师说，牛头人会把他们的死者送到一个叫赤色石的地方，在那里追悼他们。我们应该到那里去，看看是否能在那里找到凯恩。
text.completion: Someday, I'm going to be a great warrior, just like Cairne or the warchief. Everyone will remember my deeds, and the ancestors will welcome my spirit too!
text.end: Take Your Orphan to Visit Red Rocks
text.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

english.title: The Fallen Chieftain
english.objectives: Take your orphan to Red Rocks to visit the funeral pyre of Cairne Bloodhoof. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
english.description: Matron Battlewail says that when Cairne Bloodhoof died, the Horde lost a 'voice of wisdom'. I don't know what that means, but I always wanted to meet him. Some of the other orphans even have his hoofprint.$B$BWould you take me with you to Mulgore? Our tutor says tauren bring their dead to a place called Red Rocks to honor them. We should go there and see if we can find Cairne.
english.completion: Someday, I'm going to be a great warrior, just like Cairne or the warchief. Everyone will remember my deeds, and the ancestors will welcome my spirit too!
english.end: Take Your Orphan to Visit Red Rocks
english.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: 警戒之翼
text.objectives: 装备上暮光火焰长枪并飞向艾维娜的守护者。消灭10名暮光枪兵。点击扇动按键来扇动坐骑的翅膀！
text.description: 暮光的军队对这里的攻击还在继续。我们不能功亏一篑！带上翅膀，尽可能地去消灭那些长枪骑兵吧！$B$B别忘记装备上长枪先。
text.completion: Well done, $C. I hope you don't forget about us here in the Hatchery.
text.completed: Return to Farden Talonshrike within the Hatchery.

english.title: Vigilance on Wings
english.objectives: Equip a Twilight Firelance and fly Aviana's Guardian. Kill 10 Twilight Lancers by flying into them. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
english.description: The agents of Twilight continue their assault within this pocket of the Firelands. We must not let our offensive fall! Take wing, and destroy as many of those lancers as you can!$b$bDo not forget to pick up and equip your lance first.
english.completion: Well done, $C. I hope you don't forget about us here in the Hatchery.
english.completed: Return to Farden Talonshrike within the Hatchery.

text.title: 闪亮闪亮的东西！
text.objectives: Speak to Budd in the Ghostlands.
text.description: Come closer, $G man:sweetheart;! Let ol' Griftah look at yer shiny things....$b$bHmm. Yeh, yeh, not bad, but ya can do better. Much, much better.$b$b<Griftah leans in and whispers.>$b$bThere be priceless shinies everywhere, $N, ya just gotta know where to look! It be yer lucky day; I know a fella who can help ya find more shinies than ya can ever carry.$b$bVisit my ol' friend, Budd, near Zul'Aman and show him this here. Ya be tellin' him ol' Griftah sent ya and he'll let ya in on his new project.
text.completed: Speak to Budd in the Ghostlands.

english.title: Oooh, Shinies!
english.objectives: Speak to Budd in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Come closer, $G man:sweetheart;! Let ol' Griftah look at yer shiny things....$b$bHmm. Yeh, yeh, not bad, but ya can do better. Much, much better.$b$b<Griftah leans in and whispers.>$b$bThere be priceless shinies everywhere, $N, ya just gotta know where to look! It be yer lucky day; I know a fella who can help ya find more shinies than ya can ever carry.$b$bVisit my ol' friend, Budd, near Zul'Aman and show him this here. Ya be tellin' him ol' Griftah sent ya and he'll let ya in on his new project.
english.completed: Speak to Budd in the Ghostlands.

text.title: 元素敌人
text.objectives: 击败8名灼焦士兵或灼焦征服者。
text.description: 元素一直在对我们施压，我也不指望它们会在短时间内减缓攻势。$B$B现在，它们就在北边的灰烬旷野上横行。去帮我消灭掉一些元素生物吧。
text.progress: We cannot allow these elementals to take any ground. They're not likely to lapse in their attacks long enough for us to take it back.
text.completion: Your continued efforts are appreciated, $C. We will win this war as long as people like you stand beside us.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Hostile Elements
english.objectives: Kill 8 Charred Soldiers or Charred Vanquishers.
english.description: The elementals continue to press on us, and I do not expect them to subside any time soon.$B$BYou'll find them pouring across the Ashen Fields to the north. Thin their ranks.
english.progress: We cannot allow these elementals to take any ground. They're not likely to lapse in their attacks long enough for us to take it back.
english.completion: Your continued efforts are appreciated, $C. We will win this war as long as people like you stand beside us.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 诱人的保证
text.objectives: Retrieve Budd's Map of Zul'Aman from High Priest Nalorakk's terrace in Zul'Aman.
text.description: 我的理论证实了祖阿曼中存在着大量财宝的传闻，当然了，我的理论不是你们这些凡人可以理解的。$B$B很快每个人都将获得享不尽的荣华富贵了！$B$B不过，你得先去完成一些重要的事情, 你必须通过努力来挣得你的那一份, 毕竟……$B$B我们的初期行动并没有像我希望的那样顺利进行。事实上，我的地图，和那个借走我地图的新手，在深入纳洛拉克的平台调查后就失踪了。要替换一个人很简单，但我需要那份地图！$B$B只要成功了，人们就会永远的记住你，是你帮助巴德·奈德雷克解开了祖阿曼的秘密！
text.completed: Speak with Budd in Hatchet Hills.

english.title: Promises, Promises...
english.objectives: Retrieve Budd's Map of Zul'Aman from High Priest Nalorakk's terrace in Zul'Aman.
english.description: My inscrutable theories confirm rumors of vast treasure in Zul'Aman. There'll be mounts and mansions for everyone! First things first, though. You must earn your share, after all....$b$bOur initial efforts here haven't gone as well as I hoped. In fact, my map, and the recruits I lent it to, have gone missing. They were after a troll-beast named Nalorakk.$b$bForget the crew, I need that map! Succeed, and you'll go down in history as the one who helped Budd Nedreck unlock the secrets of Zul'Aman!
english.completed: Speak with Budd in Hatchet Hills.

text.title: 猛禽德鲁伊
text.objectives: 获得150个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 啸天者欧穆隆和他的猛禽德鲁伊在海加尔山的时候就是一支可怕的力量。我知道他们更喜欢在那片熟悉的天空上征战，但局势紧迫，我们无论如何都需要他们前来援助。$B$B如果你能收集到足够的印记，就该去找欧穆隆，说服他的德鲁伊们上前线。欧穆隆这人比较我行我素，但他也明白事情的轻重缓急。
text.progress: It is good to see you again.
text.completion: I see. I can't say I'm eager to bring my flock to the Firelands, but I knew it would become necessary at some point.$B$BWe will be there, $c. Thank you for carrying the message.
text.completed: Secure the aid of the Druids of the Talon from Skylord Omnuron at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Druids of the Talon
english.objectives: Obtain 150 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: Skylord Omnuron and his Druids of the Talon have been a fearsome force for us back in Hyjal. I know that they prefer the familiar skies of that battlefield, but the time may come when we need them here nonetheless.$B$BIf you get your hands on enough marks, you should appeal to Omnuron that his druids should be on the main front. Omnuron watches out for his own, but he also understands the importance of this effort.
english.progress: It is good to see you again.
english.completion: I see. I can't say I'm eager to bring my flock to the Firelands, but I knew it would become necessary at some point.$B$BWe will be there, $c. Thank you for carrying the message.
english.completed: Secure the aid of the Druids of the Talon from Skylord Omnuron at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 风暴乌鸦的飞行
text.objectives: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的啸天者欧穆隆谈一谈。
text.description: 在你的召唤下，很多猛禽德鲁伊都杀赴熔火前线了。你应该去玛法里奥突破口找啸天者欧穆隆，看看这些德鲁伊如何用双翼划破熊熊燃烧的天空。
text.completion: These skies are indeed oppressive, but we've been able to navigate them for the most part.$B$BWe may need your help to secure additional landing territory past the Furnace. I will call for you when we are ready.

english.title: Flight of the Storm Crows
english.objectives: Speak to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: Many of the Druids of the Talon have made their way to the Molten Front, at your beckoning. You should go to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach and see how their wings are faring in those burning skies.
english.completion: These skies are indeed oppressive, but we've been able to navigate them for the most part.$B$BWe may need your help to secure additional landing territory past the Furnace. I will call for you when we are ready.

text.title: X标记……你的末日！
text.objectives: Visit Halazzi's Chamber, Jan'alai's Platform, and Akil'zon's Platform in Zul'Aman.
text.description: 那群蠢货究竟是如何失败的？$B$B我一再嘱咐他们要小心，要小心——为了帮助他们潜入祖阿曼，我甚至把我的地图和伪装都给了他们。$B$B啊，不过任何事总有好的一面，他们的失败对你和你的朋友们来说是个机会。只要成功了，你们就可以名正言顺地加入我的队伍，和我一起分享即将到手的那些无尽的荣誉。并不是我贪心，只是让你意识到这点而已。$B$B在我将最终的挖掘计划准备妥当之前，我的地图上还有几块区域需要更详尽的探索……
text.completed: Speak to Budd in Hatchet Hills.

english.title: X Marks... Your Doom!
english.objectives: Visit Halazzi's Chamber, Jan'alai's Platform, and Akil'zon's Platform in Zul'Aman.
english.description: How did those fools fail? I told them to be careful - even gave them disguises to help them blend in. Ahh, well. The bright side of their failure is that this opportunity falls to you.$b$bSucceed, and you'll be well on your way to joining my crew and sharing in the immeasurable fame that will soon be mine. Not that I need any more, mind you.$b$bThere are yet a few portions of my map that require further exploration before our excavation can be initiated....
english.completed: Speak to Budd in Hatchet Hills.

text.title: 日常第二级，英雄（第一次）
妖术领主的神像
text.objectives: 从祖阿曼的妖术领主玛拉卡斯那里取得妖术领主的雕像。
text.description: 如果没有强大的巫医辅佐，这个新督军只不过是个过分发育的莽夫而已。$B$B新督军的得力助手妖术领主玛拉卡斯，是数十年来阿曼尼帝国最令人敬畏的巫医。没有妖术领主的权威，达卡拉也不可能让他的人民听从赞达拉的号令。$B$B打败妖术领主玛拉卡斯并将他最喜爱的神像带来给我，你将得到合适的奖赏。
text.progress: Have ya eliminated Hex Lord Malacrass?
text.completion: So dis is da fetish of da mighty Malacrass? It be a good addition to my collection, $n. And now, I believe, rewards be in order.
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor T'wansi in Zul'Aman.

english.title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
english.objectives: Obtain the Hex Lord's Fetish from Hex Lord Malacrass in Zul'Aman.
english.description: Dis new warlord of da Amani, he be nothin' but an overgrown brute without da protection of a strong witch doctor and he has just dat.$B$BDa new warlord's ally be Hex Lord Malacrass, da most feared witch doctor to walk among da Amani in decades. Without da hex lord's say-so, Daakara won't be submitting his people to da control of da Zandalari.$B$BDefeat Hex Lord Malacrass, bring me his favorite fetish, and I be seein' that ya get a fittin' reward.
english.progress: Have ya eliminated Hex Lord Malacrass?
english.completion: So dis is da fetish of da mighty Malacrass? It be a good addition to my collection, $n. And now, I believe, rewards be in order.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor T'wansi in Zul'Aman.

text.title: 夺牙奇兵
text.objectives: Collect 10 Forest Troll Tusks from the trolls in Zul'Aman.
text.description: 嗨，朋友！你是新来的吧？ 我托你办件事吧....$B$B巴德一直想让他的森林巨魔伪装变得更逼真。他说他就快完成了——只是需要最后一点加工，只是需要点獠牙而已……$B$B我的剥皮才能在这里毫无用处，拔那些巨魔的獠牙让我感到恶心。$B$B带10根巨魔獠牙回来给我，怎么样，朋友？
text.completed: Speak to Prigmon in Hatchet Hills.

english.title: Tuskin' Raiders
english.objectives: Collect 10 Forest Troll Tusks from the trolls in Zul'Aman.
english.description: 'Ey mon! You be new around 'ere, eh? Lemme ask a favor of ya.$b$bBudd's been refinin' his forest troll disguise. Says that he be close now - just be needin' one last touch. Tusks.$b$bMy skinnin' talents be wasted 'ere. Somethin' about yankin' troll tusks be makin me queasy. $b$bBring me back 10 troll tusks, eh mon?
english.completed: Speak to Prigmon in Hatchet Hills.

text.title: 失踪的巨魔
text.objectives: Speak to Zungam in Zul'Aman.
text.description: 听着，朋友，普雷蒙还有件事需要你帮忙，我那个没用的表兄被困在了祖阿曼里。不过他还活着——就在昨晚，我还看到了他的信号弹！$B$B他给我带来了这么多麻烦，我真应该就这么让他在里面烂掉。不过话说回来，他还欠我一大笔钱。$B$B尽量帮他一把，把他欠我的钱给我拿回来！

english.title: A Troll Among Trolls
english.objectives: Speak to Zungam in Zul'Aman.
english.description: Lissen mon, there be sumthin' else needs doin fer ol' Prigmon.$b$bZungam, my good-fer-nuthin' cousin, be stuck inside Zul'Aman. He still be alive too - I seen his signal flare just last night!$b$bI should be lettin' him rot fer gettin' me tied up in this mess, but he be owin' me big money.$b$bDo what ya can to help him out, then leave the collectin' to me!

text.title: Wicked Webs
text.objectives: Free 8 victims out of Cinderweb Cocoons.
text.description: Some of our scouts have not reported back for duty. We fear they have succumbed to the deadly spiders in the vicinity.$B$BHope may not be lost, however. The spiders often wrap up their live prey in cocoons for later consumption.$B$BGo search the pillars to the north for cocooned victims. You may yet be able to save some of our brethren.
text.completion: Our lost allies have already made it back. They are shaken, but alive. Thank you for rescuing them.
text.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

english.title: Wicked Webs
english.objectives: Free 8 victims out of Cinderweb Cocoons.
english.description: Some of our scouts have not reported back for duty. We fear they have succumbed to the deadly spiders in the vicinity.$B$BHope may not be lost, however. The spiders often wrap up their live prey in cocoons for later consumption.$B$BGo search the pillars to the north for cocooned victims. You may yet be able to save some of our brethren.
english.completion: Our lost allies have already made it back. They are shaken, but alive. Thank you for rescuing them.
english.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

text.title: 我们去放风筝
text.objectives: 从奥格瑞玛暗巷区的布雷克斯·瓶装火箭那里购买一个风筝龙玩具包，用它和你的兽人孤儿一起放风筝。如果你的孤儿不在身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 有一天，院长带我们出去玩的时候，我看见一个地精推着一辆装满了玩具的小车。那车上有布娃娃、黄铜小跑车、皮球，还有一些风筝。我一直都想有一个风筝龙。院长说过，如果我把所有的钱都攒起来，就能买一个。但我要攒好长时间。$B$B我记得那个地精的名字好象是叫布雷克斯·瓶装火箭。如果我们能找到他，能不能从他那里买一个风筝，一起把它放起来？我见过他推着小车在暗巷区走来走去。
text.completion: Thanks for the kite, $N. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!
text.end: Fly Dragon Kites with your orphan
text.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

english.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
english.objectives: Purchase a Dragon Kite Two-Pack from Blax Bottlerocket in Orgrimmar's Drag then use it to fly kites with your Orcish Orphan. If your orphan is not present, call for him.
english.description: The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a goblin pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.$B$BI think the goblin's name was Blax Bottlerocket or something. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him pushing his cart around the Drag.
english.completion: Thanks for the kite, $N. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!
english.end: Fly Dragon Kites with your orphan
english.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: 草莓冰激凌
text.objectives: 在冰锥甜筒购买冰激凌，并与你的孤儿一同分享。
text.description: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Orgrimmar, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by a crazy goblin mage! You don't think it's going to disappear if I don't finish it in fifteen minutes, do you?$B$BI bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!$B$BI heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called the Cone of Cold and it's in the southern part of the Goblin Slums.
text.completion: I think that's the first time I've ever seen a goblin making food that didn't involve a big, noisy machine with a lot of smoke. Maybe more people would like their food if they just made it like normal people... or like mages! That ice cream was so good!
text.end: Take your orphan out for ice cream.
text.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

english.title: You Scream, I Scream...
english.objectives: Purchase ice cream at Cone of Cold and then share it with your orphan.
english.description: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Orgrimmar, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by a crazy goblin mage! You don't think it's going to disappear if I don't finish it in fifteen minutes, do you?$B$BI bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!$B$BI heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called the Cone of Cold and it's in the southern part of the Goblin Slums.
english.completion: I think that's the first time I've ever seen a goblin making food that didn't involve a big, noisy machine with a lot of smoke. Maybe more people would like their food if they just made it like normal people... or like mages! That ice cream was so good!
english.end: Take your orphan out for ice cream.
english.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: The Wardens are Watching
text.objectives: Attack a Druid of the Flame to weaken it, then lure it into your Shadow Warden's trap.
text.description: We must tread carefully, $c. Fandral's Druids of the Flame practice their fiery magic beyond the pillars to the north.$B$BI need you to capture one of those druids alive for questioning. We must seize every opportunity to learn of their plans.$B$BOne of my wardens will accompany you. Follow her instructions if you wish to survive.
text.completion: I am impressed, $C. Your deeds will be remembered among the Shadow Wardens.
text.completed: Return to Marin Bladewing at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

english.title: The Wardens are Watching
english.objectives: Attack a Druid of the Flame to weaken it, then lure it into your Shadow Warden's trap.
english.description: We must tread carefully, $c. Fandral's Druids of the Flame practice their fiery magic beyond the pillars to the north.$B$BI need you to capture one of those druids alive for questioning. We must seize every opportunity to learn of their plans.$B$BOne of my wardens will accompany you. Follow her instructions if you wish to survive.
english.completion: I am impressed, $C. Your deeds will be remembered among the Shadow Wardens.
english.completed: Return to Marin Bladewing at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

text.title: 飞翔之地的祈祷
text.objectives: 将无尽时光之眼带往考达拉。
text.description: 凡人，时光没有被虚耗。$B$B当你在火元素位面奋战的时候，我和我的观测者们终于确定了我们的视野被遮蔽的范围是在何处，更重要的，是在何时。$B$B我们发现，迷雾覆盖于魔枢之上。那是在遥远的北方，蓝龙飞翔之地。$B$B我已经调整过无尽时光之眼。它会向你显示那个我们在这里无法看见的地方。$B$B立刻前往考达拉，找到一个能够激活这只眼睛的合适地点。$B$B一路平安，朋友。
text.completion: You are either a fool, or a lunatic. Regardless, you must return from whence you have come.$B$BWere you spotted by another of my brood, you would already have met your end.
text.completed: Speak with Tarecgosa in Coldarra.

english.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
english.objectives: Bring the Timeless Eye to Coldarra.
english.description: Time well spent, mortal.$b$bWhile you struggled in the Plane of Fire, my watchers and I were able to determine when and, most importantly, where our vision was obscured.$b$bWe discovered that the shroud was placed over the Nexus, far to the north in the realm of the blue dragonflight.$b$bI have attuned the Timeless Eye to show you the occurrences that remain hidden to us here.$b$bBring it to Coldarra at once and seek out a place suitable for its activation.$b$bGo, child. Time is of the essence...
english.completion: You are either a fool, or a lunatic. Regardless, you must return from whence you have come.$B$BWere you spotted by another of my brood, you would already have met your end.
english.completed: Speak with Tarecgosa in Coldarra.

text.title: 一窥究竟
text.objectives: 在魔枢的虚空漩涡使用永恒之眼。$B$B去魔枢里见泰蕾苟萨，她会护送你前往裂隙。
text.description: <泰蕾苟萨仔细地听着你讲述来到考达拉的缘由。>$B$B你的故事听起来很真实，$C。自从玛里苟斯死后，很多事情都发生了变化——但好事寥寥。$B$B我了解你带来的器物，我能从中认出阿纳克洛斯的魔力。在全考达拉只有一个地方可以让这颗无尽时光之眼发挥作用。$B$B如果你想成功，那么你需要我的协助。去魔枢里面和我再次交谈，我就会协助你。
text.completion: This cannot be, $C!$B$BIt must be some kind of trick!
text.completed: Speak to Tarecgosa at the Rift in the Nexus.

english.title: Through a Glass, Darkly
english.objectives: Look into the Eye of Eternity at the Nether Vortex in the Nexus.$b$bMeet Tarecgosa inside the Nexus where she will escort you to the rift.
english.description: <Tarecgosa listens as you explain your presence in Coldarra.>$b$bYour tale rings true, $c. Much has changed since the death of Malygos - little of it for the better.$b$bI know of the device you carry, and I recognize Anachronos' magic in its creation. There is but one place in all of Coldarra that would allow this Timeless Eye to be used discreetly.$b$bYou will require my assistance if you hope to succeed. Speak with me again inside the Nexus and you shall have it.
english.completion: This cannot be, $C!$B$BIt must be some kind of trick!
english.completed: Speak to Tarecgosa at the Rift in the Nexus.

text.title: 烈焰仪式
text.objectives: 在诺尔度之脊抵御灼焦入侵者，直至传送门打开。
text.description: 看起来一切都尽在我们掌控之中。我们通往火焰之地的入侵传送门很快就会打开，元素们还没有真正地投入战斗。$B$B协助我们的德鲁伊，消灭这里剩下的最后一批元素生物。然后，当大门打开之际，我们就可以开始行动了。
text.completion: Leyara... she lives. I sense Fandral's hand at play here...
text.completed: Speak with Malfurion atop Nordune Ridge in Mount Hyjal.
text.objective1: Open the portal to the Firelands

english.title: A Ritual of Flame
english.objectives: Fight the waves of Charred Invaders on Nordune Ridge until the portal is opened.
english.description: We appear to have everything under control. Our invasion portal to the Firelands will be opened momentarily, and the elementals have not put up much fight.$b$bAssist our druids by dispatching the last few of these elementals. Then, once the gate has been opened, we can make our move.
english.completion: Leyara... she lives. I sense Fandral's hand at play here...
english.completed: Speak with Malfurion atop Nordune Ridge in Mount Hyjal.
english.objective1: Open the portal to the Firelands

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 前往庇护所！
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。
text.description: 我们目前已经没法再分神去担心什么“烈焰德鲁伊”了。我们要关心的是行动的延续性。$B$B去玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。如果拉格纳罗斯对我们的到来早有防范，那我想他的部队很快就会发动反击的。
text.completion: What happened up there? I saw fire and... never mind, you can tell me later. We have other, more immediate matters to attend to.

english.title: To the Sanctuary!
english.objectives: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: We should not worry about this "Druid of the Flame" for the time being. We must be concerned with the continuance of our operation.$b$bReturn to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If Ragnaros was prepared for our arrival, then I anticipate that his forces will launch a counterattack soon.
english.completion: What happened up there? I saw fire and... never mind, you can tell me later. We have other, more immediate matters to attend to.

text.title: 出其不意
text.objectives: 帮助老树干、希萨莉·黑鸦、索罗·白蹄和安伦·觅影者逃离烈焰的包围。
text.description: 我们的入侵计划看来泡汤了。根据鸟儿的情报，大火已经烧到了海加尔的中心峡谷。$B$B现在我们有很多德鲁伊还困在战场上，他们对如此大规模的进攻毫无防备。希萨莉就在暗灰湖旁，而其他人则在复苏之地外面，东北方向。$B$B快去，$N！找到他们，确保他们不要再在这种困境下屈服！
text.completion: $n! You're back! They've pushed us back to the Sanctuary. We are vastly outnumbered. At this rate, the Guardians of Hyjal stand little chance of survival. I'm glad you're here with us.
text.completed: Return to Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.objective3: Kill elementals near Tholo and Anren

english.title: Caught Unawares
english.objectives: Help Elderlimb, Thisalee Crow, Tholo Whitehoof and Anren Shadowseeker escape the flames.
english.description: Our invasion plan looks to have backfired. Several of our birds have already reported in, speaking of fires breaking out across the vales of central Hyjal.$b$bNow, many of our druids are stranded out in the field, unprepared for such a large-scale attack. Thisalee was near Ashen Lake, and several others were out in the Regrowth, to the northeast.$b$bGo, $N! Find them, and make sure that they do not succumb to this backdraft!
english.completion: $n! You're back! They've pushed us back to the Sanctuary. We are vastly outnumbered. At this rate, the Guardians of Hyjal stand little chance of survival. I'm glad you're here with us.
english.completed: Return to Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.objective3: Kill elementals near Tholo and Anren

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 庇护所保卫战
text.objectives: 在玛法里奥复活玛洛恩时保护他。
text.description: Malfurion is working on a miracle for us. He believes that, in this time of peril, he can resurrect Malorne to protect the sanctuary. I have faith in him.$b$bIn the meantime, we need to hold this perimeter. Stand by, and make sure no harm befalls my fellow arch druid.
text.completion: Malorne's strength alone may have just saved Kalimdor. To imagine, Malorne has returned today, after so long an absence... We've taken heavy losses. Though the immediate threat is no longer present, our forces will need time to heal, and to put out any remaining fires here in Hyjal. Our attack on the Firelands will have to wait.
text.completed: Speak with Malfurion Stormrage at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: The Sanctuary Must Not Fall
english.objectives: Stand by Malfurion as he resurrects Malorne.
english.description: Malfurion is working on a miracle for us. He believes that, in this time of peril, he can resurrect Malorne to protect the sanctuary. I have faith in him.$b$bIn the meantime, we need to hold this perimeter. Stand by, and make sure no harm befalls my fellow arch druid.
english.completion: Malorne's strength alone may have just saved Kalimdor. To imagine, Malorne has returned today, after so long an absence... We've taken heavy losses. Though the immediate threat is no longer present, our forces will need time to heal, and to put out any remaining fires here in Hyjal. Our attack on the Firelands will have to wait.
english.completed: Speak with Malfurion Stormrage at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 寻求增援
text.objectives: 收集20个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 我们在第一次进攻失败后遭受了巨大的损失。下一次尝试绝不能再失败。$B$B所以在发动第二次进攻前，我们需要增援。拜托了，$N，去协助麦托克劳收集足够的资源吧。然后，我们将对火焰之地发动第二次，也是最后一次的进攻。
text.progress: The sooner we can break through our invasion portal, the better.
text.completion: Excellent work. I will send for our reinforcements right away.
text.completed: Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Calling for Reinforcements
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: We suffered heavy losses during the backdraft after our invasion attempt. Our second attempt cannot fail.$b$bWe need reinforcements before we attempt another invasion. Please, $N, work with Matoclaw to obtain enough resources to afford reinforcements. Then, we take our second and final stab at the Firelands.
english.progress: The sooner we can break through our invasion portal, the better.
english.completion: Excellent work. I will send for our reinforcements right away.
english.completed: Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 莱雅娜
text.objectives: 找到烈焰德鲁伊莱雅娜。
text.description: 在我们出发前，$N，我还有另一件事要你去做。$B$B有人在西北边的废墟里看到了一个“烈焰德鲁伊”。我怀疑她就是几天前在传送门那里攻击我们的人。现在，我们终于可以腾出手来看看她到底想干什么了……如果有可能的话，请你干掉她。$B$B解决了那个烈焰德鲁伊，我们就可以继续我们的计划了。
text.completion: You deviated from our plan, $n. Our attack was supposed to happen today! All this preparation... how will we succeed without the aid of Hamuul?
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Leyara
english.objectives: Find Leyara, the Druid of the Flame.
english.description: Before we depart, $N, I have another matter to which you should attend.$b$bA Druid of the Flame has been spotted in the ruins to the northwest. I suspect it is the same one that attacked us at the portal several days ago. Now would be an ideal time to see what it is that she truly wants... and if necessary, dispose of her.$b$bSee to this flame druid, then we can continue on our planned course.
english.completion: You deviated from our plan, $n. Our attack was supposed to happen today! All this preparation... how will we succeed without the aid of Hamuul?
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 穿越地狱之门
text.objectives: 穿过诺尔度之脊顶端的传送门，帮助玛法里奥占领熔火前线的根据地。
text.description: 我们可以稍后再来悼念哈缪尔。在这场战争中，伤亡是不可避免的，而他只不过是第一个而已……但我们的进攻已经不能再拖了，过去几天好不容易得到的成绩不能白费。$B$B诺尔度之脊顶端的传送门已经打开了。我们的增援也准备就绪，他们正在等候我的命令，然后穿过那道传送门。$B$B我们会在传送门另一侧再次相见。等到了那里，我们应该先占领一个根据地。
text.completion: Very well done, $c. We've managed to take a foothold in our enemy's realm without their notice. Our armies are moving through to establish a front as we speak. We have a long, brutal war ahead of us. It is my hope that you'll be around to help us see it through.
text.completed: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage inside the Sentinel Tree at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
text.objective1: Secure a foothold in the Firelands

english.title: Through the Gates of Hell
english.objectives: Pass through the portal atop Nordune Ridge and help Malfurion secure a foothold on the Molten Front.
english.description: There will be time to mourn for Hamuul later. His is the first of many inevitable casualties in this war.... but our attack cannot wait, nor should the momentum we have gained over the last several days be wasted.$b$bThe portal atop Nordune Ridge is now open. Our reinforcements are prepared, and they await only my order to pass through the portal.$B$BWe will meet again on the other side of the portal. Once there, we shall ensure that our foothold is secure.
english.completion: Very well done, $c. We've managed to take a foothold in our enemy's realm without their notice. Our armies are moving through to establish a front as we speak. We have a long, brutal war ahead of us. It is my hope that you'll be around to help us see it through.
english.completed: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage inside the Sentinel Tree at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
english.objective1: Secure a foothold in the Firelands

text.title: 哈缪尔的命运
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所，找多尔达恩·织夜者谈谈。
text.description: 我对我之前的唐突表示歉意。失去哈缪尔对我打击很大，让我手足无措。$B$B他们在你离开时把哈缪尔带回来了，他还活着——但是被严重地烧伤了。$B$B这些伤口很深，他恐怕捱不过去了。$B$B我安排了一些最棒的医师来治疗他。恕我多嘴，你能和多尔达恩·织夜者谈谈吗？他和他的人需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Yes, Hamuul lives. You can visit him in the tent behind me, but please, be careful. He is in a fragile condition, and we are doing everything in our power just to keep him alive and comfortable.$B$BWhoever did this to the Arch Druid showed no mercy. I hope that you are someday able to return the favor.

english.title: The Fate of Runetotem
english.objectives: Speak with Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: I apologize for speaking curtly with you earlier. The loss of Hamuul was shocking to me, and difficult to cope with.$b$bThey brought in his body while you were away. He is alive, but - as you might imagine - he is very, very badly burned.$b$bThe scars are deep. He may not live.$b$bI have arranged for some of our finest healers to attend to him. If it is not too much to ask, would you speak with Dorda'en Nightweaver? He and his fellow attendants may need your help.
english.completion: Yes, Hamuul lives. You can visit him in the tent behind me, but please, be careful. He is in a fragile condition, and we are doing everything in our power just to keep him alive and comfortable.$B$BWhoever did this to the Arch Druid showed no mercy. I hope that you are someday able to return the favor.

text.title: 深入神庙
text.objectives: Kill Leyara.
text.description: Leyara has been spotted in the Igneous Depths. A group of Shadow Wardens has cornered her.$B$BGo there immediately. I will join you as soon as I make one necessary preparation.
text.completion: Leyara's tale is a tragic one. It pains me that it came to this.$B$BStaghelm must be stopped, before he drags anyone else down with him.
text.completed: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Malfurion's Breach.

english.title: Into the Depths
english.objectives: Kill Leyara.
english.description: Leyara has been spotted in the Igneous Depths. A group of Shadow Wardens has cornered her.$B$BGo there immediately. I will join you as soon as I make one necessary preparation.
english.completion: Leyara's tale is a tragic one. It pains me that it came to this.$B$BStaghelm must be stopped, before he drags anyone else down with him.
english.completed: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Malfurion's Breach.

text.title: The Warden's Charge
text.objectives: If you want to help the Wardens attack the Forlorn Spire, seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner in northeastern Ashen Fields.
text.description: Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise.$B$BI've assigned her a large number of our men, but her chances of success would be greatly increased if you join her cause. It's your decision, $n.

english.title: The Warden's Charge
english.objectives: If you want to help the Wardens attack the Forlorn Spire, seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner in northeastern Ashen Fields.
english.description: Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise.$B$BI've assigned her a large number of our men, but her chances of success would be greatly increased if you join her cause. It's your decision, $n.

text.title: The Forlorn Spire
text.objectives: Protect one of the druids attempting to take the Forlorn Spire.
text.description: Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise.$B$BGo there and escort one of her druids to the tower with any forces that she can spare. You'll have quite a fight ahead of you - make sure the druid lives to see the end of it or they'll not be able to seize the tower.
text.completion: Well done, $C. This should prove a good staging ground for pushing further into enemy territory.$B$BI sense Druids of the Flame nearby. Perhaps we shall have some sport of them as well.
text.completed: Speak to Marin Bladewing at the Forlorn Spire on the Molten Front.

english.completed: Speak to Marin Bladewing at the Forlorn Spire on the Molten Front.

text.title: 进入火焰之中
text.objectives: 护送一名唤风者穿过熔炉，拿下通往熔火激流的入口。
text.description: 啸天者欧穆隆和他的德鲁伊们打算想办法穿越西北边的熔炉。他们虽然可以飞越险境，但想要拿下火焰后方的阵地，他们还是需要有人在地面上进行支援……比如说你。$B$B要是你愿意帮助猛禽德鲁伊，就等欧穆隆的一名唤风者开始飞越火焰后，跟紧他，然后保证他不受烈焰中的敌人所害。
text.completion: Glad to see the Skylord was finally able to get someone capable through without wings. Our flight has been of little use to us in these confined spaces and amidst the thermals beyond this ridge.$B$BLooks like we'll have to resort to more conventional tactics. You game?
text.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow within the Molten Flow on the Molten Front.
text.objective1: Druid of the Talon Windcaller protected

english.title: Into the Fire
english.objectives: Escort a Windcaller through the Furnace and secure the entrance to the Molten Flow.
english.description: Skylord Omnuron and his druids are seeking to push through the Furnace to our northwest. They've been able to fly over the dangers, but they really need someone on the ground to help them secure the territory past the fire... someone like you.$B$BIf you want to aid the Druids of the Talon, wait for one of Omnuron's Windcallers to start pushing through the fire, stay close to him, and keep him safe from any attackers within the flames.
english.completion: Glad to see the Skylord was finally able to get someone capable through without wings. Our flight has been of little use to us in these confined spaces and amidst the thermals beyond this ridge.$B$BLooks like we'll have to resort to more conventional tactics. You game?
english.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow within the Molten Flow on the Molten Front.
english.objective1: Druid of the Talon Windcaller protected

text.title: Into the Fiery Depths
text.objectives: Speak to Theresa Barkskin in the Igneous Depths.
text.description: One of our druids moved ahead into the Igneous Depths in pursuit of a Druid of the Flame.$B$BGo to her. Help her.

english.title: Into the Fiery Depths
english.objectives: Speak to Theresa Barkskin in the Igneous Depths.
english.description: One of our druids moved ahead into the Igneous Depths in pursuit of a Druid of the Flame.$B$BGo to her. Help her.

text.title: Enduring the Heat
text.objectives: Find your way to the Igneous Depths, then destroy all 8 of the blue runes within.
text.description: Shalis has gone with one of our druids to stop a Druid of the Flame that is performing a summoning ritual in the Igneous Depths, below us. They have been tasked with killing the druid, but I need you to stop the ritual.$B$BYou'll find the entrance to the cavern east of the Magma Springs. Once inside, you'll see 8 blue runes spread throughout the cavern. You can use these runes to protect you from the fiery creatures, but you need to stamp all of them out to end the ritual. You will need to be swift.
text.completion: Well done!$B$BThey've been attempting to start rituals of this sort all over the Molten Front, but we've been able to thwart them every time so far. Hopefully you will be present in the future to help us keep up that trend.
text.completed: Return to Theresa Barkskin at the entrance to the Igneous Depths on the Molten Front.

You will need to be swift.

text.title: Solar Core Destruction
text.objectives: Detonate the Solar Core.
text.description: The fight has taken us to Fandral's doorstep. His druids are channeling energies of the Firelands into a vessel called the Solar Core.$B$BShould this vessel detonate on Azeroth, none of us will have a home to return to.$B$BWe need to strike at the Solar Core now, while it is still vulnerable. You can find the infernal device to the northeast.
text.completion: It is destroyed? Good. I doubt this will deter Fandral for long, but we must gain every advantage we can muster.
text.completed: Return to Marin Bladewing at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Fire Hawk Down
text.objectives: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.
text.description: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.
text.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenblade at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Fire Hawk Down
english.objectives: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.
english.description: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.

text.title: 猎手还活着吗？
text.objectives: 查看格伦特·恐锤是否安好。
text.description: 情况看起来不妙，那猎豹拥有强大的魔法能力。我们最好快去看看那猎手现在怎么样了。
text.completion: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

english.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
english.objectives: Check on Grent Direhammer.
english.description: Tings ain't looking good.  Dat panther was under some powerful magic.  We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.
english.completion: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

text.title: 暗影守望者
text.objectives: 获得150个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 暗影守望者已经回到了复苏之地。我知道他们对于放跑了范达尔这件事一直耿耿于怀。所以说服他们来火焰之地猎杀那些烈焰德鲁伊应该不是难事。说不定他们还能在别的方面对我们有所帮助。$B$B如果你获得了足够多的印记，就去玛洛恩庇护所找萨伊娜·风驰队长，获取她的帮助。
text.progress: 再次欢迎你，$N!你是来向我展示你完成狩猎的证明的吗?
text.completion: I see. It is time for us to join the hunt in the Firelands then. My sisters will be with you, $c.
text.completed: Secure the aid of the Shadow Wardens from Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: The Shadow Wardens
english.objectives: Obtain 150 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: The Shadow Wardens are back in the Regrowth. I know that they take the loss of Fandral from their custody very seriously, so it wouldn't take much prodding to bring them to the Firelands to hunt the Druids of the Flame, and perhaps aid us otherwise in the process.$B$BShould you come upon enough marks, you should seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Sanctuary of Malorne and secure her aid.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: I see. It is time for us to join the hunt in the Firelands then. My sisters will be with you, $c.
english.completed: Secure the aid of the Shadow Wardens from Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 开始狩猎
text.objectives: Speak to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Malfurion's Breach.
text.description: The Shadow Wardens have joined the fight at the Molten Front, on your request. You should find Captain Saynna Stormrunner and see to it that they've found a way to best apply their skills.
text.completion: Hello, $n. It's good to see you again.$B$BYou needn't worry. We've settled in quite well. I've dispatched several of my wardens to assist in hunting down the Druids of the Flame, and I've drawn assault plans for the Forlorn Spire. When the time is right, perhaps you will join us there.

english.title: The Hunt Begins
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: The Shadow Wardens have joined the fight at the Molten Front, on your request. You should find Captain Saynna Stormrunner and see to it that they've found a way to best apply their skills.
english.completion: Hello, $n. It's good to see you again.$B$BYou needn't worry. We've settled in quite well. I've dispatched several of my wardens to assist in hunting down the Druids of the Flame, and I've drawn assault plans for the Forlorn Spire. When the time is right, perhaps you will join us there.

text.title: 玛法里奥突破口
text.objectives: Secure a foothold in the Firelands.

english.title: Malfurion's Breach
english.objectives: Secure a foothold in the Firelands.

text.title: 受困的斥候
text.objectives: 解救被俘的斥候：哈兹莱克、巴卡祖鲁、洛尔卡尼和卡莎。他们遭到了阿曼尼高阶祭司的关押。
text.description: 我们抵达之后，我就派遣了手下的斥候去探查赞达拉部族在祖阿曼的活动情况。他们中很多人带回了有用的情报，但仍有四人还没回来。如果我们不赶快行动，督军将会指挥军官们将斥候献祭给赞达拉大使。$B$B出发寻找我的斥候，$N，并将他们从异端牧师手中解救出来！
text.completion: I hadn't expected to see dem again, $n. The information dey gathered will be da key to destroying Zandalari influence in Zul'Aman. Ya have my thanks and da thanks of my scouts.
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Hakkuz in Zul'Aman.

english.title: The Captive Scouts
english.objectives: Free the captive scouts: Hazlek, Bakkalzu, Norkani, and Kasha. They are being held captive by the Amani high priests.
english.description: After we arrived, I dispatched my scouts to learn more about da Zandalari presence here in Zul'Aman. Many returned with useful information, but four still be missin'. If we do not act quickly, da new warlord's lieutenants will offer dem as sacrifices in honor of da Zandalari emissaries.$B$BFind my scouts, $N, and free dem before da priests offer dem as sacrifices!
english.completion: I hadn't expected to see dem again, $n. The information dey gathered will be da key to destroying Zandalari influence in Zul'Aman. Ya have my thanks and da thanks of my scouts.
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Hakkuz in Zul'Aman.

text.title: 布温巴之魂
text.objectives: 警告荆棘谷的人们，并找到另一名暗矛大使。
text.description: 对暗矛巨魔来说，现在真是困难的时期。赞达拉部族正在集结所有巨魔部落，想要收回所有他们失去的领土。$B$B我们想警告尽可能多的人，但恐怕已经太晚了。$B$B已经有另一个暗矛战士去荆棘谷警告他们了，但在荆棘谷单独出行并不安全。$B$B帮助我找到他，并警告荆棘谷的人们，巨魔部落即将重新崛起。$B$B我会让我的灵魂跟随你，如此一来，你赶到荆棘谷的时候，我将可以帮助你。
text.progress: Dis won't be no easy task, $n.
text.completion: Dere ya have it, $n.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.$b$bDese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.$b$bYa been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.$b$bSpirits be wit' ya, $n.
text.objective1: Help Bwemba Find the Darkspear Emissary

english.title: Bwemba's Spirit
english.objectives: Warn the people of Stranglethorn and find the other Darkspear emissary.
english.description: Dese be troublin' times for us Darkspear.  Da Zandalar be reuniting all da troll clans an' plan to take back da lands dey lost.$b$bWe tryin' to warn all dat we can.  But it might be too late.$b$bAnother Darkspear gone down to Stranglethorn to warn da people.  But it ain't safe to travel alone in Stranglethorn.$b$bHelp me find him and make sure da people in Stranglethorn are warned of da rise of da troll tribes.$b$bI gonna bind my spirit wit' ya.  When ya get to Stranglethorn, I be able to aid ya.
english.progress: Dis won't be no easy task, $n.
english.completion: Dere ya have it, $n.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.$b$bDese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.$b$bYa been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.$b$bSpirits be wit' ya, $n.
english.objective1: Help Bwemba Find the Darkspear Emissary

text.title: 前往邦巴拉
text.objectives: 前往北荆棘谷的邦巴拉寻找暗矛大使。
text.description: 这将是我们侦察的第一个营地，也是最可能遭到进攻的地点——邦巴拉。$B$B邦巴拉靠近巨魔城市祖尔格拉布……这使得它很可能成为目标。$B$B也许我们可以在那里找到大使。希望一切还没太晚。
text.completion: It seems da spirits be wit' you, $c.
text.end: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: To Bambala
english.objectives: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale to find the Darkspear emissary.
english.description: Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first, Bambala.$b$bBambala be dangerously close to da troll city Zul'Gurub... It make for an easy target.$b$bMaybe we find da emissary dere.  Hopefully it ain't too late.
english.completion: It seems da spirits be wit' you, $c.
english.end: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 毒蛇与毒药
text.objectives: 杀死丛林毒蛇，调查中毒猎头者，让布温巴治疗他们。
text.description: 警告起到了作用，$N。$B$B我们集结了更多猎头者来防御营地。但是猎头者……不擅长猎蛇的头。所以我们很快就坚持不住了。这些毒蛇，他们仿佛遍地都是，而且我估计情况只会越来越糟糕。$B$B帮助我们杀掉那些毒蛇，布温巴的魔精也可以治疗那些中毒的家伙。
text.completion: Thanks for da help, $n.  Dese serpents, dere don't seem to be an end to dem.
text.completed: Return to Bambala

english.title: Serpents and Poison
english.objectives: Kill Jungle Serpents and inspect the poisoned Headhunters to allow Bwemba to heal them.
english.description: Da warning helped, $n.$b$bWe gathered more Headhunters to help defend.  But Headhunters... Dey not used to hunting heads on serpents.  So we soon be overwhelmed.  Dese serpents, dey seem to come from everywhere.  An' it probably only gonna get worse.$b$bHelp us and kill da serpents and have Bwemba use her mojo to cure da ones dat are sick from poison.
english.completion: Thanks for da help, $n.  Dese serpents, dere don't seem to be an end to dem.
english.completed: Return to Bambala

text.title: 灵魂与我们同在
text.objectives: Prepare the bonfire in front of the serpent shrine near Bambala for Bwemba's ritual.
text.description: Dere was something about da way da serpents attacked, $n.  Something unnatural...  Even da poison had a hint of some bad mojo.$b$bDere be a shrine near here wit' a bonfire.  We can use dat to perform a ritual.$b$bWhatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem.$b$bDa only problem, $n, is dat I only be here in spirit form.  I need you to be my hands.  I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me.  Den I'll handle da rest.
text.completion: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

english.title: Spirits Are With Us
english.objectives: Prepare the bonfire in front of the serpent shrine near Bambala for Bwemba's ritual.
english.description: Dere was something about da way da serpents attacked, $n.  Something unnatural...  Even da poison had a hint of some bad mojo.$b$bDere be a shrine near here wit' a bonfire.  We can use dat to perform a ritual.$b$bWhatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem.$b$bDa only problem, $n, is dat I only be here in spirit form.  I need you to be my hands.  I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me.  Den I'll handle da rest.
english.completion: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

text.title: 无所不知的奈辛瓦里
text.objectives: 提醒北荆棘谷奈辛瓦里远征队的猎手们。
text.description: 所以说，是暴怒的古拉巴什正在使用毒蛇发起进攻。$B$B你知道谁最擅长遏制动物数量吗？当然是奈辛瓦里远征队的猎人们。$B$B前往他们的营地看看他们情况如何，看看他们是否知道解决这些毒蛇的办法。$B$B如果他们不知道，那你必须告诉警告他们，因为这些毒蛇看上去很不一般。
text.completion: We know all about the serpents, $n.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, $c!
text.end: Head to Nesingwary's Expedition.

english.title: Nesingwary Will Know
english.objectives: Warn the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: So da Gurubashi be on da rampage an' dey usin' serpents to lead da charge.$b$bYou know who be good at keepin' da animal population in check?  Da hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition.$b$bHead over dere and see how dey doin'.  See if dey know a good way to get rid of da serpents.$b$bIf dey don't know, den you gotta at least warn dem dat dese serpents, it ain't all natural.
english.completion: We know all about the serpents, $n.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, $c!
english.end: Head to Nesingwary's Expedition.

text.title: [DEPRICATED] NO LONGER USED
text.objectives: Gaze into the Timeless Eye.$b$bSpeak to Tarecgosa at the Rift to activate the artifact.
text.description: Here we are, mortal.$b$bThe rift emits intense energy that will shield the magic of your artifact.$b$bWhen you are ready, I will activate the Eye. Doing so will require all of my focus. You must witness the vision on your own.$b$bHurry now, $c. It is unsafe for us to tarry here.
text.completed: Speak to Tarecgosa at the Rift in The Nexus.

english.title: [DEPRICATED] NO LONGER USED
english.objectives: Gaze into the Timeless Eye.$b$bSpeak to Tarecgosa at the Rift to activate the artifact.
english.description: Here we are, mortal.$b$bThe rift emits intense energy that will shield the magic of your artifact.$b$bWhen you are ready, I will activate the Eye. Doing so will require all of my focus. You must witness the vision on your own.$b$bHurry now, $c. It is unsafe for us to tarry here.
english.completed: Speak to Tarecgosa at the Rift in The Nexus.

text.title: 可靠情报
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的诺达希尔，跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈。
text.description: <泰蕾苟萨认真倾听了你所描述的景象。>$B$B不可能！$B$B就算是阿瑞苟斯，他也不敢如此僭越。$B$B我并不是质疑你的诚实，$C，但你必须理解——要想欺骗你们凡人的心智，实在是很简单。$B$B尽管如此，我们还是要把这些情报告诉卡雷苟斯。你得前往诺达希尔，去找他。$B$B我要留在这里，掩盖我们活动的证据。千万别把这事告诉其他人！
text.completion: <Kalecgos listens to your account of recent events.>$B$BIt was wise of Tarecgosa to send you to me, $C.$B$BThough your vision in the Nexus was almost certainly an elaborate illusion, it would be irresponsible of me not to investigate it.

english.title: Actionable Intelligence
english.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <Tarecgosa listens intently as you describe your vision.>$b$bImpossible!$b$bNot even Arygos would dare to go to such lengths.$b$bI do not question your integrity, $c, but you must understand - your mortal mind can easily be deceived.$b$bRegardless, Kalecgos must be informed of these events. You must travel to Nordrassil at once to seek him out.$b$bI shall remain here to conceal the evidence of our activities. Speak of this to no one else!
english.completion: <Kalecgos listens to your account of recent events.>$B$BIt was wise of Tarecgosa to send you to me, $C.$B$BThough your vision in the Nexus was almost certainly an elaborate illusion, it would be irresponsible of me not to investigate it.

text.title: 追踪那野兽
text.objectives: 在北荆棘谷找到格伦特·恐锤。
text.description: 我们已经抵御毒蛇的进攻好多天了，$N。但和丛林里的某样东西比起来，这些毒蛇根本就不算什么。$B$B我们是猎手，却被当成了猎物。$B$B一只名叫玛乌提的猎豹正不断猎杀我的手下，将他们拖入草丛的深处。$B$B我们派去了我们最好的猎手之一——格伦特·恐锤——去追踪这个野兽。$B$B恐锤去了东边，也许你可以在那里找到他们。
text.completion: Shhh....

english.title: Track the Tracker
english.objectives: Find Grent Direhammer in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: We've been fending off serpents for days now, $n.  But the serpents are nothing compared to what else is out in that jungle.$b$bWe hunters are being hunted.$b$bA large panther named Mauti has been dragging my men off into the bush.$b$bWe sent Grent Direhammer, one of our best hunters, to track this beast down.$b$bDirehammer headed off to the east, perhaps you can find them there.
english.completion: Shhh....

text.title: 猎手的复仇
text.objectives: 给格伦特·恐锤一个交代，杀死玛乌提。
text.description: 我一直在猎杀……那个猎杀我们的野兽。$B$B玛乌提，就是他的名字。他是个聪明的家伙，但他犯了个巨大的错误，就是杀死了我的兄弟。现在，这个错误将让他付出代价。恐锤已经找到了他的踪迹。$B$B我注意到他就在库尔森的营地上方游荡。如果我们赶快行动，我们可以消灭他。$B$B准备好了吗，$N？
text.completion: Looks like the real Mauti was tracking Grent Direhammer all along.  Clever cat.
text.end: Bring Grent Direhammer to the body of Mauti

english.title: The Hunter's Revenge
english.objectives: Give Grent Direhammer the closure he needs by killing Mauti.
english.description: The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.$b$bWe call him Mauti.  He's a clever one.  But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother.  Now that mistake is going to cost him.  Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.$b$bI've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound.  If we act fast, we can take him down.$b$bAre you ready, $n?
english.completion: Looks like the real Mauti was tracking Grent Direhammer all along.  Clever cat.
english.end: Bring Grent Direhammer to the body of Mauti

text.title: 追踪猛兽
text.objectives: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
text.description: 很好，这解释了为什么玛乌提看起来那么小……格伦特·恐锤被真正的玛乌提抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们可以追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
text.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
text.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

english.title: Follow That Cat
english.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
english.description: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller...  The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!
english.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
english.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

text.objectives: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
text.description: 很好，这解释了为什么玛乌提看起来那么小……格伦特·恐锤被真正的玛乌提抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们可以追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
text.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
text.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

english.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
english.description: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller...  The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!
english.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
english.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

text.title: 玛乌提
text.objectives: 将布温巴带到玛乌提的尸体旁边。
text.description: 我感觉那头猎豹不太对劲，$N。太不自然了。我需要在尸体上进行一些仪式。杀掉玛乌提，然后我们看看能有什么发现，$N。
text.completion: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.
text.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

english.title: Mauti
english.objectives: Bring Bwemba to the remains of Mauti.
english.description: I got da feeling dat somethin' ain't right wit' dat panther, $n.  It ain't natural.  I gonna need to perform some rituals over da body.  Put Mauti down, an' den let's see what we can find out, $n.
english.completion: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.
english.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

text.title: 猎手还活着吗？
text.objectives: 查看格伦特·恐锤是否安好。
text.description: 情况看起来不妙，那猎豹拥有强大的魔法能力。我们最好快去看看那猎手现在怎么样了。
text.completion: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

english.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
english.objectives: Check on Grent Direhammer.
english.description: Tings ain't looking good.  Dat panther was under some powerful magic.  We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.
english.completion: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

text.title: 与靴同葬……
text.objectives: 找到格伦特·恐锤的靴子。
text.description: 啊……是你啊，$N。玛乌提……他死了？我终于活到了为我兄弟报仇的这一刻。我对你只有一个请求……这头小豹崽在这里挠我的脚很久了。作为一个矮人，我不该光着脚去死。$B$B求求你，让我穿着靴子下葬。
text.progress: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?
text.completion: Th-thank ye, $g lad:lass;.$b$bPappy...?$b$b$bIs that...$b$b$b$byou...$b$b$b$b$b...
text.completed: Return to Grent Direhammer.

english.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
english.objectives: Collect Grent Direhammer's boots.
english.description: Ah... It's you, $n.  Mauti... He's dead?  Then my brother has been avenged.  I've only one request from ya... This scamp here, he's been pawing at me bare feet.  No dwarf should go to the earth with bare feet.$b$bPlease, bury me with me boots.
english.progress: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?
english.completion: Th-thank ye, $g lad:lass;.$b$bPappy...?$b$b$bIs that...$b$b$b$byou...$b$b$b$b$b...
english.completed: Return to Grent Direhammer.

text.title: Warn Grom'gol
text.objectives: Make your way to Grom'gol Base Camp.
text.description: Dis death ain't be in vain, $n.  We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl.  Tings don't look good.$b$bWe better check out Grom'gol Base Camp to da west.  Maybe we find my contact dere.
text.completion: First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have blood-thirsty trolls.$b$bIt's good that you're here, $c, there are plenty of trolls to kill.

english.title: Warn Grom'gol
english.objectives: Make your way to Grom'gol Base Camp.
english.description: Dis death ain't be in vain, $n.  We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl.  Tings don't look good.$b$bWe better check out Grom'gol Base Camp to da west.  Maybe we find my contact dere.
english.completion: First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have blood-thirsty trolls.$b$bIt's good that you're here, $c, there are plenty of trolls to kill.

text.title: 委派
text.objectives: 去火焰之地夺回诺达希尔的分枝。
text.description: 我有责任对你的发现进行调查，$R，这也就意味着我的任务现在只能交给你了。$B$B一股远非天然生成的强大魔力将我引来此地，我这才发现事态大为不妙。$B$B有人将诺达希尔的一根树枝折了下来，带到了火焰之地的深处。在那里，敌人正利用它进行邪恶的仪式，以腐蚀诺达希尔，试图用大火烧毁它。$B$B你必须想办法干扰仪式，将世界之树的树枝夺回来。
text.progress: Were you able to recover Nordrassil's Bough, $C?
text.completion: Nordrassil's Bough...$B$BYou have done well, mortal.
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Delegation
english.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
english.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.
english.progress: Were you able to recover Nordrassil's Bough, $C?
english.completion: Nordrassil's Bough...$B$BYou have done well, mortal.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

text.title: Defend Grom'gol
text.objectives: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.
text.description: I hope you like to fight, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage.  I never thought the battle would be this glorious though.$b$bCome, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!
text.completion: These trolls just keep coming, $n.  I love it!$b$bLike I said before, the Darkspear emissary was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.$b$bThysta, our Wind Rider Master, helped get him to his next destination, maybe she can help you out.$b$bHappy hunting, $n.
text.end: Help Defend Grom'gol Base Camp
text.completed: Speak to Commander Aggro'gosh

english.objectives: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.

english.completion: These trolls just keep coming, $n.  I love it!$b$bLike I said before, the Darkspear emissary was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.$b$bThysta, our Wind Rider Master, helped get him to his next destination, maybe she can help you out.$b$bHappy hunting, $n.
english.end: Help Defend Grom'gol Base Camp
english.completed: Speak to Commander Aggro'gosh

text.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
text.objectives: Head to Hardwrench Hideaway in The Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.description: Bwemba...  Is that you?$b$bYour contact was here.  He was eager to get to the next location and warn them.  And really, who could blame him?  I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn.$b$bI will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench.$b$bTalk to me when you are ready to go, $n.
text.completion: Dis don't look very good, $n.

english.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
english.objectives: Head to Hardwrench Hideaway in The Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Bwemba...  Is that you?$b$bYour contact was here.  He was eager to get to the next location and warn them.  And really, who could blame him?  I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn.$b$bI will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench.$b$bTalk to me when you are ready to go, $n.
english.completion: Dis don't look very good, $n.

text.title: 巫毒僵尸
text.objectives: Rescue 10 Hideaway Survivors.
text.description: 那些人……他们都成了僵尸，还是巫毒僵尸！这看起来可不妙，$N。$B$B你必须杀了他们。$B$B他们被杀死后的那段时间，我可以拯救他们，把他们变回曾经的人形。$B$B我们必须赶快行动，僵尸可不会休息。
text.completion: We done enough, $n.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

english.title: Voodoo Zombies
english.objectives: Rescue 10 Hideaway Survivors.
english.description: Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies!  Dis ain't gonna be pretty, $n.$b$bYou gotta kill dem.$b$bBut once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem.  Change dem back into da person dey were before.$b$bWe gotta act fast.  Da zombies don' rest.
english.completion: We done enough, $n.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

text.title: 不良供给
text.objectives: Check out the food preparation area in Hardwrench Hideaway.
text.description: 有些幸存者提到了食物，$N。我们最好赶快检查下食物补给，我有种不祥的预感。
text.completion: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

english.title: Bad Supplies
english.objectives: Check out the food preparation area in Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Some of da survivors mentioned food, $n.  We better check da food supplies.  I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.
english.completion: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

text.title: 诺达希尔的分枝
text.objectives: 去北风苔原的琥珀崖拿到诺达希尔的分枝。
text.description: 自从我们上次交谈以来，事情明朗了不少。$B$B前往魔枢，夺回阿纳克洛斯的神器，我自是当仁不让，当然东西得自己用。现在我也见证了你所看到的。$B$B在进一步探讨接下来的计划之前，请允许我为了你在这里和火元素位面所提供的援助，向你表示感谢。
text.completion: Nordrassil's Bough is now joined with the Timeless Eye.$B$BEven a battleworn hero such as yourself cannot help but be humbled by such a gift.

english.title: Nordrassil's Bough
english.objectives: Collect the Branch of Nordrassil at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.
english.description: Much has transpired since last we spoke.$b$bI have taken it upon myself to visit the Nexus and recover Anachronos's artifact, but not before using it for myself. Now I too have witnessed that which you have seen.$b$bBefore discussing the matter further, allow me to express my gratitude to you for your assistance, both here and in the Plane of Fire.
english.completion: Nordrassil's Bough is now joined with the Timeless Eye.$B$BEven a battleworn hero such as yourself cannot help but be humbled by such a gift.

text.title: 紧急撤退
text.objectives: 陪伴卡雷苟斯前往考达拉。$B$B准备好了就跟他谈谈。
text.description: 现在，说回手头的正事……$B$B我相信是死亡之翼谋划了魔枢的幻象，他想让我们军团在最脆弱的时候爆发内部冲突。$B$B如果我们陷入内讧，灭世者就会渔翁得利。$B$B而且，我一直有一种不安的预感，所以不得不谨慎处之。$B$B在做出抉择的时刻来临之前，我最好还是带着泰蕾苟萨撤退。
text.completion: She is dying, $N.$B$BI have... failed her.
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

english.title: Emergency Extraction
english.objectives: Accompany Kalecgos to Coldarra.$b$bSpeak to him when you are ready.
english.description: Now, back to the matter at hand...$b$bI am convinced that the vision in the Nexus is one of Deathwing's illusions designed to bring conflict into our flight at a very fragile time.$b$bThe Worldbreaker would only be strengthened were we to fall to infighting.$b$bStill, a gnawing sense of unease tempts me to take a path of caution.$b$bIt would be wise for me to take Tarecgosa and withdraw until the time of choosing.
english.completion: She is dying, $N.$B$BI have... failed her.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

text.title: 消灭碎神者
text.objectives: 在英雄难度的祖尔格拉布杀死碎神者金度。
text.description: <鲜血杀手扎拉指向远处的神庙。>$B$B上一次人们将金度从这个世界上除掉的时候，他并未完全消亡，而是成了一只灵魂世界中脆弱而潦倒的阴影。$B$B但面对灵魂的时候，金度总是拥有着无比的力量。一个接着一个，灵魂们服从了他的意志。而随着他不断吞噬灵魂，金度即将撕裂出一个联结灵魂世界和这个世界的裂口。$B$B他应该已经来到了此地……$B$B灵魂与我们同在，我们必须结果金度。
text.completion: It be done, then.  Spilling da blood of our brothers be a grim task.  Da city of da Gurubashi has seen only death an' hatred for years. Maybe it be time for da jungle ta retake Zul'Gurub, an' wash da scent of death from dis place. Blood and honor, champion, to da Siame-Quashi you will always be known as "Bloodslayer".
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer Zala inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: Break him.

english.title: Break the Godbreaker
english.objectives: Kill Jin'do the Godbreaker inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: <Bloodslayer Zala points at the temple in the distance.>$B$BWhen Jin'do was last ripped from dis world, he survived as a shade, weak and broken, in da spirit world.$B$BBut Jin'do always had power over da spirits.  One by one, he broke dem to his will, and wit' each soul devoured, Jin'do got closer ta' rippin' a hole through to dis world.$B$BTa be here now...$B$BDa spirits be wit' us, we must end Jin'do.
english.completion: It be done, then.  Spilling da blood of our brothers be a grim task.  Da city of da Gurubashi has seen only death an' hatred for years. Maybe it be time for da jungle ta retake Zul'Gurub, an' wash da scent of death from dis place. Blood and honor, champion, to da Siame-Quashi you will always be known as "Bloodslayer".
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer Zala inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: Break him.

text.title: 无价之宝的价值
text.objectives: 调查疯狂之缘并找到神秘的古拉巴什宝石。
text.description: 听着，朋友。我不认识你，你也不认识我。但既然我们俩都在此地，里维加兹要我给你传个话。$B$B也许你只是碰巧路过这个遍地巨魔的丛林炼狱，也许你碰巧找到了一件二件巨魔神器，也许你又将他们带回来给我了，而我不小心准备了个礼物给你。$B$B如果你想知道这些东西有什么用，我可以告诉你我们在做个项目。但具体是什么项目？我可不告诉你。
text.progress: So, did you find a thing?  Because my pants are getting pretty heavy from all of this treasure of yours I'm holding onto.
text.completion: What have you got there?$B$BA crazy-looking snake idol?  What am I supposed to do with this?  Hit someone over the head with it and steal something that's actually valuable?$B$BThis thing is worthless!$B$B<Briney tosses the Bijou into the water.>$B$BThanks for the "help," I guess.  Here's your "reward."$B$BIdiot.
text.completed: Speak to Briney Boltcutter inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: Investigate the Cache of Madness.

english.title: Putting a Price on Priceless
english.objectives: Investigate the Cache of Madness and find the Mysterious Gurubashi Bijou.
english.description: Listen, friend.  I don't know you, and you don't know me.  But as long as we're both here, there's something Revilgaz wanted me to mention.$B$BMaybe you're taking a stroll through this troll-infested jungle-ocalypse.  Maybe you happen to find a priceless troll artifact or two.  Maybe you bring it back to me and I accidentally leave behind a little present for ya'.$B$BIf you must know, it's for a project.  And no, you can't ask what the project is.
english.progress: So, did you find a thing?  Because my pants are getting pretty heavy from all of this treasure of yours I'm holding onto.
english.completion: What have you got there?$B$BA crazy-looking snake idol?  What am I supposed to do with this?  Hit someone over the head with it and steal something that's actually valuable?$B$BThis thing is worthless!$B$B<Briney tosses the Bijou into the water.>$B$BThanks for the "help," I guess.  Here's your "reward."$B$BIdiot.
english.completed: Speak to Briney Boltcutter inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: Investigate the Cache of Madness.

text.title: Strike at the Heart
text.objectives: Kill the Lieutenant of Flame.
text.description: One of Ragnaros' Lieutenants has shown itself at Ragnaros' Reach.  It is time to strike. Captain Saynna has requested that you be there to help see the fight through.$B$BWitherbranch and some others will have joined the battle by the time you arrive.  You should make haste to the northwest and find them.
text.completion: Very well done, $N! This should delay them significantly.$B$BIf we keep this up, we can easily push the fight back to Ragnaros himself.
text.completed: Return to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: A Lieutenant of Flame
text.objectives: Report to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Ragnaros' Reach.
text.description: Captain Saynna has requested your presence at Ragnaros' Reach. A Lieutenant of Flame has shown himself and she thinks you are our greatest chance at striking against him.$B$BMake your way there as soon as you're able.

english.objectives: Report to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Ragnaros' Reach.
english.description: Captain Saynna has requested your presence at Ragnaros' Reach. A Lieutenant of Flame has shown himself and she thinks you are our greatest chance at striking against him.$B$BMake your way there as soon as you're able.

text.title: The Mysterious Seed
text.objectives: Take the Acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
text.description: A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe.$B$BWhy would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around?$B$BPerhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.
text.completion: Fascinating! It appears to be an acorn!
text.completed: Take the acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
