english.objectives: Take the Acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
english.description: A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe.$B$BWhy would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around?$B$BPerhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.
english.completion: Fascinating! It appears to be an acorn!
english.completed: Take the acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: 镇痛
text.objectives: 从炙热的葬火领主身上收集4颗烈焰裹附核心。
text.description: 大德鲁伊对疼痛的忍耐超乎常人。我曾经一天22个小时处理被烧伤的伤员，我的耳朵都要被他们的惨叫震聋了，但他们的烧伤还没有哈缪尔的一半严重。$B$B不管怎样，我能感觉到他今天非常苦恼。去东南边给我带大型火元素的核心来。我可以用它们做镇痛膏。
text.progress: These hearts will give us exactly what Hamuul needs to rest.
text.completion: I must get to work preparing the salve immediately. These reagents lose their efficacy by the minute.$b$bThank you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Relieving the Pain
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Flame-Wreathed Hearts from Seething Firelords.
english.description: The Arch Druid has an immense tolerance for pain. I've treated burn victims that spend twenty-two hours a day screaming in pain, and their burns weren't even half as bad as what Hamuul has suffered.$b$bNevertheless, I can sense that he is in greater discomfort than normal today. Bring me the hearts of the large fire elementals to the southeast. I can use them to prepare a soothing salve for our patient.
english.progress: These hearts will give us exactly what Hamuul needs to rest.
english.completion: I must get to work preparing the salve immediately. These reagents lose their efficacy by the minute.$b$bThank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 疗伤
text.objectives: 从塞西莉亚的栖地的火焰巨兽身上弄来4个沾满硫磺的包裹。
text.description: 庇护所里的医疗供给很充足，但是我们面对的是一场战争。不是只有哈缪尔需要绷带。$B$B在塞西莉亚的栖地附近游荡的火焰巨兽有抗火包裹，可以当作任何一种绷带来治疗哈缪尔。给我弄点来，我会用来治疗大德鲁伊。
text.progress: There are some who say that the sulfur in those wrappings has curative properties. Personally, I am unconvinced, but I am willing to endure the smell on the off-chance that it does.
text.completion: Many thanks, $c.$b$bYou do the war effort a favor. Burn victims have a notorious appetite for bandages, and Hamuul is no exception.
text.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Treating the Wounds
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Sulfur-Laced Wrappings from Fiery Behemoths in Sethria's Roost.
english.description: We have an ample supply of medical supplies here at the Sanctuary, but we mustn't lose sight of the fact that we are at war. Hamuul isn't the only person who has need of bandages.$b$bThe fiery behemoths that roam Sethria's Roost wear flame-resistant wrappings that will serve Hamuul as ably as any bandage. Bring me those wrappings, and I will prepare them for use on the Arch Druid.
english.progress: There are some who say that the sulfur in those wrappings has curative properties. Personally, I am unconvinced, but I am willing to endure the smell on the off-chance that it does.
english.completion: Many thanks, $c.$b$bYou do the war effort a favor. Burn victims have a notorious appetite for bandages, and Hamuul is no exception.
english.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 减压
text.objectives: 收集100块火妖的鳞片。
text.description: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔的烧伤非常严重，很多地方都浮肿了——身体的组织开始肿胀。为了不让他因肿胀而窒息，他的随从费了不少力气。$B$B通常来说，要消除这种肿胀，我们需要切肉放脓，但是他很虚弱，$N。今天我不能下刀。我需要你的帮助。$B$B火妖的鳞片对治疗肿胀很有疗效，但所需的数量却很庞大。
text.progress: Do you have the scales? I hesitate to cut the Arch Druid again, but we must relieve the swelling somehow.
text.completion: You are a compassionate $R. With this many scales, we won't have to cut him again for another day, at least. Perhaps two.
text.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Releasing the Pressure
english.objectives: Obtain 100 Flamewaker Scales.
english.description: Having been burned so badly, Arch Druid Hamuul is suffering from edema - swelling of the body's tissues. It takes a great deal of his attendants' effort to keep his swelling down enough for him to breathe.$b$bNormally, to reduce this swelling, we make cuts in his flesh, but he is weak, $N. I cannot cut him today. I need your help.$b$bFlamewaker scales will aid with the swelling, but you need a lot of them.
english.progress: Do you have the scales? I hesitate to cut the Arch Druid again, but we must relieve the swelling somehow.
english.completion: You are a compassionate $R. With this many scales, we won't have to cut him again for another day, at least. Perhaps two.
english.completed: Return to Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Planting Season
text.objectives: Plant the Acorn in the Un'Goro Soil at Malfurion's Breach.
text.description: The acorn seems to be unharmed.$B$B<Avrilla shrugs.>$B$BNo point in beating around the bush. Let's plant it and see what comes out.$B$BLuckily for you, we brought some leftover soil with us to help establish our base.$B$BYou'll find the soil at the graveyard directly east.
text.completion: A red flower pops its head out of the soil.

text.title: 尝试交流
text.objectives: 前往藏宝海湾并找到布温巴的联络人。
text.description: 你不是僵尸……$B$B你在找一个巨魔？我确实看到过一个，就在战斗爆发之前……他警告了我们，督促我们提高警惕……但一切都太晚了。$B$B你的巨魔朋友已经赶往藏宝海湾去警告那里的人了……
text.completion: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

english.title: Making Contact
english.objectives: Head to Booty Bay and find Bwemba's contact.
english.description: You aren't one of the zombies...$b$bA troll?  I did see one, just before the outbreak...  He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late.$b$bYour troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...
english.completion: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

text.title: 藏宝海湾的利益
text.objectives: 取回一件可以将祖尔格拉布巨魔驱逐出藏宝海湾的神器。
text.description: 听着，$N，至此你已经帮了很大的忙了，但那还远远不够。我们必须阻止这些疯狂的巨魔，至少成功把他们挡在藏宝海湾的大门外。$B$B我会派人去指挥整个行动，但我需要你进入祖尔格拉布，帮我做些事情。$B$B就是说，我需要你为我找来一个可以将这些巨魔赶出藏宝海湾的物件。$B$B你要是能做到的话，我们不会亏待你的。
text.progress: Did you find something, $N?
text.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

english.title: Booty Bay's Interests
english.objectives: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
english.description: Look, $n.  You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough.  I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay.$b$bI'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen.$b$bAt the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.$b$bYou do that and we'll treat you right.
english.progress: Did you find something, $N?
english.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

text.title: 藏宝海湾的利益
text.objectives: 取回一件可以将祖尔格拉布巨魔驱逐出藏宝海湾的神器。
text.description: 藏宝海湾的大财主里维加兹派我到这里的目的，就是确保这次巨魔的威胁可以有效地被遏止，至少成功把他们挡在藏宝海湾的大门外。$B$B我需要大家马上行动，取得成效。$B$B所以你应该到那里去，奋勇杀敌。$B$B然后你要找到一样可以把巨魔从藏宝海湾驱逐走的物件。$B$B你要是能做到的话，我们会给予你报酬的。
text.progress: Did you find something, $n?
text.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$b$bAh, but what's that you have?$b$bYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$b$bNow we are talking!$b$bOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

english.objectives: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
english.description: I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted.  Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay.$b$bI want action and I want results.$b$bI want you to get in there and kill.$b$bI want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.$b$bYou do that and we'll make sure you get paid.
english.progress: Did you find something, $n?
english.completion: You killed them all? Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.

text.title: 闪亮的报酬
text.objectives: 到加尼罗哨站的雕像下取得你的奖赏。
text.description: 就在荆棘谷藏宝海湾的西北边，有一处藏宝点位于加尼罗哨站的雕像附近。$B$B前往那个雕像领取你的奖赏，$C。
text.completion: Loot at last!

english.title: A Shiny Reward
english.objectives: Get your reward from a chest in the statue at Janeiro's Point.
english.description: There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.$b$bHead to the statue and claim your prize, $c.
english.completion: Loot at last!

text.title: Little Lasher
text.objectives: Bring the Crimson Lasher to Avrilla.
text.description: The little red flower wiggles its tendrils happily. It seems to like you!$B$BPerhaps Avrilla would like to see what grew out of the acorn.
text.completion: Oh my! Who's your little friend? It followed you, you say?
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

english.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: 餘燼膠質
text.objectives: Retrieve 5 Embergris from Charred Soldiers and Charred Vanquishers.
text.description: The Crimson Lasher has developed some cracking blisters on its vines. Without treatment, this condition could be life threatening.$B$BLuckily, the Charred Soldiers and Charred Vanquishers in the area produce a waxy substance known as Embergris, which should soothe the Lasher's pain.$B$BBring me some of this substance, and kill those nasty fire elementals while you're at it.
text.progress: The Lasher is growing quite quickly.
text.completion: It isn't very pleasant-smelling, but this should fix the Lasher right up.
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Eat Your Heart Out
text.objectives: Retrieve 3 Lava Burster Hearts.
text.description: Hello $N. Checking in on your Fire Lasher?$B$BHe seems quite hungry, but no mixture of fertilizer or plant growth seems to interest him.$B$BSome plants are carnivorous, and I'd like to test this rather unconventional theory.$B$BWould you retrieve some Lava Burster Hearts for me? The Lava Bursters frequent the fields to the north.
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: Steal Magmolias
text.objectives: Collect 8 Magmolias from the Magma Springs to the north.
text.description: We've discovered a new species of flower growing in the Magma Springs to the north. Amazingly, they sustain themselves in pure molten lava!$B$BPlease go and retrieve some specimens for me. I'm sure that further study of these plants will shed some light on your little friend here.$B$BSpeaking of which, he seems quite eager to go with you. Let's hope he behaves himself.
text.progress: Fascinating! The more time I spend in the Firelands, the more I see there is an ecosystem at work here.
text.completion: Thank you, $N. I will start analyzing these samples at once.
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Hide and Seek
text.objectives: Find and expose the hidden Fire Lasher in Malfurion's Breach.
text.description: Good to see you again, $N. Your Lasher here has invented a new game - hide and seek!$B$BIt looks like he wants to play with you.$B$BWait until he hides himself, then look for him somewhere in the camp.$B$BIf he's too well-hidden, I've created this special mist that will reveal his general direction. Don't tell him I gave it ito you.
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.objectives: Take the Fire Lasher to the burnt tree.
text.description: Your Fire Lasher has been quite restless. He keeps visiting the old burnt tree, though for what reason, I cannot fathom.$B$B$N, would you do me a favor and take your Fire Lasher to the tree? Perhaps you can figure out what interests him so much about that place.

text.title: A Bitter Pill
text.objectives: Find the Subterranean Magma Worm's breath bubbles, then defeat it by making it swallow the Bitter Pill.
text.description: As far as I'm concerned, there's no problem that can't be solved with bombs. And if a bomb doesn't solve your problem on the first try... use a bigger bomb.$b$bSo there's this big worm that's been eating people near the lava pools up north. Search for breath bubbles to find it. Attack it until it prepares to bite, then place this bomb down in front of it. Then sit back and watch the fireworks.$b$bHmm... there was one other thing I wanted to say... oh yeah! Don't get eaten.
text.completion: Ah knew Ricket's bombs'd come in handy. Twas just a matter ah findin' somethin' big enough to explode.
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 熔火激流的火妖
text.objectives: 去熔火激流击败8条火妖。
text.description: 在拉格纳罗斯的爪牙中，火妖貌似是最虔诚的。它们大多居住在这个洞窟里，准备着下一次的进攻。我们的根据地或许很牢固，但是我们也不能容许这些爬虫发动奇袭。$B$B绝不！我们必须先下手为强。$B$B去消灭那些烈焰的奴仆吧，$N。
text.completion: I like the way you work, $N.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow within the Molten Flow in the Molten Front.

english.title: Flamewakers of the Molten Flow
english.objectives: Slay 8 Flamewakers within the Molten Flow.
english.description: Of all Ragnaros' minions, the flamewakers appear to be the most devoted. Most of them dwell within this cave, preparing for another attack. Our foothold may be strong, but we will not tolerate any surprise attacks from these worms.$b$bNo, we will strike first.$b$bTear them apart, $N.
english.completion: I like the way you work, $N.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow within the Molten Flow in the Molten Front.

text.title: 火焰之花
text.objectives: 采摘5朵炼狱花。
text.description: 我的德鲁伊伙伴楚伦娜要我们帮忙收集生长在火焰之地的一切植物标本……$B$B……我不知道把学究带到战线上来到底是谁的主意。$B$B无论如何，你反正要去洞穴里——干点打打杀杀的事情——不如顺便帮忙注意一下地上长出来的东西。
text.progress: They could be growing anywhere. Keep your eyes open.
text.completion: These things never cease to amaze me. Whether they're actual plants, or just delicate stone formations, the fact that they can grow in such hostile conditions astounds me. I'll have these sent to Avrilla for analysis right away.
text.completed: Report to Choluna at the north end of The Furnace in the Molten Front.

english.title: Fire Flowers
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Luciferns.
english.description: My fellow druid, Choluna, has asked us to collect any specimens of plant life that we might find here in the Firelands...$b$b...I don't know whose idea it was to bring scholars to a warfront.$b$bNevertheless, you will already be in the cave - killing things - so be on the lookout for anything growing out of the ground.
english.progress: They could be growing anywhere. Keep your eyes open.
english.completion: These things never cease to amaze me. Whether they're actual plants, or just delicate stone formations, the fact that they can grow in such hostile conditions astounds me. I'll have these sent to Avrilla for analysis right away.
english.completed: Report to Choluna at the north end of The Furnace in the Molten Front.

text.title: 善心之举
text.description: 这样多的暴力，这样多的死亡。兄弟们死去了，母亲死去了。而现在，如果没有人照顾这只豹崽，它同样会死去。$B$B你能不能暂停一下暴力的行为，来照顾一下豹子的幼崽？

english.title: Some Good Will Come
english.description: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a pause from the violence to help care for a panther cub?

text.title: 善心之举
text.objectives: Care for the panther cub, after all, you did kill it's mother.
text.description: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?
text.completion: The panther cub looks at you with a look in its eyes that says, "Will you be my new $g dad:mom;?"

text.title: 化为一体
text.objectives: 跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈，同意他的请求。
text.description: 我受命保护她，可到头来她还是为了我牺牲了自己。$B$B我无法忍受失去她的痛苦，$N。我要交给你一件庄重的任务。$B$B从来没有一名凡人能够承载纯粹的龙族精华，但只要你允许，我会破这个例。$B$B趁她尚有余息，请问你，你是否愿意让我把泰蕾苟萨同你结合在一起？
text.completion: I am grateful, $N.$B$BWere you not present, or had you refused, Tarecgosa would be lost to me.
text.end: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

english.title: At One
english.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos to agree to his proposition.
english.description: I was charged with her protection, yet it was she who sacrificed herself for my sake.$b$bI cannot bear to lose her, $n. I must make a solemn request of you.$b$bNever has a mortal borne the essence of a true dragon, but with your permission I would make an exception.$b$bPlease, while there is life in her, will you allow me to bind Tarecgosa to you?
english.completion: I am grateful, $N.$B$BWere you not present, or had you refused, Tarecgosa would be lost to me.
english.end: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

text.title: 光阴苦短
text.objectives: 从火焰之地收集1000份沸燃之烬。
text.description: 泰蕾苟萨已经和你融合在了一起，$N，但这只是暂时的。只有守护巨龙才有能力永久封住她的精魂。$B$B玛里苟斯的继任者要在艾泽拉斯的下一个月蚀之时才会被选出，而你们之间的联系无法持续那么久。$B$B幸运的是，有一个办法可以帮我们争取到必要的时间。强大的元素存在可以延长仪式的效果。其中一些在火元素位面就能找到，相信你已经很熟悉了。$B$B拿到它们，$C，让泰蕾苟萨撑到月蚀之时。
text.completed: Speak with Kalecgos in Coldarra

english.title: Time Grows Short
english.objectives: Collect 1000 Seething Cinders from the Firelands.
english.description: Tarecgosa is bound to you, $n, but only temporarily. An aspect's power is required to permanently seal her essence.$b$bMalygos's successor will not be chosen until Azeroth's moons next eclipse, and the bond you share will not last until then.$b$bFortunately, there is a way to buy us the time we need. Powerful elements exist that can extend the ritual's effects. Some of these can be found in the Plane of Fire, with which you've become familiar.$b$bObtain them, $c, and sustain Tarecgosa until the eclipse.
english.completed: Speak with Kalecgos in Coldarra

text.title: Bound for Warmer Weather
text.objectives: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
text.description: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

english.title: Bound for Warmer Weather
english.objectives: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
english.description: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

text.title: 真的……需要……水……
text.objectives: 把安伦·觅影者带到熔火前线的入口处去。
text.description: 真的……需要……水……
text.completion: You! You're the one who saved Anren. My best friend, Anren.$b$bWe got separated in that cave. I didn't know what to do without Anren.$b$bYou are a resourceful $c. We may call upon you later to assist us in our reconnaissance missions. With your help, Anren and I might no longer face the terrifying risk of being separated from one another.
text.completed: Speak with Tholo Whitehoof at the Furnace in the Molten Front.
text.objective1: Escort Anren to the front of the cave

english.title: Need... Water... Badly...
english.objectives: Bring Anren Shadowseeker to the entrance of the Molten Front.
english.description: Need... water... badly...
english.completion: You! You're the one who saved Anren. My best friend, Anren.$b$bWe got separated in that cave. I didn't know what to do without Anren.$b$bYou are a resourceful $c. We may call upon you later to assist us in our reconnaissance missions. With your help, Anren and I might no longer face the terrifying risk of being separated from one another.
english.completed: Speak with Tholo Whitehoof at the Furnace in the Molten Front.
english.objective1: Escort Anren to the front of the cave

text.title: How Hot
text.objectives: Use Tholo's Thermometer to measure the temperature of the three large lava pools on Fireplume Peak.
text.description: The fire hawks of Fireplume Peak can withstand incredible temperatures. While you'll often find them circling the skies above, they're also known to swim in molten lava.$b$bIsn't that right, Anren?$b$bWe'd like to know just how hot that lava can get. Fireplume Peak has three large lava pools. Use this to measure the temperature of each.
text.completion: These results will go a long way to help us understand the fire hawks, and - more importantly - Alysrazor, their new, fiery queen.$B$BTholo and I are thankful that you've been helping us out.
text.completed: Return to Anren Shadowseeker at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 沙恩诺克斯的猎狗
text.objectives: 收集6份猎狗骨灰。
text.description: 在火焰之地最大的一座岛屿上，我们的部队在面对火妖猎手沙恩诺克斯时遇到了麻烦。他不仅是个神射手，而且还豢养着训练有素的猎狗，让我们的部队吃尽了苦头。$B$B聪明绝顶的索罗认为我们最好研究一下这些猎狗的生物学现象。而我呢，当然，和索罗意见一致。$B$B你可以在熔炉下的熔火激流里找到不少猎狗。我们需要它们的灰烬来进行研究，
text.progress: Any information we can get will be instrumental in helping our men defeat Shannox.
text.completion: This ash may seem indistinguishable from any other type of ash you find on this forsaken island, but trust me... you have found the right stuff.$B$BWe will have it analyzed immediately.$B$BReturn again soon. While I do enjoy spending time with Anren, we also appreciate your company, $N.
text.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: Hounds of Shannox
english.objectives: Obtain 6 small piles of Houndbone Ash.
english.description: On the Firelands' largest island, our troops have been having trouble against Shannox, the flamewaker hunter. Not only does he have impeccable aim, but he keeps trained hounds that give our troops no end of trouble.$b$bTholo, in all his wisdom, thinks it would be a good idea to study the biology of these hounds. I, of course, agree with Tholo.$b$bYou will find several hounds in the Molten Flow, beneath the Furnace. We will need their ashes to study.
english.progress: Any information we can get will be instrumental in helping our men defeat Shannox.
english.completion: This ash may seem indistinguishable from any other type of ash you find on this forsaken island, but trust me... you have found the right stuff.$B$BWe will have it analyzed immediately.$B$BReturn again soon. While I do enjoy spending time with Anren, we also appreciate your company, $N.
english.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: Fandral's Methods
text.objectives: Obtain a Flame Druid Staff, a Flame Druid Spellbook, a Flame Druid Reagent Pouch, and a Flame Druid Idol.
text.description: The Druids of the Flame... an order of druids that, up until a few weeks ago, Tholo and I had never even heard of. Now, under the leadership of Fandral Staghelm, they threaten our mission's success with their mastery of fire.$b$bIt would appear that they store some supplies in the Igneous Depths, to the northeast. Perhaps, if we can get some of those supplies, we will have more luck when we take the fight to Fandral.
text.progress: Trust me - whatever information we can gather here will go far to helping us understand the source of Fandral's powers.
text.completion: Anren, look what $N found! This is exactly what we needed!$B$BIt will take us some time to look through these supplies. For now, you have our thanks.
text.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: The Flame Spider Queen
text.objectives: Obtain 8 samples of Flame Venom and 8 samples of Searing Web Fluid.
text.description: The Widow's Clutch, to the northeast, is named after Beth'tilac, the enormous queen of the flame spiders. Her webs and her poison are a nagging threat to our main offensive force.$b$bWe believe that if we study the flame spiders here on the Molten Front, we can use that information to find success against Beth'tilac. Use whatever methods you can to gather their venom and their web fluid, then return to my trusted friend Anren.
text.progress: Be careful with those fluids, $N. We don't want them spilling anywhere.
text.completion: You are an asset to our cause, $N. Tholo and I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Anren Shadowseeker at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.objectives: Obtain 8 samples of Flame Venom and 8 samples of Searing Web Fluid.

english.completed: Return to Anren Shadowseeker at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: Living Obsidium
text.objectives: Retrieve 10 Obsidium Meteorites.
text.description: Have you seen those fireballs falling out of the sky? I saw one crash in the fields to the north, and the rock that landed was made of pure Living Obsidium!$B$BI can use the material to craft ultra-sturdy heat proof armor and weapons for our troops. Can you bring me a lode?$B$BGo to the Magma Springs and touch one of the magnetic stones. Just watch where you're standing when the rain of fire hits, and gather up the rocks before they crumble from the impact.
text.progress: How's it going? Found any meteorites yet?
text.completion: Fantastic! Now ah kin get ta work.
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: 注满月井
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 我们造了一口月井，但是在我们用永恒之井的圣水注满它之前，这口井的功能很有限。$B$B只要有了功能齐备的月井，我们就能祝福储备的食物，还可以利用月井的祝福来帮你防护火焰的侵袭。$B$B等你获得了足够多的印记，就去跟玛洛恩庇护所的麦托克劳谈一谈。她会安排你护送圣水的。
text.progress: How can I be of aid, $N?
text.completion: Of course. I will see to it that the sacred waters are transported through the portal right away.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: Secure sacred water for the moonwell from Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Filling the Moonwell
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: We've constructed this moonwell, but it serves little purpose until it is filled with the sacred waters of the Well of Eternity.$B$BWith an active moonwell, we would be able to bless our food stores, and we may also be able to use the blessing to offer you some protection from fire as well.$B$BWhen you've obtained enough marks, speak to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. She'll be able to secure transport of the sacred waters.
english.progress: How can I be of aid, $N?
english.completion: Of course. I will see to it that the sacred waters are transported through the portal right away.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Secure sacred water for the moonwell from Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Nourishing Waters
text.objectives: Speak to Ayla Shadowstorm at Malfurion's Breach.
text.description: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.
text.completion: You will pleased to know that the waters arrived safely. With the moonwell filled, and the shade of the Sentinel Tree upon us, I can almost forget we're in the Firelands for moments at a time.$B$BI've spread the moonwell's blessing upon these trees and bushes. Take the fruit with you before you venture out. It is more refreshing than you can possibly imagine.

text.title: 追加军火
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 那些德鲁伊没有合用的家伙来应付这里的问题。我有个哥们就在玛洛恩那头老鹿的圣殿里，穿过传送门就是。只要让我们凑到一块儿，就一定能搞出点真家伙来对付拉格纳罗斯那老小子和他的爪牙。$B$B去弄点他们那种什么印记，然后去找麦托克劳。问问她莉吉特在哪里。我们需要她来协助我们搞点大乱子。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: I was wondering if those two would come in handy. They've seemed quite out of place ever since they arrived.$B$BI saw Ricket around here just a moment ago. I'll gladly send her back through the portal with you. She's less likely to be blowing up any local plant life on that side of things anyway.$B$BLet's see... where is she...
text.completed: Seek out Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Additional Armaments
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: These druids be lackin' the tools ta properly handle the job out 'ere. I got meself a buddy back at day ol' stag shrine through the portal though. If we were ta be gettin' reunited, we'd sure have some real toys ta use against ol' Ragboy and 'is cronies.$B$BTake some of dem mark things an' go find Matoclaw. Ask her fer Ricket. We need'r here so we can be causin' some real trouble.
english.progress: Yes, $N?
english.completion: I was wondering if those two would come in handy. They've seemed quite out of place ever since they arrived.$B$BI saw Ricket around here just a moment ago. I'll gladly send her back through the portal with you. She's less likely to be blowing up any local plant life on that side of things anyway.$B$BLet's see... where is she...
english.completed: Seek out Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 全副武装
text.objectives: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的莉吉特谈一谈。
text.description: 按照你的要求，莉吉特应该已经和达默克在玛法里奥突破口待命了。但我不知道你是否真的明白和这两个家伙共事意味着什么。$B$B说到这里，你应该赶紧去看看……别让他们把哨卫之树给炸了。你只要吩咐他们专心与元素周旋，那么突破口这里发生“事故”的概率就会大大降低。
text.completion: Hey you! Good to see you again!$B$BI'm settled in good and fine, actually! It's good to be with good old Damek again. I never thought I'd be mixing with a dwarf so well, but he and I, we've got like minds on all the important stuff.$B$BYou go do your thing. Don't be worrying about us. If we cook up any good toys for you, we'll be sure to let ya know!

english.title: Well Armed
english.objectives: Speak to Ricket at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: Ricket should be at Malfurion's Breach with Damek, as you requested. I'm not sure you fully know what you're getting into with those two though.$B$BSpeaking of which, you should probably go check on them... make sure they haven't managed to blow up the Sentinel Tree itself. As long as you keep them busy with the elementals, the chances of "accidents" at the breach should lessen dramatically.
english.completion: Hey you! Good to see you again!$B$BI'm settled in good and fine, actually! It's good to be with good old Damek again. I never thought I'd be mixing with a dwarf so well, but he and I, we've got like minds on all the important stuff.$B$BYou go do your thing. Don't be worrying about us. If we cook up any good toys for you, we'll be sure to let ya know!

text.title: 呼唤古树
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 古树们都在海加尔山待命。考虑到他们的……身体构造，火焰之地对他们来说实在太过危险，不过为了战胜拉格纳罗斯的副手，他们的力量必不可少。$B$B去收集点印记，并且去找玛洛恩庇护所的老树干。如果古树要加入我们，那么只有他才能带领他们穿过传送门。
text.progress: Greetings to you, young one.
text.completion: I understand. We are prepared. We shall join the march and meet you on the far side of the portal.
text.completed: Secure the aid of the Ancients from Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Calling the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: The ancients await in Hyjal. The Firelands will prove a dangerous place for them considering their... composition, but their strength will be of great use to us if we are to face any of Ragnaros' lieutenants.$B$BGather your marks, and seek out Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If they are to march with us, he would be the one leading them through the portal.
english.progress: Greetings to you, young one.
english.completion: I understand. We are prepared. We shall join the march and meet you on the far side of the portal.
english.completed: Secure the aid of the Ancients from Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Aid of the Ancients
text.objectives: Speak to Elderlimb at Malfurion's Breach.
text.description: The ancients have seen the value of your wisdom, and have set root at Malfurion's Breach. You should seek out Elderlimb. I am certain he would like to hear from you.
text.completion: You chose a wise time to call upon us, $C. I was concerned for our ability to stand against the elements in this realm, but the protection of the Sentinel Tree has proven far more than sufficient shelter.$B$BWe will do anything we can to aid your efforts here. Witherbranch has met with your other allies and is discussing a way to corner some of Ragnaros' lieutenants. You should speak with them when the time comes.

text.title: 结盟
text.objectives: 陪伴卡雷苟斯前往蓝龙议会。$B$B准备好了就去考达拉跟他谈谈。
text.description: 选举即将开始，$N。$B$B尽管议会只允许蓝龙军团的成员参加，但是与泰蕾苟萨融合之后，你也必须参加这次选举了。$B$B我要你以她的形态，代表她进行投票。$B$B速速动身。月蚀之时就要到来了……
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

english.title: Alignment
english.objectives: Accompany Kalecgos to the blue dragon council.$b$bSpeak to Kalecgos in Coldarra when ready.
english.description: The time of choosing has arrived, $n.$b$bWhile only members of the blue dragonflight may attend, Tarecgosa's binding makes your presence requisite.$b$bI must ask that you take on her form and vote on her behalf.$b$bDo not tarry. The moment of the eclipse draws near....
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

text.title: 事起山峰
text.objectives: 从火羽峰顶获得一颗火鹰蛋。
text.description: 这些火鹰都是火焰生物，但它们的习性和我们老家的鸟类没什么两样。因此我在想，它们到底源自何处。$B$B话说回来——我觉得咱们应该能驯服它们。把它们驯化，用它们的力量来对付敌人。$B$B我要你去火羽峰顶弄一颗火鹰蛋回来。如果你能将其安全带回来的话，剩下来的事情可以交给我。
text.progress: Were you able to recover an egg?
text.completion: This will do perfectly! Come see me again in a day or two and we'll see how things have progressed.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Peaked Interest
english.objectives: Retrieve a Fire Hawk Egg from the top of Fireplume Peak.
english.description: These fire hawks are beings of fire, but they exhibit much of the same behavior that we've seen in birds back home. It makes me wonder from where they originate.$B$BBack to the point - I think we might be able to train them. Domesticate them if you will. Use them against our enemies.$B$BI'd like you to retrieve one of their eggs from the top of Fireplume Peak. If you can bring it back to me safely, I will see to the rest.
english.progress: Were you able to recover an egg?
english.completion: This will do perfectly! Come see me again in a day or two and we'll see how things have progressed.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Starting Young
text.objectives: Recover 5 Fire Hawk Hatchlings.
text.description: Our scouts are bringing back reports of fire hawk hatchlings all over the peak... their eggs must have hatched very recently. Better yet, it seems that they're extremely docile.$B$BI know it may sound a strange and perhaps unsavory request, but if you were able to bring some of those hatchlings back to me, I might be able to train them to aid us in our war efforts.$B$BAre you willing?
text.progress: I can't make up my mind on how to regard these creatures. They act like much like other avians, but they are very obviously native to this fiery place.$B$BI wonder why Ragnaros and his minions have not made attempts to rally them against us...
text.completion: They look to have singed your gloves a bit, but I don't see any damage otherwise. Well done, $C.$B$BCome by again within the next few days to see how the training has gone.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.progress: I can't make up my mind on how to regard these creatures. They act like much like other avians, but they are very obviously native to this fiery place.$B$BI wonder why Ragnaros and his minions have not made attempts to rally them against us...
english.completion: They look to have singed your gloves a bit, but I don't see any damage otherwise. Well done, $C.$B$BCome by again within the next few days to see how the training has gone.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Mother's Malice
text.objectives: Defeat the Fire Hawk Matriarch.
text.description: Unsurprisingly, their matriarch has taken offense to us taking her young to train for our own uses. It's understandable... and a bit tragic actually. We are very much the villains in this exchange.$B$BNow is not the time for such thoughts. These creatures are beings of fire, and on more than one occasion, they've claimed the lives of our kin. With their matriarch angered, the danger has grown immensely.$B$BI need someone to quiet her rage, and I fear you may be the most capable.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 天空中的火焰
text.objectives: 利用驯服的火鹰消灭聚集在火焰之地的100只火妖、40只烬网蜘蛛，以及3名熔火领主。
text.description: 瞧啊！真是不可思议！它两天前才刚孵出来，如今已经完全长大了。遗憾的是，我怀疑它们的生命周期恐怕也同样短暂，因此我们必须抓紧一切可以利用的时间。$B$B他的训练十分顺利。我要你把它带出去，将它放到拉格纳罗斯要塞附近的敌军中去。$B$B不要对敌人手软，$R。
text.completion: I take it your assault was a success! Brilliant. This could be a key moment in opening up Ragnaros' defenses.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Fire in the Skies
english.objectives: Use the Trained Fire Hawk to kill 100 of the Flamewaker Salamanders, 40 of the Cinderweb Spiders, and 3 of the Molten Lords that are amassing in the Firelands.
english.description: Look at that! It's incredible! Born less than two days ago and already full grown. Sadly, I suspect their life cycle is similarly short, so we'll have to take advantage of any time we have.$B$BHis training went remarkably well. I want you to be the one to take him out and unleash him on the bulk of the enemy forces gathered near Ragnaros' keep.$B$BShow no mercy, $r.
english.completion: I take it your assault was a success! Brilliant. This could be a key moment in opening up Ragnaros' defenses.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Straight Chuting
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Straight Chuting
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Hawk Fire
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Hawk Fire
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Singed Wings
text.objectives: Rescue 5 Injured Druids of the Talon on Fireplume Peak.
text.description: Many of our Storm Crows have gone ahead to scout the peak and attempt to retrieve some of the fire hawk eggs, but to very little success I'm afraid. The thermals make it nearly impossible to fly safely, and the fire hawks aren't exactly friendly either.$B$BI need you to head over there and rescue any druids that you can. I've got splints, bandages, burn salves, smelling salts... anything you'll need to get them back on their feet, assuming they're still alive. Please hurry and help anyone you can find.
text.completion: Several of our brothers and sisters passed by while returning to the safety of the Sentinel Tree. You did very well out there, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.completion: Several of our brothers and sisters passed by while returning to the safety of the Sentinel Tree. You did very well out there, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Animate Embers
text.objectives: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.
text.description: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 它们越大
text.objectives: 从火羽峰的黑曜石惩罚者那里获得10份活体黑曜石。
text.description: You're not going to take on fiery behemoths wearing THAT, are you? If you aren't wearing my obsidium crafted goods, you're going to burn right up! And even if you are, you can never have enough of the good stuff.$B$BLook $Gbrother:sister;, I can craft you the best armor that gold can buy, but I need pure, unsmelted Living Obsidium first.$B$BThe Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak are literally made of the stuff. Go kill them and gather their pieces.
text.progress: Did you bring me the goods?
text.completion: This'll do. Nice work, $N.
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: The Bigger They Are
english.objectives: Collect 10 Living Obsidium from the Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak.
english.description: You're not going to take on fiery behemoths wearing THAT, are you? If you aren't wearing my obsidium crafted goods, you're going to burn right up! And even if you are, you can never have enough of the good stuff.$B$BLook $Gbrother:sister;, I can craft you the best armor that gold can buy, but I need pure, unsmelted Living Obsidium first.$B$BThe Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak are literally made of the stuff. Go kill them and gather their pieces.
english.progress: Did you bring me the goods?
english.completion: This'll do. Nice work, $N.
english.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 鸟儿的领地意识
text.objectives: 杀死5只火鹰。
text.description: 我们的久居不去让火鹰十分不安。它们变得极具攻击性，且已经远远超出了保护领地的需要。我担心继续置之不理的话，它们不久就会对我们的大树展开进攻，我也不知道我们是否能够应付它们。$B$B我要你到火羽峰去，尽可能地压制住它们。如今我们的安全远比它们的重要，所以别拖泥带水的。
text.completion: Well done, $n. It's good to know I can count on you.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Territorial Birds
english.objectives: Slay 5 Fire Hawks.
english.description: The fire hawks are upset by our continued presence. They're getting extremely hostile, and not just in the usual territorial ways. I worry that if we leave them unchecked, they will soon be joining the assault on our tree, and I'm not sure we're capable of handling that.$B$BGo across the way to Fireplume Peak and do what you have to to keep them in check. I'm far more concerned with our safety right now than theirs, so be decisive about it.
english.completion: Well done, $n. It's good to know I can count on you.
english.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Bye Bye Burdy
text.objectives: Kill 3 Druids of the Flame, while in Fire Crow form, with the Burd Sticker.
text.description: Staghelm's druids are putting up a fierce fight at Wildflame Point to the northeast.$B$BThe druids fly above us in fire crow form, then strike when we least expect it. Worst part is, they know exactly how to stay out of our reach!$B$BWe would be totally helpless, except Damek lent me his trusty harpoon. He says these weapons will fly straight and true even in this super dense air.$B$BTake the dwarf's weapon and shoot some birds out of the sky!
text.completion: Those blasted burds are dead? Good riddance!
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.
text.objective1: Druids of the Flame in Fire Crow form slain

text.title: 一条烟熏过的坠饰
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰交给月光林地，永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳。
text.description: 这条坠饰的表面上刻着小小的叶子形的花样，不过其他的细节都被时光侵蚀了，要么就是在火焰中遭到了损毁。它看上去似乎出自德鲁伊的手笔。$B$B大部分德鲁伊在试炼时都会经过月光林地。如果说有什么人能帮你查清这条坠饰的来历，那么就只有永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳了。
text.progress: Yes, young $R?
text.completion: What have we here? A necklace? No, a locket...$B$BOh, my...
text.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: A Smoke-Stained Locket
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
english.description: This locket has a few small leaf-shaped carvings etched into its face, but any other details have been rubbed away with time, or burned away with fire. It appears to be druidic in nature.$b$bMost druids pass through Moonglade during their training. If anybody can help you decipher where this locket came from, it would be Rabine Saturna of Nighthaven.
english.progress: Yes, young $R?
english.completion: What have we here? A necklace? No, a locket...$B$BOh, my...
english.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 热情如火
text.objectives: 观察火红鞭笞者汲取6个灰烬之池。熔焰蝎虫只有在战斗中才会喷出灰烬之池。
text.description: 我的研究有进展了，$N。根据我们对当地植被系统的观察，你的鞭笞者很可能也可以吸收高温液体作为养分。$B$B我想让你帮我做一个小实验。居住在北边熔岩之泉的熔焰蝎虫会在战斗中喷出燃烧的火焰团。$B$B把鞭笞者带上，看看它对那些蝎子的灰烬之池有什么反应。
text.completion: Did it work? So my theory was correct?
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
text.objective1: Help the Crimson Lasher Drink from Ember Pools

english.title: Some Like It Hot
english.objectives: Observe the Crimson Lasher drinking from 6 Ember Pools. Ember Pools are created by fighting Emberspit Scorpions.
english.description: I've been making progress in my research, $N. Based on what we've witnessed in the local flora, it's quite possible that your Lasher also accepts superheated liquids as a principal source of nutrition.$B$BI'd like you to help me with a little experiment. The Emberspit Scorpions that inhabit the Magma Springs to the north spew out burning pools of fire during combat.$B$BTake the Lasher and observe his reaction to the scorpions' Ember Pools.
english.completion: Did it work? So my theory was correct?
english.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
english.objective1: Help the Crimson Lasher Drink from Ember Pools

text.title: 解开其中的秘密
text.objectives: 观看烟熏过的坠饰中储存的记忆。
text.description: 坠饰上面的名字缩写已经模糊了，但我能感觉到一种力量，这说明坠饰的主人只可能是一个人：$B$B烈焰德鲁伊莱雅娜。$B$B退后，我们来看看这条坠饰里有些怎样的惊喜。
text.completion: If Leyara bore witness to the War of the Shifting Sands, then it seems likely she knew Fandral - and his late son, Valstann - far more closely than any of us suspected.$B$BIt would seem that your journey does not end here, $N.
text.completed: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: Unlocking the Secrets Within
english.objectives: Witness the memories stored within the Smoke-Stained Locket.
english.description: The initials seem to have worn off of this locket, but I can sense a power within it that suggests only one possible owner:$b$bLeyara, the Druid of the Flame.$b$bStand back, and we shall see what surprises this locket contains.
english.completion: If Leyara bore witness to the War of the Shifting Sands, then it seems likely she knew Fandral - and his late son, Valstann - far more closely than any of us suspected.$B$BIt would seem that your journey does not end here, $N.
english.completed: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 悲剧与家庭
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰带到灰谷的阿斯特兰纳附近的暗夜精灵坟地去。
text.description: 你将坠饰交给我十分明智，$N。很少有人知道瓦斯坦恩遗体所在，而我恰巧是其中之一。$B$B你可以在灰谷的阿斯特兰纳东南边的一个小坟场里找到他的遗冢。把这条坠饰带去，它或许会解开更多的回忆。$B$B再会了，$N，愿你旅途好运。
text.completion: If the vision is to be believed, Leyara's ties to the Staghelm family were quite strong. It's no wonder that she clung so fiercely to Fandral's new order of flame.

english.title: Tragedy and Family
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Night Elf Grave near Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: You were insightful to bring this locket to me, $N. I am among the few who know where Valstann's body lays.$b$bYou can find his resting site in a small graveyard, southeast of Astranaar, in Ashenvale. Bring this locket to the site, and it may unlock more memories.$b$bFarewell, $N, and good luck on your journey.
english.completion: If the vision is to be believed, Leyara's ties to the Staghelm family were quite strong. It's no wonder that she clung so fiercely to Fandral's new order of flame.

text.title: The Dogs of War
text.objectives: Kill 5 Charhounds or Ancient Charhounds.
text.description: Our forces are falling beneath an unleashed monstrosity - Charhounds from the molten depths.$B$BThese dogs fear nothing and will not stop until their lust for blood is satisfied. Our forces are barely holding them back.$B$BGo join the defenders in the Ashen Fields or in the Molten Flow. Perhaps you can make a dent in their numbers.
text.completion: Good, $C. The enemy may be tough, but you have proven today that you are tougher.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: The Dogs of War
english.objectives: Kill 5 Charhounds or Ancient Charhounds.
english.description: Our forces are falling beneath an unleashed monstrosity - Charhounds from the molten depths.$B$BThese dogs fear nothing and will not stop until their lust for blood is satisfied. Our forces are barely holding them back.$B$BGo join the defenders in the Ashen Fields or in the Molten Flow. Perhaps you can make a dent in their numbers.
english.completion: Good, $C. The enemy may be tough, but you have proven today that you are tougher.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: Strike at the Heart
text.objectives: Kill the Lieutenant of Flame.
text.description: One of Ragnaros' Lieutenants has shown himself at Ragnaros' Reach, the walled area to our northeast.$B$BI hoped to send you as soon as you returned, but I suspect Witherbranch and some of our forces have already joined the fight by now. You should hurry.$B$BYou should be able to drop down the cliff wall right here and reach them quickly.
text.completion: Very well done, $N! This should delay them significantly.$B$BIf we keep this up, we can easily push the fight back to Ragnaros himself.
text.completed: Return to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 烈焰之心
text.objectives: 用250份阴燃精华为诺达希尔符文法杖充能，并获得烈焰之心。
text.description: 你是第一个亲眼看到巨龙议会的凡人，$N，也是整个艾泽拉斯唯一能够参与守护巨龙选举的生物。$B$B我晋升之后，获得了不可思议的力量。我已经擅自强化了你与泰蕾苟萨之间的融合，尽管她需要的是一个更加……稳定的家。$B$B我要你再闯一次火元素位面，给我带来拉格纳罗斯的心脏。$B$B当我们下次再会时，我会好好褒奖你所做的一切。
text.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
text.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$B$B$BNow prepare to receive a hero's reward.
text.completed: Speak to Hallegosa  in Stormwind.

english.title: Heart of Flame
english.objectives: Empower the Runestaff of Nordrassil with 250 Smouldering Essences and obtain the Heart of Flame.
english.description: You are the first mortal to witness a dragon council, $n, and among the only beings in Azeroth to take part in the choosing of an Aspect.$b$bMy ascension has endowed me with incredible power. I have taken the liberty to strengthen Tarecgosa's bond with you, though she will require a more... permanent home.$b$bI would have you venture one last time into the Plane of Fire and bring me the heart of Ragnaros.$b$bWhen next we meet, I will be able to suitably thank you for all that you have done.
english.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
english.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$B$B$BNow prepare to receive a hero's reward.
english.completed: Speak to Hallegosa  in Stormwind.

text.objectives: 用250份阴燃精华为诺达希尔符文法杖充能，并获得烈焰之心。

text.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$B$B$BNow prepare to receive a hero's reward.
text.completed: Speak to Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

english.objectives: Empower the Runestaff of Nordrassil with 250 Soul Flame Essences and obtain the Heart of Flame.

I have taken the liberty to strengthen Tarecgosa's bond with you, though she will require a more... permanent home.$b$bI would have you venture one last time into the Plane of Fire and bring me the heart of Ragnaros.$b$bWhen next we meet, I will be able to suitably thank you for all that you have done.

english.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$B$B$BNow prepare to receive a hero's reward.
english.completed: Speak to Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 出神入化
text.objectives: 跟赫雷苟萨谈一谈。
text.description: 能同你结识真是不胜荣幸，$R。$B$B你的名声响彻艾泽拉斯，妇孺皆知。$B$B我将在卡雷苟斯到达时，向他献上拉格纳罗斯的心脏。它的力量将被用来进一步地强化你的武器。$B$B典礼马上就要开始了。我被指派来当你的护卫，等你准备好了，咱们就出发。
text.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
text.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Stuff of Legends
english.objectives: Speak to Hallegosa.
english.description: It is an honor to make your acquaintance, $r.$b$bYour deeds echo in the ears of Azeroth's creatures, mortal and immortal alike.$b$bI shall present the heart of Ragnaros to Kalecgos when he arrives. Its power is to be harnessed to further endow your weapon.$b$bThe ceremony is to begin shortly. I have been appointed to escort you there when you are ready.
english.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
english.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

enders.name: 巨龙之怒，泰蕾苟萨的寄魂杖

text.title: 临界点
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰带到海加尔山，莱雅娜的哀伤那里的小墓碑前去。
text.description: 莱雅娜袭击哈缪尔的那天，她就在复苏之地西北边海加尔山附近的遗迹里等待。那时她行为十分异常：冷静、沉默，眼睛盯着远处看。也许那个地方对她来说意义非凡。$B$B如果把坠饰带到那里去，它或许会有所反应。
text.completion: First Valstann, now this...

english.title: The Tipping Point
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Small Gravestone at Leyara's Sorrow in Hyjal.
english.description: On the day when Leyara attacked Hamuul, she was waiting near some ruins in Hyjal, northwest of the Regrowth. She acted strangely at the time: calm, silent, and staring off into the distance. Perhaps that location is of some importance to her.$b$bThe locket might react if brought to that location.
english.completion: First Valstann, now this...

text.title: 皆不可考
text.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.
text.description: In her memories, Leyara spoke of Malfurion. The tragedies of her past - at least, in her opinion - are largely due to his actions.$b$bMalfurion must remember Leyara from before she became a druid of the flame. You resolve to bring the locket to him in the Firelands. Hopefully he can answer any remaining questions.
text.completion: Yes, I knew Leyara, and I was aware of her anger even before she joined the Druids of the Flame. She was a promising young druid, once. Unfortunately, the bonds of family are often stronger than the power of reason, and ultimately, she chose to follow Fandral down his treacherous path.$B$BYou should keep this locket, $N. May it remind you that each of us walks our own path through life... and that some paths are easier than others.
text.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.

english.title: The Rest is History
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.
english.description: In her memories, Leyara spoke of Malfurion. The tragedies of her past - at least, in her opinion - are largely due to his actions.$b$bMalfurion must remember Leyara from before she became a druid of the flame. You resolve to bring the locket to him in the Firelands. Hopefully he can answer any remaining questions.
