Unfortunately, the bonds of family are often stronger than the power of reason, and ultimately, she chose to follow Fandral down his treacherous path.$B$BYou should keep this locket, $N. May it remind you that each of us walks our own path through life... and that some paths are easier than others.
english.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.

text.title: 出神入化
text.objectives: 跟赫雷苟萨谈一谈。
text.description: 能同你结识真是不胜荣幸，$R。$B$B你的名声响彻艾泽拉斯，妇孺皆知。$B$B我将在卡雷苟斯到达时，向他献上拉格纳罗斯的心脏。它的力量将被用来进一步地强化你的武器。$B$B典礼马上就要开始了。我被指派来当你的护卫，等你准备好了，咱们就出发。
text.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
text.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Stormwind.

english.title: The Stuff of Legends
english.objectives: Speak to Hallegosa.
english.description: It is an honor to make your acquaintance, $r.$b$bYour deeds echo in the ears of Azeroth's creatures, mortal and immortal alike.$b$bI shall present the heart of Ragnaros to Kalecgos when he arrives. Its power is to be harnessed to further endow your weapon.$b$bThe ceremony is to begin shortly. I have been appointed to escort you there when you are ready.
english.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
english.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Stormwind.

enders.name: 巨龙之怒，泰蕾苟萨的寄魂杖

text.title: 完美泡菜的秘密
text.objectives: 在达纳苏斯找到8只埋藏的泡菜坛。
text.description: My family has been making the best kimchi in Darnassus for generations, $N. The secret is something simple, but it makes all the difference.$B$BWe bury the jars in the ground until it's ready to serve and my latest batch has just reached that point. You can find the jars buried in earthen mounds all over the city. Would you help me gather them while the contents are just right?
text.progress: Were you able to find the jars?
text.completion: Thank you, $N. There's no way I could've found them all in time and it would be a shame to miss out on so much good kimchi!
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: The Secret to Perfect Kimchi
english.objectives: Find 8 Buried Kimchi Jars in Darnassus.
english.description: My family has been making the best kimchi in Darnassus for generations, $N. The secret is something simple, but it makes all the difference.$B$BWe bury the jars in the ground until it's ready to serve and my latest batch has just reached that point. You can find the jars buried in earthen mounds all over the city. Would you help me gather them while the contents are just right?
english.progress: Were you able to find the jars?
english.completion: Thank you, $N. There's no way I could've found them all in time and it would be a shame to miss out on so much good kimchi!
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 纪念祖先
text.objectives: 收集受祝福的米糕，并送往月神殿。
text.description: 需要供养的并不仅仅是生者。我的职责之一就是准备用来供奉祖先的米糕。一般来说，只有我的资深学徒才能得到将这些糕点送往月神殿，在那里接受赐福，然后将它们敬献给祖先的荣誉。但今天，她出城去了。你愿意代替她完成这一使命吗？
text.progress: This is the shrine the trainer mentioned.
text.completion: <You lay out the rice cakes around the shrine, which begins to glow softly. A faint sense of approval washes over you.>
text.completed: Offer the Blessed Rice Cakes at the Shrine of the Ancestors in Darnassus.

english.title: Remembering the Ancestors
english.objectives: Collect the Blessed Rice Cakes from the Temple of the Moon.
english.description: The living are not the only ones who require sustenance. One of my duties is to prepare the rice cakes that are left for the ancestors. Normally, my senior apprentice has the honor of taking the cakes to the Temple of the Moon for blessing and then presenting them to the ancestors. Since she is out of the city today, would you mind performing the duty in her place?
english.progress: This is the shrine the trainer mentioned.
english.completion: <You lay out the rice cakes around the shrine, which begins to glow softly. A faint sense of approval washes over you.>
english.completed: Offer the Blessed Rice Cakes at the Shrine of the Ancestors in Darnassus.

text.title: 我们的蘑菇
text.objectives: 采集12个下水道伞菇。将这些蘑菇交给幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 一些厨师抱怨说，我们热爱的幽暗城里没有制做真正美味的优秀食材。$B$B他们全都是拖鼻涕的小白痴。这里有许多美味的食物！$B$B在幽暗城西北方的下水道里采集一些冒臭气的，黏滑的下水道伞菇，然后把它们交给我。
text.progress: Did you find enough Sewer Caps?
text.completion: These smell absolutely wretched. Perfect!
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Fungus Among Us
english.objectives: Obtain 12 Sewer Caps.  Deliver the fungus to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: Some chefs complain that our beloved Undercity doesn't boast the ingredients to create truly fine fare.$B$BSuch mewling little cretins. Delicious delights abound!$B$BGather some of the rank, slimy Sewer Caps growing in Undercity's northwest sewer line and return them to me.
english.progress: Did you find enough Sewer Caps?
english.completion: These smell absolutely wretched. Perfect!
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 回归基本
text.objectives: 帮助工匠区和贸易区的居民制做米粉。办法是捣击米筐中的东西。
text.description: 有一些东西是从家庭厨师到厨艺大师的每一个人都需要的。这座城市最重要的出产物之一就是米粉。大部分家庭都会长期储备至少一筐大米。工匠区和贸易区的居民也都一样。$B$B我经常会要求我的学生们去帮助居民将大米捣成米粉。因为这一工作永远都需要有人去做，而且又是一种很好的练习。为什么你不去试一试？
text.completion: It takes a lot of effort to ensure that there's enough flour for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $N.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Back to Basics
english.objectives: Help the inhabitants of the Craftsmen's Terrace and Tradesmen's Terrace make rice flour by pounding the contents of Rice Baskets.
english.description: There are certain things that everyone needs, from the basic household cook to the master chef. One of the city's most important staples is rice flour. Most families keep at least one basket of rice in their houses and the residents of the Craftsmen's Terrace and Tradesmen's Terrace are no different.$B$BI often ask my students to help with the task of pounding rice into flour since it's good practice and an endless task. Why don't you give it a try?
english.completion: It takes a lot of effort to ensure that there's enough flour for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $N.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 钓起零件
text.objectives: 阿曼德·克伦威尔想让你在幽暗城中为大药剂师法拉尼尔钓起炼金傀儡的零件。
text.description: 一个兽人卫兵和大药剂师法拉尼尔的炼金傀儡之间……出了……一点事故。$B$B很显然，那个库卡隆监督者把那个炼金傀儡大卸八块，并把某些零件踢进了粘液池。$B$B法拉尼尔的学徒们找了好几个小时，却怎么也找不到那东西。想不想把它钓出来？相信那个老家伙一定会感谢你的。
text.progress: You haven't by any chance come across a severed abomination head, have you...?
text.completion: Ah! THERE it is! How ever did you find it?$B$BWell, no matter. My apprentices weren't able to recover the head despite hours splashing about in the slime, though they DID recover this bag of shiny things... perhaps you've a use for what's inside?$B$BMy thanks.
text.completed: Return the severed head to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

english.title: Fish Head
english.objectives: Armand Cromwell wants you to fish up a Severed Abomination Head in Undercity for Master Apothecary Faranell.
english.description: There was an... incident... with an orc guard and one of Master Apothecary Faranell's abominations.$B$BApparently, the Kor'kron Overseer chopped its head clean off and kicked it into the slime.$B$BFaranell's apprentices searched for hours but they can't find the thing. Care to try fishing it up? I'm sure the old fellow'd be grateful.
english.progress: You haven't by any chance come across a severed abomination head, have you...?
english.completion: Ah! THERE it is! How ever did you find it?$B$BWell, no matter. My apprentices weren't able to recover the head despite hours splashing about in the slime, though they DID recover this bag of shiny things... perhaps you've a use for what's inside?$B$BMy thanks.
english.completed: Return the severed head to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

text.title: 为哨兵准备肋排
text.objectives: 在炉子或篝火附近使用生肋排，将它们烤熟，然后用它们喂饱5名达纳苏斯哨兵。
text.description: 我的责任之一就是为执勤的达纳苏斯哨兵提供伙食。这任务十分耗费时间，但我很乐于承担。这同样是你练习技巧的一个不错的途径。愿不愿意帮我准备今天的哨兵伙食？拿上这些肋排，在炉子或火堆旁边将它们烤熟，然后把它们送给城中各处的哨兵就行了。
text.completion: Feeding all those sentinels is much easier with your help. Nobody had to wait in line for their meal this time.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Ribs for the Sentinels
english.objectives: Use the Uncooked Ribs near a stove or campfire to cook them and then use them to feed 5 Darnassus Sentinels.
english.description: One of my responsibilities is to feed the sentinels of Darnassus while they're on duty. It's a time-consuming task, but one I'm happy to undertake. It's also a great way to practice your skills. Would you mind helping me with today's meal? Simply take these ribs, cook them near a stove or fire, and distribute them to sentinels throughout the city.
english.completion: Feeding all those sentinels is much easier with your help. Nobody had to wait in line for their meal this time.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 恐怖蝌蚪
text.objectives: Armand Cromwell in Undercity wants you to bring him 8 Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles.
text.description: Some of our apothecaries took to dumping their more volatile waste chemicals into Stillwater Pond and... well, let's just say that no one wants to know how big mutant flesh-eating toads can grow.$B$BWould you consider fishing up some Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles before it gets to that? Just don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
text.progress: Catch any mutant tadpoles? Don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
text.completion: Excellent work, $N. I'll see that these are, ah, disposed of immediately.$B$BAfter all, what would our fine apothecaries want with an army of monstrous, poison-spitting, flesh-eating super-toads?
text.completed: Return the tadpoles to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Tadpole Terror
english.objectives: Armand Cromwell in Undercity wants you to bring him 8 Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles.
english.description: Some of our apothecaries took to dumping their more volatile waste chemicals into Stillwater Pond and... well, let's just say that no one wants to know how big mutant flesh-eating toads can grow.$B$BWould you consider fishing up some Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles before it gets to that? Just don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
english.progress: Catch any mutant tadpoles? Don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
english.completion: Excellent work, $N. I'll see that these are, ah, disposed of immediately.$B$BAfter all, what would our fine apothecaries want with an army of monstrous, poison-spitting, flesh-eating super-toads?
english.completed: Return the tadpoles to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 喜欢梭子鱼？
text.objectives: 在洛丹伦废墟的庭院里挖出一条尸虫，将它作为诱饵，钓到一条食尸梭子鱼。食尸梭子鱼可以在幽暗城东北方的澈水湖中钓到。
text.description: 你在澈水湖钓过鱼，对不对？$B$B在那里钓鱼能得到的一种辉煌战果就是那湖中的大型食尸梭子鱼。不过，要钓到它们，就必须有一种非常特别的诱饵——尸虫。$B$B在上面庭院中的坟墓里找一找，你应该能找到一些。
text.progress: Catch that pike, yet?
text.completion: That's a fine, fat pike, $N.  Well done.
text.completed: Return the pike to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Like Pike?
english.objectives: Dig up a Corpse Worm in the Ruins of Lordaeron courtyard and use it as bait to catch a Corpse-Fed Pike.  Corpse-Fed Pike can be fished up in Brightwater Lake, northeast of Undercity.
english.description: You've fished in Brightwater Lake, yes?$B$BThe prize catch there is one of the lake's massive corpse-fed pikes. However, they only bite on a very specific type of bait... corpse worms.$B$BSearch the graves in the courtyard up top and you should find some.
english.progress: Catch that pike, yet?
english.completion: That's a fine, fat pike, $N.  Well done.
english.completed: Return the pike to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 快乐挖蚌人
text.objectives: 从鲁瑟兰村附近的海岸上收集10只泰达希尔蚌肉。
text.description: 我认识的所有人都喜欢蚌肉，只有我完全受不了它们！它们又腥又黏，而且要找到它们，就一定要在泥巴里挖坑。与其这样，我宁愿用钓竿和鱼饵渡过一天时间。$B$B不过，我还是想用一桶新鲜的蛤蜊给我的兄弟来一个惊喜。如果你愿意为我去收集那些蛤蜊，我会给你奖励的。$B$B通过传送门到鲁瑟兰村去，在那里的岸边浅滩上寻找蚌肉吧。
text.progress: Did you find enough clams?
text.completion: Yuck, they're so gross-looking, but they're my brother's favorite. Thanks for sparing me from that messy job!
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: Happy as a Clam Digger
english.objectives: Gather 10 Teldrassil Clams from the shores near Rut'theran Village.
english.description: It seems like everyone I know loves clams, but I can't stand them! They're smelly and slimy, and harvesting them means digging through mud. Give me a fishing pole and some bait any day.$B$BStill, I want to surprise my brother with a bucket of fresh clams. I'd reward you if you were willing to gather those clams for me.$B$BJust go through the portal to Rut'theran Village and look for the clams in the shallows near the shore.
english.progress: Did you find enough clams?
english.completion: Yuck, they're so gross-looking, but they're my brother's favorite. Thanks for sparing me from that messy job!
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 粘液时刻
text.objectives: Collect 10 Squirming Slime Molds. Deliver them to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.
text.description: It takes a special sort of fisherman to reap the bounty of Undercity's burbling slime troughs. Think you can handle gathering some of the squirming, sentient slime mold slithering about down there?$B$BYou can try to fish them up, but they're wily; you might be better off just diving into the ooze and grabbing them.$B$BRemember, they're only useful alive and intact... who'd want to eat a dead slime mold?! Disgusting.
text.progress: Difficult to catch, aren't they?
text.completion: These slimes look perfect.  I will send these along to Eunice for preparation, thank you.
text.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Time for Slime
english.objectives: Collect 10 Squirming Slime Molds. Deliver them to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.
english.description: It takes a special sort of fisherman to reap the bounty of Undercity's burbling slime troughs. Think you can handle gathering some of the squirming, sentient slime mold slithering about down there?$B$BYou can try to fish them up, but they're wily; you might be better off just diving into the ooze and grabbing them.$B$BRemember, they're only useful alive and intact... who'd want to eat a dead slime mold?! Disgusting.
english.progress: Difficult to catch, aren't they?
english.completion: These slimes look perfect.  I will send these along to Eunice for preparation, thank you.
english.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 囤积绷带
text.objectives: 在达纳苏斯钓到5条湖生白鲑。
text.description: 为了养活难民和那些家园生计都毁于一旦的人们，我们已经用光了绝大部分的食品储备。如果我们不补充食品，当下次风暴或者部落来袭的时候，我们就全都有危险了。$B$B也许你愿意帮助我们捉一些湖生白鲑来，补充我们的食品储备。你可以在达纳苏斯的任何地方捉到它们。把它们晒干之后，就能储存起来，以备不时之需了。
text.progress: If all of our fishermen pitch in, it won't take long to rebuild our supplies.
text.completion: These are beautiful! Thank you, $N. I'll set them out to dry.
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: Stocking Up
english.objectives: Catch 5 Lake Whitefish by fishing in Darnassus.
english.description: We've used up most of our food stores in taking care of refugees and feeding those whose homes and livelihoods were destroyed. If we don't replenish our stores, we'll all be in danger next time there's a bad storm or a Horde invasion.$B$BPerhaps you'd be willing to help me build up our stock of lake whitefish. You can catch it anywhere in Darnassus, and once it's dried, it'll keep until it's needed.
english.progress: If all of our fishermen pitch in, it won't take long to rebuild our supplies.
english.completion: These are beautiful! Thank you, $N. I'll set them out to dry.
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 姐妹的坠饰
text.objectives: 从一条巨鲶鱼的肚子里找到艾奎恩妮的月亮坠饰。你可以在达纳苏斯一切能钓鱼的地方钓到它们。
text.description: Have you met Sister Aquinne? She and I grew up together in Dolanaar, and she recently came to the city to study at the Temple of the Moon. We decided to go for a boat ride, but the clumsy oarsman managed to capsize the craft!$B$BWhen we got back to the shore, Aquinne's moon pendant was missing. The lakes in Darnassus are full of giant catfish who will gobble up anything shiny!$B$BI've been catching them nonstop, hoping to find the one with her pendant. I don't suppose you want to help?
text.progress: Have you had any luck finding Aquinne's missing pendant? I must've caught fifty of those monsters and I have nothing to show for it!
text.completion: <Astaia takes the pendant from you.>$B$BUnderneath all the slime and tarnish, I think this is it! Aquinne will be so happy to have this back... after a thorough cleaning, of course. I can't thank you enough, $N.
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: The Sister's Pendant
english.objectives: Retrieve Aquinne's Moon Pendant from the belly of a Giant Catfish. You should be able to catch them anywhere you can fish in Darnassus.
english.description: Have you met Sister Aquinne? She and I grew up together in Dolanaar, and she recently came to the city to study at the Temple of the Moon. We decided to go for a boat ride, but the clumsy oarsman managed to capsize the craft!$B$BWhen we got back to the shore, Aquinne's moon pendant was missing. The lakes in Darnassus are full of giant catfish who will gobble up anything shiny!$B$BI've been catching them nonstop, hoping to find the one with her pendant. I don't suppose you want to help?
english.progress: Have you had any luck finding Aquinne's missing pendant? I must've caught fifty of those monsters and I have nothing to show for it!
english.completion: <Astaia takes the pendant from you.>$B$BUnderneath all the slime and tarnish, I think this is it! Aquinne will be so happy to have this back... after a thorough cleaning, of course. I can't thank you enough, $N.
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 滑溜溜的小吃
text.objectives: Gather 6 Baby Octopi from the shallow water near Rut'theran Village.
text.description: Have you ever eaten octopus meat? It takes some getting used to, but it's my favorite! I even know some people who like to eat the whole thing while it's alive!$B$BI don't plan on trying that anytime soon, but I am out of fresh octopi at the moment. Will you help me gather some more? They live in the shallow water off the shore near Rut'theran Village.
text.progress: It's impossible to catch octopi with a fishing line, so you're just going to have to grab them!
text.completion: These are going to be delicious, I can already tell! Thanks, $N!
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: A Slippery Snack
english.objectives: Gather 6 Baby Octopi from the shallow water near Rut'theran Village.
english.description: Have you ever eaten octopus meat? It takes some getting used to, but it's my favorite! I even know some people who like to eat the whole thing while it's alive!$B$BI don't plan on trying that anytime soon, but I am out of fresh octopi at the moment. Will you help me gather some more? They live in the shallow water off the shore near Rut'theran Village.
english.progress: It's impossible to catch octopi with a fishing line, so you're just going to have to grab them!
english.completion: These are going to be delicious, I can already tell! Thanks, $N!
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 诺达希尔之巅
text.objectives: 去海加尔山跟世界之树下的萨尔谈一谈，见证大地之环的仪式。
text.description: 你好，$C！我在大地之环的兄弟姐妹们对你在大灾变中的表现评价甚高。但想要治愈这个破碎的世界，我们还有好多事情要做。$B$B同我一起走走吧，朋友。我们正在准备一道仪式，希望能够借此扭转对暮光之锤的战局。$B$B当一切结束的时候，你将要把我们的捷报传向四方。
text.completion: It can't be over. We mustn't give up hope!
text.completed: Speak with Aggra under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: The Nordrassil Summit
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal and witness the Earthen Ring ceremony.
english.description: Hello, $c! My brothers and sisters of the Earthen Ring have spoken well of your deeds in the wake of the Cataclysm. But much remains to be done if we are to heal this broken world.$B$BWalk with me, friend. Preparations for a ceremony are underway, a ritual that I hope will be a turning point in our battle against the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BWhen all is done, you will be able to spread the word about our triumph here.
english.completion: It can't be over. We mustn't give up hope!
english.completed: Speak with Aggra under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 元素誓约：疑惑
text.objectives: 跟塞克隆纳斯交谈，去找萨尔。然后打败折磨他的风元素，将他救出来。
text.description: 我知道你要找的那个人……但是我不知道寻找他是否明智。他将自己投入了旋风之中。气流撕扯着他的身心，除了肉体和疑惑的碎片之外什么也不剩。$B$B去找他的话，你只能落得一样的下场。狂风会将万物切得体无完肤。$B$B我已经警告过你了。现在你打算怎么做？
text.completion: What is this... water?
text.completed: Speak with Aggra in Uldum.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Doubt
english.objectives: Speak with Cyclonas to secure passage to Thrall. Then, fight the wind elementals that torment him until he is freed.
english.description: I do know the one you seek... but I do not know if it is wise for you to follow him. He has cast himself into the cyclone. The winds now tear at his body and mind, leaving nothing but shreds of flesh and doubt.$b$bChasing after him would only expose you to the same fate. The wind's edge leaves nothing uncut.$b$bYou have been warned. Now what will you do?
english.completion: What is this... water?
english.completed: Speak with Aggra in Uldum.

text.title: 元素誓约：渴望
text.objectives: 击败深渊裂口附近的渴求之潮和渴求漩涡，把萨尔从它们的手里解救出来。
text.description: $C，我还是需要你的帮助，才能平息这场风暴。你得帮我将那些不稳定的元素击退。只有那样，我们才能救出古伊尔！
text.completion: Air, water... now earth?
text.completed: Return to Aggra at the edge of the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Desire
english.objectives: Slay the Tides of Longing and Vortexes of Longing near the Abyssal Breach until Thrall is free of their grasp.
english.description: Once again, $c, I cannot do this without your help. I will try to quiet this tempest, but you will need to fight back the unstable elementals that whirl around it. Only then can we free Go'el!
english.completion: Air, water... now earth?
english.completed: Return to Aggra at the edge of the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.

text.title: 元素誓约：耐心
text.objectives: 做好援助萨尔的准备后，就去和阿格娜谈一谈。然后打败关押他的耐心的石元素和耐心之石核。
text.description: 有了石母的祝福，我就能把咱们带往古伊尔被关押的所在。$B$B我们一定要小心。暮光之锤到处都有眼线。我会尝试找到古伊尔，而你则要帮我顶住他们的进攻！$B$B准备好了就跟我谈谈，我会把你带到他那儿去。
text.completion: <Aggra clenches her fists, and stares at the spot where Thrall stood moments ago.>
text.completed: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm.
text.objective1: Help Thrall break out of his stone prison

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Patience
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra when you are ready to help Thrall. Then defeat the Elements of Patience and Corestones of Patience that are holding him captive.
english.description: With the Stonemother's blessing, I can take us to where Go'el is being held.$b$bWe must be careful. The Twilight's Hammer has agents all around. You help me hold them off while I attempt to get through to Go'el!$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready, and I will take you to him.
english.completion: <Aggra clenches her fists, and stares at the spot where Thrall stood moments ago.>
english.completed: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm.
english.objective1: Help Thrall break out of his stone prison

text.title: 元素誓约：怒火
text.objectives: 去平台西边悬崖找到阿格娜的空气图腾，击败旁边的元素，直到图腾激活为止。然后接着去找阿格娜的水图腾、阿格娜的大地图腾，以及阿格娜的火焰图腾。
text.description: 那些图腾，$N！我们得激活它们，不然古伊尔就完了！$B$B去平台悬崖边上找到我的图腾，把边上的元素都消灭掉。一旦激活四座图腾，我们就能把古伊尔最后一部分的灵魂解放出来！
text.completion: Despite all odds, Thrall has been saved. Aggra was right to hold out hope for the world-shaman.
text.objective1: Activate Aggra's totems to save Thrall

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Fury
english.objectives: Kill fire elementals next to Aggra's Air Totem, on the western edge of the plateau, until it activates. Then continue to Aggra's Water Totem, Aggra's Earth Totem, and Aggra's Fire Totem.
english.description: The totems, $N! We need to activate them, or Go'el is lost!$b$bKill the elementals next to each of my totems, located around the edges of this plateau. Once all four totems are activated, we should be able to free the last piece of Go'el's soul!
english.completion: Despite all odds, Thrall has been saved. Aggra was right to hold out hope for the world-shaman.
english.objective1: Activate Aggra's totems to save Thrall

text.title: 元素誓约：誓言
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的诺达希尔跟萨尔谈谈。
text.description: 在迈入通往海尔加山的传送门之前，萨尔要你跟他走。他要让你做个见证。
text.completion: Thanks to you, my friend - I live again! And due to the combined efforts of the Cenarion Circle and the Earthen Ring - the World Tree will bring new life to Azeroth as well.$B$BWhile Deathwing and the rest of our foes remain to be dealt with, I wish to share something with you.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: The Vow
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Before he passed through the portal to Mount Hyjal, Thrall asked you to follow him. There is something he would like you to witness.
english.completion: Thanks to you, my friend - I live again! And due to the combined efforts of the Cenarion Circle and the Earthen Ring - the World Tree will bring new life to Azeroth as well.$B$BWhile Deathwing and the rest of our foes remain to be dealt with, I wish to share something with you.

text.title: 美丽的睡莲
text.objectives: Obtain 10 Stillwater Lilies.  Deliver the plants to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
text.description: The lilies that grow around Stillwater Pond can be rendered down into a delightful broth.$B$BWell... by "delightful," I mean "won't immediately sicken any orc who drinks it."$B$BWhy don't you go gather some for me, hmmm? Just watch out for the giant flesh-eating tadpoles.
text.progress: Did you find enough Stillwater Lilies?
text.completion: Ah, what a luscious batch of lilies. Bravo! I'll boil them down right away...
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Lily, Oh Lily
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Stillwater Lilies.  Deliver the plants to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.progress: Did you find enough Stillwater Lilies?
english.completion: Ah, what a luscious batch of lilies. Bravo! I'll boil them down right away...
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 蜗牛快跑
text.objectives: Collect 8 Brightwater Snails. Deliver them to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
text.description: The orc guards are always grumbling about bland and moldering Undercity fare - as if it's OUR fault they can't get by on a diet of mushrooms and old corpses - so I think it's time they learn just the sort of exotic delights we can cook up when we've a mind to.$B$BGather some of the freshwater snails ambling about beneath Brightwater Lake and I'll show them what a true culinary master can create.
text.progress: Gather those freshwater snails, yet?
text.completion: You must be quite the swimmer... all I can manage is the dead man's float.$B$BIn any case, excellent batch of snails you've gathered. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Escargot A Go-Go
english.objectives: Collect 8 Brightwater Snails. Deliver them to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: The orc guards are always grumbling about bland and moldering Undercity fare - as if it's OUR fault they can't get by on a diet of mushrooms and old corpses - so I think it's time they learn just the sort of exotic delights we can cook up when we've a mind to.$B$BGather some of the freshwater snails ambling about beneath Brightwater Lake and I'll show them what a true culinary master can create.

english.completion: You must be quite the swimmer... all I can manage is the dead man's float.$B$BIn any case, excellent batch of snails you've gathered. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 蟑螂小屋
text.objectives: Obtain 20 Plump Cockroaches.  Deliver the insects to Chef Audrey in Undercity.
text.description: For all the grousing those Kor'kron Overseers do about Undercity food, there's ONE thing they'll eat in spades: My sister Audrey's Thrice-Spiced Crunchy Stew.$B$BIts popularity means she's always running low on ingredients. Could you gather some for her at the coach she sells them from?$B$BYou'll find traps all over the city; just take their contents to Audrey and she'll handle the rest!
text.progress: I call my little traps "Cockroach Cabins."$B$BCockroaches check in, but they don't check out!
text.completion: Oh, and just as I was nearly out. Thank you!
text.completed: Return to Chef Audrey in Undercity.

english.title: Roach Coach
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Plump Cockroaches.  Deliver the insects to Chef Audrey in Undercity.
english.description: For all the grousing those Kor'kron Overseers do about Undercity food, there's ONE thing they'll eat in spades: My sister Audrey's Thrice-Spiced Crunchy Stew.$B$BIts popularity means she's always running low on ingredients. Could you gather some for her at the coach she sells them from?$B$BYou'll find traps all over the city; just take their contents to Audrey and she'll handle the rest!
english.progress: I call my little traps "Cockroach Cabins."$B$BCockroaches check in, but they don't check out!
english.completion: Oh, and just as I was nearly out. Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Chef Audrey in Undercity.

text.title: 迎接刺骨的狂风
text.objectives: 去奥丹姆的南风之崖跟塞克隆纳斯谈一谈。
text.description: $C，我不相信古伊尔永远离我们而去了。他的灵魂散落在不同的元素位面中。只要哪怕一小部分还存在着，我们就能找到他。但我需要你的帮助。$B$B我们将从空气元素位面开始着手。$B$B跟我谈一谈，然后我们一起前往旋云之巅，去找一名叫做塞克隆纳斯的元素。他变幻莫测，但他能够洞察空气国度的一切。如果我的爱人在那里，塞克隆纳斯一定知道他的处境如何。
text.completion: <You feel the wind racing over your arms, your face, your weapons and armor...>$B$B<Cyclonas is looking you over.>

english.title: Into Slashing Winds
english.objectives: Speak with Cyclonas on the Bluff of the South Wind in Uldum.
english.description: $C, I refuse to believe my Go'el is lost forever. His spirit has been scattered across the elemental planes. If even a part of him still exists, we can find him, but I will need your help.$b$bWe will start with the plane of air.$b$bSpeak to me and we will travel to the Vortex Pinnacle together. We must speak with an elemental, Cyclonas. He's capricious, but he sees everything in the realm of air. If my love is there, Cyclonas will know what's become of him.
english.completion: <You feel the wind racing over your arms, your face, your weapons and armor...>$B$B<Cyclonas is looking you over.>

text.title: 扑向无常的潮水
text.objectives: 去瓦丝琪尔的无底海渊，跟深渊裂口的海卓里斯谈一谈。
text.description: 古伊尔一定就在水元素位面……在深渊之喉里面！我真不敢想他在那里会遭到怎样的命运。$B$B去深渊裂口附近找到海卓里斯。这个元素认识古伊尔，并且对我们同拉格纳罗斯的战斗表示支持。在那里你能依靠的人也只有他了。$B$B我们在瓦丝琪尔的海潮下见，$R……
text.completion: I will do what I can to aid you, $C.

english.title: Into Coaxing Tides
english.objectives: Speak with Hydrius at the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.
english.description: Go'el must be in the plane of water... the Abyssal Maw itself! I shudder to imagine what fate awaits him there.$b$bFind the elemental, Hydrius, near the Abyssal Breach. He knows of Go'el and is sympathetic to our fight against Ragnaros. If anyone can help you there, it's him.$b$bI will meet you beneath the tides of Vashj'ir, $r...
english.completion: I will do what I can to aid you, $C.

text.title: 进入连绵的大地
text.objectives: 去深岩之洲跟塞拉赞恩的王座的塞拉赞恩谈一谈。$B$B阿格娜可以把你从深渊裂口传送到塞拉赞恩的王座去。
text.description: 时间紧迫！我的爱人就在深岩之洲。你准备好了以后我们就出发，我们将会去见石母塞拉赞恩。
text.completion: I already know what it is you seek, fleshlings. And I have chosen to aid you.
text.completed: Speak with Therazane at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

english.title: Into Constant Earth
english.objectives: Speak with Therazane at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.$b$bAggra can teleport you to Therazane's Throne from the Abyssal Breach.
english.description: Time is short! My love lies in Deepholm. I will take us there when you are ready, and we will speak with Therazane the Stonemother.
english.completion: I already know what it is you seek, fleshlings. And I have chosen to aid you.
english.completed: Speak with Therazane at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

text.title: 投身不熄的火焰
text.objectives: 去深岩之洲的顽石岭跟阿格娜谈一谈，前往火焰之地。
text.description: 现在我们必须前往火焰之地。在那个国度，古伊尔燃烧的灵魂可能会像拉格纳罗斯本人一样可怕！做好准备，我们就要孤身进入一个充满敌意的世界。$B$B准备好了就和我谈谈……愿先祖保佑我们！
text.completion: Be ready, $N.
text.completed: Speak with Aggra at Ragnaros' Reach in the Molten Flow.

english.title: Into Unrelenting Flame
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm to secure passage to the Firelands.
english.description: We must travel now to the Firelands. Within that realm, Go'el's burning spirit could become as terrible as Ragnaros himself! Prepare yourself, for we will be alone in a hostile world.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready... and may the ancestors protect us!
english.completion: Be ready, $N.
english.completed: Speak with Aggra at Ragnaros' Reach in the Molten Flow.

text.title: 寒水垂钓
text.objectives: 在丹莫罗的盔枕湖钓起5条寒水鲑鱼。
text.description: $N，不要去听别人胡说八道，这世上最美味的鱼生活就在丹莫罗冰冷的湖水里。那就是我的最爱——寒水鲑鱼，也是铁炉堡最受欢迎的美味，只有我们的故乡出产。$B$B我总说，这是铁炉堡送给全世界的礼物！$B$B嘿，你为什么去试试运气，亲手抓几条回来呢？最容易钓起寒水鲑鱼的地方是盔枕湖，就在丹莫罗的最东边。
text.progress: Have ye tried to catch those char?
text.completion: These are beautiful, $N! I think ye've got the hang of it.
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: Cold Water Fishing
english.objectives: Catch 5 Arctic Char by fishing in Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh.
english.description: The best tastin' fish live in the cold waters o' Dun Morogh, $N, an' don't let anyone else tell ye otherwise! Me favorite, an' the most popular one in Ironforge, is the arctic char, which only comes from our ancestral lands.$B$BI like tae think o' it as Ironforge's gift t' the world!$B$BWhy don't ye try yer hand at catchin' a few yerself? The best place tae find 'em is down in Helm's Bed Lake, in the eastern end o' Dun Morogh.
english.progress: Have ye tried to catch those char?
english.completion: These are beautiful, $N! I think ye've got the hang of it.
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 少不更事
text.objectives: Catch a Young Ironjaw in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern and display it in the Library near the Empty Plaque.
text.description: I'm sure by now ye've heard the tale o' Old Ironjaw, the most famous and elusive fish in the waters o' Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Well, in his many years, he's been responsible for the rise o' many young ironjaws. Don't let the name fool ye, $N, these young'uns are every bit as clever as their dad, but somewhat lackin' in experience.$B$BWith skill an' patience, ye could probably catch one, an' when ye do, bring it to the museum in Ironforge's Library an' put it on display fer all to see!
text.completion: Well done, $N! Maybe seein' yer catch will inspire more dwarves to take up fishin'!
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: One fer the Ages
english.objectives: Catch a Young Ironjaw in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern and display it in the Library near the Empty Plaque.

Well, in his many years, he's been responsible for the rise o' many young ironjaws. english.completion: Well done, $N! Maybe seein' yer catch will inspire more dwarves to take up fishin'!
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 给滑滑的鱼
text.objectives: Catch 3 Blind Minnows in the pool in the Forlorn Cavern and feed them to Squirky.
text.description: Hae I introduced ye tae me pet, Squirky? I'm teachin' him tae fish all proper-like. Fer now, I've been feedin' him minnows fished from the pool in this cavern.$B$BMaybe ye'd like tae give it a try? Just cast yer lure in the pool over there and feed Squirky any minnows ye happen tae fish up. He'll love ye ferever!
text.completion: Ye've done a good job. Squirky seems happy and I've had some time to make some new lures. Thank ye fer the help!
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: Fish fer Squirky
english.objectives: Catch 3 Blind Minnows in the pool in the Forlorn Cavern and feed them to Squirky.
english.description: Hae I introduced ye tae me pet, Squirky? I'm teachin' him tae fish all proper-like. Fer now, I've been feedin' him minnows fished from the pool in this cavern.$B$BMaybe ye'd like tae give it a try? Just cast yer lure in the pool over there and feed Squirky any minnows ye happen tae fish up. He'll love ye ferever!
english.completion: Ye've done a good job. Squirky seems happy and I've had some time to make some new lures. Thank ye fer the help!
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 池塘猛兽
text.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 8 Azshara Snakehead fish from the Thunder Bluff pond.
text.description: A well-meaning goblin visitor introduced Azshara snakeheads to our waters and now they're overrunning the pond.$B$BPlease, if you can catch some of these voracious predatory fish before they eat every smallfish and mud snapper in Thunder Bluff, I'd be terribly grateful.
text.progress: Have you caught any Azshara snakeheads, yet?
text.completion: Good work, $N. It's up to all of Thunder Bluff's fishers to keep this vicious creature out of Mulgore's waters.
text.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Pond Predators
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 8 Azshara Snakehead fish from the Thunder Bluff pond.
english.description: A well-meaning goblin visitor introduced Azshara snakeheads to our waters and now they're overrunning the pond.$B$BPlease, if you can catch some of these voracious predatory fish before they eat every smallfish and mud snapper in Thunder Bluff, I'd be terribly grateful.
english.progress: Have you caught any Azshara snakeheads, yet?
english.completion: Good work, $N. It's up to all of Thunder Bluff's fishers to keep this vicious creature out of Mulgore's waters.
english.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 戒指事件
text.objectives: Fish up a Blind Cavefish from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.  Once you catch a cavefish, fillet it and check if it swallowed the ring.
text.description: One of the Forsaken from the Pools of Vision came to me and said he'd lost his ring to a blind cavefish in the waters there.$B$BOr perhaps it was his finger. It was hard to tell; his jaw did not move and his Orcish was no better than mine.$B$BIn any case, I thought it would be a kind gesture towards our unusual visitors to catch and gut cavefish until the ring - or finger - was found.$B$BWould you help?
text.progress: You haven't seen a ring about, have you? I think one of the cavefish might have swallowed it...
text.completion: You found my ring, did you? I'm most grateful.$B$BTo be honest, I've no idea why I keep the thing. I'm not even certain how I acquired it... I suppose I am simply a creature of habit.$B$BStill, as I said, I am grateful. Say... I found these things while searching for it myself. Perhaps they'd be of some use to you?
text.completed: Deliver the Poshken's Ring to Poshken Hardbinder in Thunder Bluff.

english.objectives: Fish up a Blind Cavefish from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.  Once you catch a cavefish, fillet it and check if it swallowed the ring.

I suppose I am simply a creature of habit.$B$BStill, as I said, I am grateful. Say... I found these things while searching for it myself. Perhaps they'd be of some use to you?
english.completed: Deliver the Poshken's Ring to Poshken Hardbinder in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 活饵
text.objectives: 对你自己使用格瑞诺尔的饵料，然后跳进丹莫罗的盔枕湖里。
text.description: 如果你钓过小龙虾，就一定知道用活饵来钓小龙虾是最好不过了。而且诱饵越多，效果越好。想试试我新研制的龙虾饵吗？把这东西涂在你的身上，然后跳进丹莫罗东边的盔枕湖里。$B$B抓住猎物之后，把它交给我的朋友——厨师格瑞姆，他就在盔枕湖西边的古博拉采掘场。他可是烹调这些超级大虾米的大师！
text.completion: These are beautiful, $N! Grimnur's goin' tae be so proud when he hears about this!$B$BOh, he did say tae pass this along tae ye, if the scheme worked.
text.completed: Bring your crayfish to Cook Ghilm at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Live Bait
english.objectives: Use Grimnur's Bait on yourself, then jump into Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh.
english.description: If ye've ever fished fer crayfish, ye know they respond best to live bait, an' the more bait, the better. Would ye like to test my new bait? Simply smear this on yerself an' hop into Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh.$B$BAfter ye've got the catch, take it to me friend, Cook Ghilm at Gol'Bolar Quarry, west of the lake. He's an expert at cookin' those oversized bugs!
english.completion: These are beautiful, $N! Grimnur's goin' tae be so proud when he hears about this!$B$BOh, he did say tae pass this along tae ye, if the scheme worked.
english.completed: Bring your crayfish to Cook Ghilm at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 种群恢复
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的卡尔·迷雾行者要你从莫高雷石牛湖中带回2条产卵期小鱼和2条交配期泥鳅。
text.description: 雷霆崖的池塘里挤满了贪吃的艾萨拉蛇头鱼，小鱼和泥鳅几乎都要绝种了。$B$B我们已经让渔夫去尽可能地消灭它们了。你能不能再帮我们引一些鱼种来，重新恢复池塘里的鱼类种群？$B$B如果你能从石牛湖钓些鱼上来，把它们带到雷霆崖来，我会非常感激你的。
text.progress: Did you bring those fish from Stonebull Lake, yet?
text.completion: Your help is much appreciated, $N.$B$BHopefully these fish will go a long way towards restocking our fishing pond.
text.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: The Race to Restock
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 2 Randy Smallfish and 2 Amorous Mud Snappers from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore.
english.description: Thunder Bluff's fishing pond is being overrun with voracious Azshara snakeheads; there are hardly any smallfish or mud snappers left.$B$BWe already have fishers trying to kill as many snakeheads as they can, but can you assist us in our restocking efforts?$B$BIf you could gather some fish from Stonebull Lake and bring them here to Thunder Bluff, I would be very grateful.
english.progress: Did you bring those fish from Stonebull Lake, yet?
english.completion: Your help is much appreciated, $N.$B$BHopefully these fish will go a long way towards restocking our fishing pond.
english.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 美味小龙虾
text.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 10 Stonebull Crayfish from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore.
text.description: One of the great delicacies of Mulgore is the crayfish that dwell in our lakes and streams. They are particularly popular during weddings or the celebration of a birth.$B$BWould you help me catch some of these crafty crustaceans for the cooking pots of Thunder Bluff?$B$BYou can fish them up from Stonebull Lake, or simply dive in and grab them.
text.progress: Crayfish are so tasty. Have you caught many?
text.completion: Ah, so many crayfish!$B$BDid you fish these up? Or simply swim after them?$B$BWell, no matter. Excellent work, $N.
text.completed: Return the crayfish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Craving Crayfish
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 10 Stonebull Crayfish from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore.
english.description: One of the great delicacies of Mulgore is the crayfish that dwell in our lakes and streams. They are particularly popular during weddings or the celebration of a birth.$B$BWould you help me catch some of these crafty crustaceans for the cooking pots of Thunder Bluff?$B$BYou can fish them up from Stonebull Lake, or simply dive in and grab them.
english.progress: Crayfish are so tasty. Have you caught many?
english.completion: Ah, so many crayfish!$B$BDid you fish these up? Or simply swim after them?$B$BWell, no matter. Excellent work, $N.
english.completed: Return the crayfish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 侏儒诱鱼器
text.objectives: 获得5个闪光的小珠，1个精密触发器，3个捕鼠陷阱，然后使用诱鱼器设计图。
text.description: 有个侏儒工程训练师来找过我，还给了我一张诱鱼器的设计图。据他说这种新发明不光能帮我快速抓鱼，还能防止鱼儿逃走。要我说，这玩意儿听上去其实挺蠢的，但我总喜欢尝试新鲜玩意儿。$B$B这就是那张设计图。你可以从我在房子里的助手那里买到闪光的小珠，再从工匠镇的工程学供应商那里买到精密触发器，另外你能在矿道地铁里找到捕鼠陷阱。
text.progress: How's that fancy new lure comin' along?
text.completion: It doesn't look like anything I think a fish'd be interested in, but ye never know. Fish're strange creatures. Thanks fer givin' this a try, $N.
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: The Gnomish Bait-o-Matic
english.objectives: Use the Bait-o-Matic Blueprint with 5 Shiny Baubles, a Hair Trigger, and 3 Rat Traps to create the Gnomish Bait-o-Matic.
english.description: One o' the gnomish engineerin' trainers gave me a blueprint fer a fancy lure he says'll help me catch fish faster and keep 'em from gettin' away. The whole thing sounds a mite silly if ye ask me, but I'll try anythin' once.$B$BHere are the blueprints. Ye're going to need shiny baubles, which ye can buy from my assistant inside the buildin', a hair trigger ye can buy from an engineerin' supplier in Tinker Town, and a few rat traps from the Deeprun Tram.
english.progress: How's that fancy new lure comin' along?
english.completion: It doesn't look like anything I think a fish'd be interested in, but ye never know. Fish're strange creatures. Thanks fer givin' this a try, $N.
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 守卫的军粮
text.objectives: 向6位铁炉堡守卫分发铁炉堡军粮。
text.description: 铁炉堡的守卫们赌上了性命来保卫我们的城市，我们也应当照顾一下他们。$B$B他们今天的军粮由两部分组成：矮人最爱的羊杂馅饼和铁炉堡麦酒。你能帮我分发一下这些军粮吗？这样每个人都能及时拿到自己的伙食，我们也好腾出手来做别的事情。
text.completion: A full guard is a happy guard, as I always say. Thanks fer yer help, $N.
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: A Round for the Guards
english.objectives: Distribute the Ironforge Rations to 6 Ironforge Guards.
english.description: The guards who defend Ironforge put their lives on the line against our many enemies, and it's up to us to take care of them.$B$BToday, their rations consist of two dwarven favorites, haggis and Ironforge pale ale. Would ye be so kind as to help me distribute them? That way, everyone gets his food in a timely manner and we can move on to other tasks.
english.completion: A full guard is a happy guard, as I always say. Thanks fer yer help, $N.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 禽肉短缺
text.objectives: 在铁炉堡前门附近收集6只丹莫罗小鸡。
text.description: 哦，不，$N，如果我们不快点弄点鸡肉回来，事情就麻烦大了……没有鸡肉的韭菜鸡汤怎么能叫韭菜“鸡汤”呢！$B$B如果我们能马上就弄到一些新鲜鸡肉，那就还来得及做鸡汤。你能帮我吗？铁炉堡前门经常会有些小鸡跑来跑去。如果你能帮我弄回来，我看看，6只小鸡，我们就还能弄出鸡汤来。
text.progress: The chickens, $N, do ye have them or not?
text.completion: Aye, that's exactly what I needed. Ye have me thanks, $N, and me apologies fer bein' so brusque earlier. I just cannae stand the thought of not gettin' a meal finished on time.
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: A Fowl Shortage
english.objectives: Collect 6 Dun Morogh Chickens near the entrance to Ironforge.
english.description: Oh, no, $N, this is going to be a disaster if we don't find some chicken soon... Ye just cannae make cock-a-leekie soup without the chicken! It's not possible!$B$BThere's still time to make the soup and broth if ye can find some fresh chicken. Will ye help me? There are usually a few chickens running around outside the front entrance to the city. If ye can get yer hands on, say, six o' them, that should save me soup.
english.progress: The chickens, $N, do ye have them or not?
english.completion: Aye, that's exactly what I needed. Ye have me thanks, $N, and me apologies fer bein' so brusque earlier. I just cannae stand the thought of not gettin' a meal finished on time.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 羊杂馅饼飘香满溢
text.objectives: 取得一包羊杂碎，5袋甜香料和4袋燕麦片。
text.description: 羊杂馅饼飘香满溢，这是句老话，但他们从没想过馅饼可不是从天上掉下来的！你肯定不想知道要是铁炉堡的人吃不到羊杂馅饼会有多么难受。$B$B我正在做下一锅羊杂馅饼，但还少一些材料。$B$B索戈纳尔·硬须是军事区的肉商，他能卖给你一大袋我需要的羊杂碎。另外，你能从任何一名烹饪供应商那里买到甜香料。我们还需要一些燕麦片，你可以在城里的旅馆或者其他食品商那里买到。
text.progress: Do ye have those ingredients?
text.completion: Ye got them all? Wonderful! I'll get started right away.
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: Keepin' the Haggis Flowin'
english.objectives: Obtain a Bag o' Sheep Innards, 5 packets of Mild Spices, and 4 Sacks of Oatmeal.
english.description: The haggis must flow. Aye, it's a figure o' speech, for haggis'll ne'er flow! Ye dinnae want to know what'll happen if the people o' Ironforge don't get their haggis.$B$BI'm working on the next batch, but I'm still missing a couple of ingredients.$B$BSognar Cliffbeard is the meat vendor in the Military Ward, an' he'll sell you the big bag o' sheep innards I need. Ye can buy mild spices from any cooking supplier and ye can find sacks o' oatmeal in any inn or among the supplies  in the city.
english.progress: Do ye have those ingredients?
english.completion: Ye got them all? Wonderful! I'll get started right away.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 闪光的小珠
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的娜哈莉·追云者希望得到20枚中部高地底层周围的闪光石子。
text.description: 渔夫最简单，也最有效的工具之一就是闪光的小珠。把它们挂在鱼线上，就算是钓鱼新手也有机会钓上大鱼。$B$B但在这种钓鱼活动火爆的情况下，雷霆崖已经极度缺乏这种小东西了！$B$B你能不能去中部高地下面为我收集一些闪光石子？把它们交给娜哈莉·追云者。她就能用它们制做出更多闪光的小珠了。
text.progress: Did you happen to bring me any shiny stones?
text.completion: My, those are some very lovely stones! They'll make perfect shiny baubles, thank you.$B$BHere... Kah told me you'd be by with the stones, and to give this to you upon your arrival.
text.completed: Return the stones to Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Shiny Baubles
english.objectives: Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff wants 20 Shiny Stones from around the central rise's base.
english.description: One of a fisher's most simple and effective tools is the shiny bauble; affixed to a line, even the most novice angler has a chance at a catch.$B$BWith all the fishing going on of late, though, Thunder Bluff is in woefully short supply!$B$BMight I ask you to collect shiny stones from around the base of the central rise? Bring them to Nahari Cloudchaser so that she might craft more shiny baubles with them.
english.progress: Did you happen to bring me any shiny stones?
english.completion: My, those are some very lovely stones! They'll make perfect shiny baubles, thank you.$B$BHere... Kah told me you'd be by with the stones, and to give this to you upon your arrival.
english.completed: Return the stones to Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 再来点香料面包
text.objectives: Make or obtain 10 slices of Spice Bread.
text.description: 越简单的菜式越重要，$N，香料面包可是一直在铁炉堡里大受欢迎。有时候甚至供不应求！$B$B你能不能帮我做点香料面包来满足群众的需求，顺便练习下烹饪技术？你能在我的兄弟埃姆鲁尔·里克努斯那里买到所有需要的材料，他就在楼下。
text.progress: How's that spice bread?
text.completion: That bread looks delicious. Thanks, $N.
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: Can't Get Enough Spice Bread
english.objectives: Make or obtain 10 slices of Spice Bread.
english.description: It might seem like a basic thing, $N, but spice bread is a longtime favorite in Ironforge. Some days, I have trouble keeping up!$B$BWould ye like to cook some to practice yer skills an' help meet the demand? Ye can buy all the ingredients ye'll need from me brother, Emrul Riknussun, who is downstairs.
english.progress: How's that spice bread?
english.completion: That bread looks delicious. Thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 我需要一桶美酒
text.objectives: 在卡拉诺斯酿酒厂外扛起一桶德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒，并把它运回铁炉堡。
text.description: 我的铁炉堡麦酒储量正在变低。幸运的是，啤酒厂就在附近，他们应该已经为我们酿好了一桶德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒。德鲁甘可是个天才酿酒师。$B$B我今天实在是没空亲自去卡拉诺斯，但也许你能帮我跑一趟，把那桶卖给帮我运回来，如何？
text.completion: Ah, well done! I tell ye, that Drugan's a true polymath -- explorer, historian, brewer -- is there anythin' that man hasn't mastered?
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: I Need to Cask a Favor
english.objectives: Pick up the Cask of Drugan's IPA outside the brewery in Kharanos and run it back to Ironforge.
english.description: My stocks o' IPA, that's Ironforge Pale Ale for ye novices, are gettin' low. Luckily, the brewery isn't too far away an' they should have a new cask o' Drugan's IPA waitin' fer us. That Drugan's a genius of a brewer, I tell ye.$B$BI won't be able to get down to Kharanos meself today, but perhaps ye can dash down there, pick up the new cask an' run it back 'ere? What d'ye say?
english.completion: Ah, well done! I tell ye, that Drugan's a true polymath -- explorer, historian, brewer -- is there anythin' that man hasn't mastered?
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 香料面包无限量
text.objectives: 烹饪或获得10片香料面包。
text.description: 简简单单的香料面包却在达纳苏斯如此受欢迎，是不是很令人惊讶？当我没有繁杂事务缠身的时候，我总是会去烤两片香料面包来锻炼下厨艺。$B$B为什么你不也来试试呢？所有的食材都可以在这里的商店里买到。$B$B香料面包总是不嫌多的，不管你做多少都会有人喜欢吃。当你做好面包之后带来给我，我会邀请我们的吉尔尼斯朋友们也来尝尝。
text.progress: I just love the smell of baking bread, especially spice bread. Don't you?
text.completion: These are well-made, $N. I hope you found baking as relaxing as I do.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Spice Bread Aplenty
english.objectives: Make or obtain 10 pieces of Spice Bread.
english.description: Isn't it amazing how something as simple as spice bread is used every day in Darnassus? When I'm not seeing to my other responsibilities, I like to bake spice bread to hone my skills as a cook and practice my technique.$B$BWhy don't you give it a try? You should be able to get your ingredients here in the shop.$B$BNo matter how much we make, it never goes to waste. Bring me your loaves when you're done and I'll have someone share them with our friends, the Gilneans.
english.progress: I just love the smell of baking bread, especially spice bread. Don't you?
english.completion: These are well-made, $N. I hope you found baking as relaxing as I do.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 需求松仁
text.objectives: Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.$B$BThe Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.$B$BWould you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...
text.progress: Have you found many of those tasty pine nuts?
text.completion: You work so quickly!$B$BI'll see that these are distributed to the various chefs and bakers of Thunder Bluff.$B$BThank you!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Pining for Nuts
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.$B$BThe Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.$B$BWould you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...
english.progress: Have you found many of those tasty pine nuts?
english.completion: You work so quickly!$B$BI'll see that these are distributed to the various chefs and bakers of Thunder Bluff.$B$BThank you!
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 昔日最爱
text.objectives: 在鲁瑟兰村钓起8条卡多雷鲱鱼。
text.description: 鲱鱼是达纳苏斯最受追捧的美食之一，但不是所有鲱鱼都能做出好菜式。卡多雷鲱鱼只在泰达希尔周边的水域里出产。$B$B我一直囤积了大量的卡多雷鲱鱼，因为这种鱼能做出的菜式实在是太多了！我刚刚做了一些烟熏鲱鱼，所以我得马上补充存货。你能帮我个忙吗？在鲁瑟兰村，你可以轻松钓起卡多雷鲱鱼。
text.progress: Did you get those herring?
text.completion: Thanks! I wonder what I should do with this batch...
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: An Old Favorite
english.objectives: Catch 8 Kaldorei Herring by fishing in Rut'theran Village.
english.description: Herring is one of the most sought-after fish in Darnassus, but not just any herring. The Kaldorei herring is native only to the waters surrounding Teldrassil.$B$BI try to keep a good supply of it because it's so versatile! I just finished smoking a batch of it, so I need to rebuild my stocks. Would you mind helping me? You can catch Kaldorei herring by fishing in Rut'theran Village.
english.progress: Did you get those herring?
english.completion: Thanks! I wonder what I should do with this batch...
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 要来点苍蝇吗
text.objectives: 在攻城绞肉车附近的“肉”上取得25只肿胀苍蝇。然后去找幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 为兽人烹调食物并不是我们唯一的任务，$C。这一次，我们要为一些有望取代兽人的家伙做饭。$B$B我们先要从小东西开始做。所以我们要捉苍蝇。苍蝇爱腐肉，我们也爱腐肉……当然，我们是爱把腐肉做成投掷武器！$B$B去看看攻城绞肉车上有没有残余的肉。有肉的地方就有苍蝇。$B$B给我带25只肿胀苍蝇来，然后我就能进行进一步的烹调了。
text.progress: I bet some of that "meat" is still good.
text.completion: Ah!  Perfect!  Fat, slow and ready to be eaten!  Next up, we will feed them to our spiders.  Fatten them up, and then, we feed the spiders to the frogs...$B$BListen to me go on.  You don't need to know all the details.  This is just a small step in a grand cuisine in a grand scheme.
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Would You Like Some Flies With That?
english.objectives: Obtain 25 Bloated Flies from the "meat" near the Meat Wagons. Then return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: It's not always about making food for the orcs, $c.  This time, it's about making food for what will hopefully be their replacements.$b$bWe need to start small, we need to catch flies.  Flies love rotting meat, and we love rotting meat... as projectile weapons!$b$bCheck out the Meat Wagons for any extra bits of meat.  Where you find the meat, you'll find the flies.$b$bBring me 25 bloated flies, and then I can start on the next stage of our cooking plan.
english.progress: I bet some of that "meat" is still good.
english.completion: Ah!  Perfect!  Fat, slow and ready to be eaten!  Next up, we will feed them to our spiders.  Fatten them up, and then, we feed the spiders to the frogs...$B$BListen to me go on.  You don't need to know all the details.  This is just a small step in a grand cuisine in a grand scheme.
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 壕沟怪物！
text.objectives: Use the Alliance Decoy Kit to summon the Moat Monster in the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Then use the Bloated Frogs to feed the monster.
text.description: Sometimes fishing means throwing something back, $c.$b$bWe've been overfeeding these frogs for just that occasion.  We've fed these frogs bloated spiders, that were fed bloated flies, and now, we are going to feed a real monster.$b$bThe moat above, in the Ruins of Lordaeron, is home to our very own Moat Monster.$b$bToday is feeding day.  But we must train it as well.  In this bag, you will find a decoy kit and some Bloated Frogs.  Use the decoy kit, then toss the frogs to the monster when it appears.
text.completion: The dead feed the flies.  The flies feed the spiders.  The spiders feed the frogs.  The frogs feed our moat monster... It's a beautiful circle of life with the goal of ending life.
text.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.
text.objective1: Feed Bloated Frogs to the Moat Monster

english.title: Moat Monster!
english.objectives: Use the Alliance Decoy Kit to summon the Moat Monster in the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Then use the Bloated Frogs to feed the monster.
english.description: Sometimes fishing means throwing something back, $c.$b$bWe've been overfeeding these frogs for just that occasion.  We've fed these frogs bloated spiders, that were fed bloated flies, and now, we are going to feed a real monster.$b$bThe moat above, in the Ruins of Lordaeron, is home to our very own Moat Monster.$b$bToday is feeding day.  But we must train it as well.  In this bag, you will find a decoy kit and some Bloated Frogs.  Use the decoy kit, then toss the frogs to the monster when it appears.
english.completion: The dead feed the flies.  The flies feed the spiders.  The spiders feed the frogs.  The frogs feed our moat monster... It's a beautiful circle of life with the goal of ending life.
english.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.
english.objective1: Feed Bloated Frogs to the Moat Monster

text.title: “魔法”蘑菇
text.objectives: Gather 6 "Magic" Mushrooms from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.  Deliver them to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: You know of the Pools of Vision, yes?$B$BThere is a sort of mushroom that grows there... not the tough, rank fungi that dominates the place, but smaller, more delicate caps that grow beneath them.$B$BThey are rare and quite delicious, adding a flavor to meat dishes that one might even call magical.$B$B...what? No, really. They just taste good. That's it.
text.progress: Were you able to gather any mushrooms?
text.completion: Thank you, $N! I'm sure these will impart a simply magical taste to whatever dish they're used in.$B$BWhat? Stop looking at me like that!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 莫高雷香料面包
text.objectives: Use Mulgore Spices with Spice Bread to create 5 Fresh Mulgore Spice Bread (you may make your own Spice Bread or use someone else's). Deliver the bread to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: I am often asked, "Aska, who is making all this Mulgore spice bread?!"$B$BIt is a reasonable question. Our fine and noble bread is traded in countless settlements in the most far-away lands, even by our staunchest foes. IT'S JUST THAT GOOD.$B$BAnd the answer...?$B$BIt is "YOU." Please take this packet of Mulgore spices and use it to turn bland, boring spice bread into MULGORE spice bread!
text.progress: Have you baked that Mulgore spice bread, yet?
text.completion: Ooo, that bread smells delicious. You are quite the baker, $N.$B$BWho knows how far these exquisite loaves will go... I hear it's even popular among the draenei of the Azuremyst Isles!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 碾碎玉米
text.objectives: Help the inhabitants of Thunder Bluff make cornmeal by pounding bowls of Corn Kernels.
text.description: One of Thunder Bluff's most important staples is cornmeal; bowls of corn may be found in nearly every home.$B$BWith so many of the local mills under constant attack by harpies, gnolls, reckless mining companies and Earth Mother knows what else, I often ask my students to help with the task of grinding corn into cornmeal.$B$BWould you care to help?
text.completion: Much work is required to grind enough cornmeal for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $N.
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.description: Even the novice cook knows that a great dish begins with great ingredients.$B$BI have standing orders with merchants throughout Thunder Bluff, but I'd like to see how well you do at selecting the very best of what they have to offer.$B$BPlease make the rounds and gather perfect portions of meat, fish, vegetables and herbs from local merchant stalls.
text.progress: Have you gathered all the necessary ingredients?
text.completion: <Aska examines the ingredients you have chosen.>$B$BMmmhmmm. Yes. Well done!$B$BI could not have chosen better myself.

text.title: 败其兴致
text.objectives: 去洛丹伦废墟对稻草人使用灭火剂。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$C。我们虽然尽力享受稻草人庆典，但很明显部落也会尽力破坏我们的庆祝活动。$B$B审慎的做法可能是不去受争端的影响，不去理会那些攻击。$B$B我很尊敬那些行为高尚的人，但我帮他们不上。不过至于那些想以牙还牙的……我倒是能帮点忙。要是你也感兴趣，$C，拿着这灭火剂，去洛丹伦废墟那儿把部落的稻草人给弄灭。
text.progress: Have you extinguished the Horde's Wickerman, $c?
text.completed: Return to Keira outside of Stormwind City.

english.title: A Time to Lose
english.objectives: Use the Dousing Agent on the Wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
english.description: Well met, $c. As we attempt to embrace the Wickerman ceremony, it is no surprise that the Horde would attempt to ruin our celebration.$b$bNow the prudent course of action may be to rise above the conflict and simply ignore the attacks.$b$bI admire those that take that high road, but I cannot help them.  But for those that seek to strike back... I can help them.  If you are interested, $c, take this Dousing Agent and use it on the Horde's Wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
english.progress: Have you extinguished the Horde's Wickerman, $c?
english.completed: Return to Keira outside of Stormwind City.

text.title: 臭气弹轰炸！
text.objectives: Speak with Crina Fenlow and take a broomstick flight over Stormwind city.  Use the stink bombs to cover the city and its people.
text.description: The foolish Alliance have employed hags to fuel an attack on our city.  Well, as my sister once told me, "Turnabout is fair play."$b$bWe will gladly return the favor.  Speak with my sister, and she will provide you with a broomstick flight over Stormwind.  While over Stormwind, drop stink bombs on the city and on the people.  Make them suffer!$b$bWe will show those hags in Stormwind who is the most powerful.
text.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.objectives: Use the Arcane Cleanser to remove stink bombs within the Undercity.
text.description: Greetings, $c!  Are you enjoying Hallow's End?  It seems that in response to our stink bombing Stormwind, the Alliance has decided to stink bomb our city.$b$bFortunately, we have magics that can handle the stink the Alliance bring us.  Use this Arcane Cleanser to remove the stink bombs from the city.
text.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 重振旗鼓
text.objectives: 用稻草人前面的篝火将其点燃。并使用稻草人周围的灰烬。
text.description: 我们烧毁了稻草人，用来警告那些敢于反对我们的人。我们将稻草人焚烧的灰烬涂在身上，向那些奴役我们的人发起永不休止的征战。$B$B用附近的篝火点燃稻草人。把四周的灰烬收集起来，涂在你的脸上。$B$B这些姿态将提醒敌人，我们永不退让。
text.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: A Time to Build Up
english.objectives: Use the bonfire in front of the Wickerman to set it ablaze.  Use the ashes on the ground near the Wickerman.
english.description: We burn the effigy of the Wickerman as a symbol of our struggle against those who would oppose us. We wear the ashes of the burnt Wickerman as a symbol of our neverending fight against those who would enslave us.$b$bUse the bonfire nearby and ignite the Wickerman.  Then take the ashes that lay nearby and spread them across your face.$b$bThese gestures will serve as a reminder to our enemies that we shall never yield.
english.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 大肆破坏
text.objectives: 对暴风城前的稻草人使用灭火剂。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$C。在我们欢祝稻草人庆典的时候，联盟显然也会尽力破坏我们的庆祝活动。$B$B现在我们有一个办法可以还以颜色。如果你有兴趣，$C，就拿上这灭火剂，去暴风城前面把联盟的稻草人给弄灭。$B$B去熄灭他们的火苗，让他们吃点苦头吧，$C。
text.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

If you are interested, $c, take this Dousing Agent and use it on the Alliance's Wickerman in front of Stormwind.$b$bExtinguish their flame and revel in their misery, $c.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：海加尔山！
text.objectives: 跟塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月谈一谈，进入月光林地。
text.description: 奉瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民都要前往月光林地的永夜港，向风歌使者报到。$B$B我们在塞纳里奥议会中的兄弟报告说，死亡之翼的爪牙向世界之树发起了毁灭性的进攻，试图将其夷为平地！$B$B与暴风要塞中的塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月交谈，前往月光林地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！英勇战斗吧，我的$G兄弟:姐妹;!
text.end: Transportation to Moonglade Secured
text.completed: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
english.objectives: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Jademoon to secure transportation to Moonglade.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!
english.end: Transportation to Moonglade Secured
english.completed: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 失踪的传家宝
text.objectives: 去暴风城港口上船搜寻雇来的送货员的船舱，查看是什么让他耽搁了。
text.description: 我的最后一批货物今天就该从塞拉摩运到了。船是来了，但我还没有收到送货员的消息。他押运着我们家族代代相传的宝物。$B$B你是否愿意前往暴风城港口，看看是什么事情让他耽搁了这么久？
text.end: Search the courier's cabin.
text.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

english.title: Missing Heirlooms
english.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship in Stormwind Harbor for evidence of what might be delaying him.
english.description: The last of my belongings were supposed to be arriving from Theramore today. The ship has arrived, but I haven't heard from the courier. The crate he was transporting had items that've been in my family for generations.$B$BWill you go down to Stormwind Harbor and see what's keeping him?
english.end: Search the courier's cabin.
english.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

text.title: Brew For Brewfest
text.objectives: 你有4分钟时间驾驭赛羊，让它保持三种不同的速度各8秒。
text.description: So you want to check out the racing rams?  The dwarves think they have got a handle on it, but let's be honest, they are drunk most of the time, so how hard can it really be?$b$bNow before I let you strut your stuff, you'll need to show me that you can handle these fine, legally obtained creatures.$b$bSo here's the deal:  I'll lend you some racing reins and the use of a ram. You need to prove to me that you can handle using these rams.$b$bKeep the ram at a trot, canter and gallop for 8 seconds each.

english.title: Brew For Brewfest
english.objectives: You have 4 minutes to ride the ram and maintain 3 different levels of speed for 8 seconds.
english.description: So you want to check out the racing rams?  The dwarves think they have got a handle on it, but let's be honest, they are drunk most of the time, so how hard can it really be?$b$bNow before I let you strut your stuff, you'll need to show me that you can handle these fine, legally obtained creatures.$b$bSo here's the deal:  I'll lend you some racing reins and the use of a ram. You need to prove to me that you can handle using these rams.$b$bKeep the ram at a trot, canter and gallop for 8 seconds each.

text.title: 新的纪念品供应商
text.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
text.description: <sigh>$b$bDon't talk to me about last year's stein...$b$bI think our shady stein suppliers were somehow involved with that Twilight Hammer cult non-sense that errupted just before the elementals invaded.$b$bAnd that's why we have a new supplier and a better stein!$b$b Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.
text.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

text.title: 新的纪念品供应商
text.objectives: 去美酒节营地的贝尔比那里兑换美酒节礼品券。
text.description: 最好别再提去年的酒杯了，$N。我跟你说哦，我们上一家供应商，他们靠不住。有证据表明他们参与了邪教活动……$B$B我们怎么能和想要毁灭世界的人合作呢！！$B$B于是我们找了一家新的供应商，换了新货。$B$B拿上这张礼品券，去美酒节营地后头附近找贝尔比。她会免费给你一个美酒节酒杯。此外，她还负责节日期间所有的美酒节兑换活动。
text.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

english.title: A New Supplier of Souvenirs
english.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Belbi Quikswitch in the Brewfest camp.
english.description: The less said about last year's stein, the better, $n.  I'll tell you this, our previous supplier, they were shady.  Turns out they were involved in some cultist activities...$b$bWe can't work with people who are trying to destroy the world!!$b$bSo we have a new supplier and a new stein.$b$bTake this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch  near the back of the Brewfest camp.  She'll give you your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also handle any and all other Brewfest transactions that come up during the holiday.
english.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 保护货物
text.objectives: 跟着蜘蛛走，质询你发现的那个人。
text.description: 你迅速查看了一番，没有在船舱里找到任何证据，能够表明杀手的身份或者是动机。你要找的箱子不翼而飞了。$B$B你正打算离开的时候，发现脚下有什么东西在动。一群蜘蛛接踵从送货员的床下爬了出来。它们这是要去哪儿?
text.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Fitch.

english.title: Fencing the Goods
english.objectives: Follow the spiders to their destination and question the man you find there.
english.description: A quick search of the cabin reveals no evidence of the killer's identity or motives. The crate you were sent to retrieve has vanished.$B$BAs you turn to leave the cabin, you notice something small moving underfoot. A trail of spiders crawls out from under the slain courier's bed. Where could they be heading?
english.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Fitch.

text.title: 购物
text.objectives: 前往暴风城矮人区的林荫女士，寻找偷箱贼前来拜访过的证据。
text.description: 我跟那位“绅士”说，矮人区或许有家店更能满足他的需要。店名叫做林荫女士，门口就在矮人区西侧的运河附近。$B$B你要找的人叫做昆西·科特勒。他经手的东西，诚实的中间商从来不碰！
text.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
text.completed: Speak to Hudson Barnes.

english.title: Shopping Around
english.objectives: Make your way to the Shady Lady in Stormwind's Dwarven District and look for evidence of the crate-thief's visit.
english.description: I told the 'gentleman' that there might be a shop more suited to his needs in the Dwarven District. It's called the Shady Lady and you can find the entrance near the Canals on the western side of the district.$B$BQuincy Cutler is your man. He trades in merchandise an honest broker would never touch!
english.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
english.completed: Speak to Hudson Barnes.

text.title: 庆祝的季节
text.objectives: 与幽暗城入口外洛丹伦废墟里的黑暗召唤者雅恩卡交谈。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$C。万圣节是欢庆和反思的时刻。尽管有人在举办许多庆祝活动时，根本不知道它们的起源。除了被遗忘者之外的许多人甚至不知烧“稻草人”到底是干什么的。$B$B到幽暗城上方的洛丹伦废墟去，和黑暗召唤者雅恩卡谈谈。她会向你介绍更多关于稻草人仪式的知识。

english.title: A Season for Celebration
english.objectives: Speak with Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron just outside the entrance to Undercity.
english.description: Well met, $c.$B$BHallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though some have no idea why. The burning of the Wickerman in particular is a mystery to many outside the Forsaken.$B$BTravel to the Ruins of Lordaeron above Undercity and speak to Darkcaller Yanka.  She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.

text.title: 吹跑了
text.objectives: 珈珈想让你在奥格瑞玛城中收集5个飘走的气球。
text.description: Please, $gmister:miss;, you just gotta help me!$b$bMy pa brought me a bunch of balloons from the Darkmoon fair. Best... gift... EVER! They're magical, you know, and never lose their floatiness!$b$bThere's just one thing...$b$bA big ol' gust of wind blew 'em right outta my hands. They're scattered all over Orgrimmar!$b$bI'd chase after 'em myself, but this city's so big I'd get lost for sure.$b$bCan you round 'em up for me before they float away?$b$bPlease?
text.progress: Did you find all of my balloons, $gmister:miss;?
text.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!
text.completed: Return to Jaga in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Blown Away
english.objectives: Jaga wants you to collect 5 Windswept Balloons from Orgrimmar.

english.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!

text.title: 保护措施
text.objectives: Obtain 5 Crystal Vials, 5 Arcane Powder, and 5 Blood Nettle.
text.description: I'd be wary of anyone identifying himself as the rightful owner of the crate and its contents. He didn't warn you of the danger?$B$BHere's a better idea: let's work together to recover the crate and ensure that its contents can't hurt anyone. To protect ourselves, we're going to need a draught made from a few ingredients that can be found around the city.$B$BBuy some arcane powder from a reagent merchant, get vials from an alchemy merchant, and pick some blood nettle from the fields north of the city.
text.progress: Did you get all the ingredients?
text.completed: Return to Hudson Barnes at the Shady Lady in Stormwind.

english.completed: Return to Hudson Barnes at the Shady Lady in Stormwind.

text.title: 收货人的代表
text.objectives: 去光明大教堂下方的陵寝破坏萨纳斯同窃贼的会面。
text.description: 照昆西的说法，想要箱子的“收货人”不是别人，正是疯狂的艾萨拉大法师克希雷姆。$B$B大法师的忠实信徒打算在光明大教堂底下的陵寝里同拿着箱子的人碰头。$B$B你必须赶到那里，阻止接头，在箱子永远落入克希雷姆手中之前将其夺回来。等你得手之后，就来黄金酒桶找我。
text.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the catacombs.

english.title: The Collector's Agent
english.objectives: Disrupt the meeting between Sanath Lim-yo and the thief in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light.
english.description: According to Quincy, the "collector" who wants the crate is none other than the insane Archmage Xylem of Azshara.$B$BThe archmage's faithful servant is to meet with the man who has the crate in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light.$B$BYou must get there in time to intercept the exchange and retrieve the crate before it is lost to Xylem forever. When you have the crate, meet me at the Golden Keg.
english.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the catacombs.

text.title: What Now?
text.objectives: Return the crate to Anson Hastings at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind.$B$B-OR-$B$BReturn the crate to Hudson Barnes at the Golden Keg in Stormwind.
text.description: You've finally found the crate that Anson sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the archaeology student's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct.$B$BThere's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Hudson Barnes, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?

text.title: The Creepy Crate
text.description: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

text.title: 失踪的传家宝
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛东边码头上船搜寻雇来的送货员的船舱，查看是什么让他耽搁了。
text.description: 我叫送货员坐飞艇，可他偏不，他要搭地精的船！这下好啦，他迟到了，我家族珍贵的传家宝也没送来。$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，能不能去奥格瑞玛东边的码头那儿，登上地精船，看看是什么让他耽搁了？
text.end: Search the courier's cabin.
text.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

english.title: Missing Heirlooms
english.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship at the docks east of Orgrimmar  for evidence of what might be delaying him.
english.description: I told that courier to take the zeppelin, but no, he had to use the goblin ship! Well, now he's late and my precious family heirlooms are with him.$B$BIf you're willing to help, would you go down to the docks east of Orgrimmar, board the goblin ship and see what's keeping him?
english.end: Search the courier's cabin.
english.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

text.objectives: Make your way to Droffers and Son Salvage in Orgrimmar's Drag district and look for evidence of the crate-thief's visit.
text.description: Look, I told that shady character that there might be a shop more open to his, uh, wares in the Drag. Droffer's and Son Salvage is the name of the place.$B$BLook for Dran Droffers. He oversees the 'salvage' of rare and valuable objects from all over Azeroth.
text.completed: Speak to Delian Sunshade.
