text.end: Fully Investigate The Blood Furnace
text.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

english.title: Heart of Rage
english.objectives: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Gunny.
english.description: As it turns out, the eggheads back at Honor Hold can't see much into this place. Bunch of lying lazy mages, is what they are.$B$BEither way, we don't really know exactly what's going on in here. So, you're going in to find out!
english.completion: <You tell Gunny everything you saw in the Blood Furnace.>$B$BYou brought back some loot for ol' Gunny, right?$B$BNo, no, you're right, clearly I owe you a reward for all your hard work. Not like Gunny didn't arrange all this and send you in there in the first place.
english.end: Fully Investigate The Blood Furnace
english.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

text.title: 击碎者
text.objectives: 杀死击碎者克里丹，然后向冈尼复命。
text.description: 嗯，按照他们的说法，他们就把那个大恶魔藏在这里。有一个兽人正负责藏匿他。$B$B杀兽人就是杀兽人，对吧？不管他干了什么或者正在干什么，兽人就是该杀！
text.completion: Really? You want a reward for killing an orc? As in fame and riches and noble steeds?$B$BBack in my day killing orcs WAS the reward!
text.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
text.giverWindow: Make him suffer.

english.title: The Breaker
english.objectives: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Gunny.
english.description: So they've got this big ol' demon stashed away in this place, is what they're telling me. And there's an orc that's in charge of keeping him under wraps.$B$BKilling an orc is killing an orc, am I right? Doesn't matter what he did or what he's doin', orcs are always ripe for the slaughter!
english.completion: Really? You want a reward for killing an orc? As in fame and riches and noble steeds?$B$BBack in my day killing orcs WAS the reward!
english.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
english.giverWindow: Make him suffer.

text.title: 入侵堡垒
text.objectives: 与地狱火城墙的石头守卫斯托克顿谈谈。
text.description: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Thrallmar is going to be overrun if we don't do something about it.$B$Head west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton. He's in charge of a covert operation to start a Horde invasion on the entire citadel.
text.completion: Shatterskull's not personable by anyone's standards, but he certainly gets the job done. Let's put you to work.

english.title: Invading the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Thrallmar is going to be overrun if we don't do something about it.$B$Head west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton. He's in charge of a covert operation to start a Horde invasion on the entire citadel.
english.completion: Shatterskull's not personable by anyone's standards, but he certainly gets the job done. Let's put you to work.

text.title: 入侵堡垒
text.objectives: 与地狱火城墙的高级斥候卡德维克谈谈。
text.description: 面对燃烧军团和邪兽人的两面夹击，如果我们再不采取行动，荣耀堡的陷落只是时间问题。$B$B到西边的地狱火城墙去，与高级斥候卡德维克谈谈。他正负责策划联盟对整个堡垒的奇袭。
text.completion: That Altumus is certainly a gem, isn't she? But there won't be any of us left alive out here if we aren't successful in our efforts in the ramparts.

english.title: Invading the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Honor Hold is going to be overrun in a matter of time if we don't do something about it.$B$BHead west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Advance Scout Chadwick. He's in charge of a covert operation to start an Alliance invasion on the entire citadel.
english.completion: That Altumus is certainly a gem, isn't she? But there won't be any of us left alive out here if we aren't successful in our efforts in the ramparts.

text.title: 鲜血熔炉
text.objectives: Speak with Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
text.description: Caza'rez awaits you within the Blood Furnace. He's already cleared out a small area and has our scryers hard at work figuring out what's going on down there.$B$BBut I don't trust that scrying will be enough. I'm sure Caza'rez has plans in mind for a solid blade or two. I want you to go there and lend him your expertise in dealing with the fel orcs.

english.title: The Blood Furnace
english.objectives: Speak with Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
english.description: Caza'rez awaits you within the Blood Furnace. He's already cleared out a small area and has our scryers hard at work figuring out what's going on down there.$B$BBut I don't trust that scrying will be enough. I'm sure Caza'rez has plans in mind for a solid blade or two. I want you to go there and lend him your expertise in dealing with the fel orcs.

text.title: 鲜血熔炉
text.objectives: Speak with Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
text.description: This war is far from over. We need to stop the flow of new recruits to the fel orc front if we are to have any hope of victory.$B$BTravel to the Blood Furnace and speak with Gunny, he's secured a small area within and I'm sure he could use your assistance. Be forewarned, Gunny is...unusual.

english.title: The Blood Furnace
english.objectives: Speak with Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
english.description: This war is far from over. We need to stop the flow of new recruits to the fel orc front if we are to have any hope of victory.$B$BTravel to the Blood Furnace and speak with Gunny, he's secured a small area within and I'm sure he could use your assistance. Be forewarned, Gunny is...unusual.

text.title: 失踪的同伴
text.objectives: 调查博学者拜特和除草者格林萨姆的下落，然后向观察者杰哈恩复命。
text.description: 你一定要帮帮我！我们被派来这里调查水库的各个区域，可我的朋友们到现在都没回来，我已经等了很久了。$B$B所以我想让你去看看，他们到底出什么事了。博学者拜特和除草者格林萨姆走的就是这条路。
text.completion: The loss of life...it pains me.$B$B<Watcher Jhang sighs.>$B$BThank you, $N. When we are all reunited, the naga won't stand a chance.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.

english.title: Lost in Action
english.objectives: Discover what happened to Naturalist Bite and Weeder Greenthumb. Then, return to Watcher Jhang.
english.description: You have to help me! We were sent here to investigate the various parts of the reservoir, but my friends haven't come back yet, and it's been a long time.$B$BThat's why I need you to discover what became of them. Naturalist Bite and Weeder Greenthumb went this way.
english.completion: The loss of life...it pains me.$B$B<Watcher Jhang sighs.>$B$BThank you, $N. When we are all reunited, the naga won't stand a chance.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.

text.title: 背叛的手足
text.objectives: 杀死背叛者门努，然后向纳霍德复命。
text.description: 我的村子一开始逃过了纳迦的突袭。要不是我的兄弟，我们本来都可以逃去纳格兰的。可他出卖了我们，换取他自己的自由。$B$B现在，他就在这里充当奴隶监工，鞭笞着他自己的同胞，直到他们的背脊鲜血淋漓。去让门努付出应有的代价吧，$R。
text.completion: Mennu's death will not fix the broken backs of my family and friends, but it will give them a chance to live the rest of their lives free.
text.completed: Return to Nahuud in the Slave Pens.

english.title: A Brother Betrayed
english.objectives: Kill Mennu the Betrayer, then return to Nahuud.
english.description: My village was able to escape the naga onslaught at first. We would have all made it to Nagrand had it not been for my brother. He sold our souls for his own freedom.$B$BNow he works here as a slave driver, whipping his own brothers until their backs bleed. Make Mennu pay, $r.
english.completion: Mennu's death will not fix the broken backs of my family and friends, but it will give them a chance to live the rest of their lives free.
english.completed: Return to Nahuud in the Slave Pens.

text.title: 雪人的毛发
text.objectives: 将入侵者之爪和奴隶主之眼交给观察者杰哈恩。
text.description: 纳霍德告诉我，巨钳鲁克玛尔和夸格米拉是第一批被纳迦奴役的生物。这两个强大的生物帮助纳迦征服了许多赞加沼泽的原住民。$B$B虽然这让我很痛心，可你必须去杀了他们。
text.progress: Did you slay them?
text.completion: I'm glad that their spirits are now free. I wish we could say the same for the rest of their kind.$B$BThere is still much work to be done, especially elsewhere in Coilfang.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.
text.giverWindow: He cannot be saved.

english.title: The Heart of the Matter
english.objectives: Bring The Invader's Claw and The Slave Master's Eye to Watcher Jhang.
english.description: From what Nahuud has told me, two mighty creatures, Rokmar the Crackler and Quagmirran, were among the first enslaved by the naga when they arrived. They helped to subjugate many of the native races of Zangarmarsh.$B$BThough it pains me greatly to ask you to do so, you must put them down.
english.progress: Did you slay them?
english.completion: I'm glad that their spirits are now free. I wish we could say the same for the rest of their kind.$B$BThere is still much work to be done, especially elsewhere in Coilfang.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.
english.giverWindow: He cannot be saved.

text.title: 查探情况
text.objectives: 和奴隶围栏的观察者杰哈恩谈一谈。
text.description: 这片沼泽多美啊，你说呢？当然，除了那些正在抽空湖水的纳迦以外。$B$B为了探查纳迦的活动，我派遣了一支远征小队前往盘牙水库，但他们至今未归。我担心他们遇上了什么麻烦。$B$B你能否前往毒蛇湖下的奴隶围栏，找到观察者杰哈恩？
text.completion: What're you doing all the way down here? As you can see, it isn't exactly safe!

english.title: Checking Up
english.objectives: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.
english.description: These marshes are beautiful, wouldn't you agree? That is, except for the naga forces draining the water away.$B$BI sent a small expedition to the Coilfang Reservoir to investigate the naga, and they haven't returned. I'm concerned that something has happened to them.$B$BWould you travel to the Slave Pens underneath Serpent Lake and find Watcher Jhang?
english.completion: What're you doing all the way down here? As you can see, it isn't exactly safe!

text.title: 黑色阔步者
text.objectives: 将黑色阔步者的大脑交给塔苏。
text.description: 虽然眼下孢子巨人们一直在侵扰我的人民，但是泥沼游荡者们所残害的无辜生命比我见过的任何生物都要多。我们之间的世仇不共戴天。$B$B泥沼游荡者之母叫做黑色阔步者，栖息在这个沼地的深处。如果你能够消灭她并且将她的大脑作为凭证带回来，你的英勇事迹必将在我的子子孙孙中流传下去。
text.progress: You have returned.  Does this mean that The Black Stalker is no more?
text.completion: The Black Stalker is dead!  Normally I would not revel in such butchery, but the pain that the great mother and her brood have put my people through over the centuries is unspeakable.$B$BYou have my deepest thanks, brave $C.
text.completed: Return to T'shu in the Underbog.
text.giverWindow: Far more powerful than any other member of her brood.

english.title: Stalk the Stalker
english.objectives: Bring the Brain of the Black Stalker to T'shu.
english.description: The spore giants may be attacking my people today, but the marsh walkers have taken more innocent lives than any creature I've ever seen. They are our ancient enemies.$B$BTheir brood mother, the Black Stalker, resides deep within this bog. If you were to destroy her and bring me her brain as proof, I would tell tales of your bravery to my grandchildren.
english.progress: You have returned.  Does this mean that The Black Stalker is no more?
english.completion: The Black Stalker is dead!  Normally I would not revel in such butchery, but the pain that the great mother and her brood have put my people through over the centuries is unspeakable.$B$BYou have my deepest thanks, brave $C.
english.completed: Return to T'shu in the Underbog.
english.giverWindow: Far more powerful than any other member of her brood.

text.title: 必要之恶
text.objectives: 杀死霍加尔芬，然后向博学者拜特复命。
text.description: 霍加尔芬和夸格米拉曾经一起统治着所有的孢子巨人。夸格米拉已不在，霍加尔芬将独自承受这份负担。$B$B我们别无选择，只有在他被奴役之前，在他成为可怕的武器之前，把他击败。
text.completion: You've done all of Zangarmarsh a favor this day, $N. The spore giants may be naturally aggressive, but they're still a vital part of the ecosystem.
text.completed: Report to Naturalist Bite in the Underbog.

english.title: A Necessary Evil
english.objectives: Kill Hungarfen, then report back to Naturalist Bite.
english.description: Hungarfen and Quagmirran used to jointly rule over the spore giants. With Quagmirran gone, the burden rests solely on Hungarfen's tendrils.$B$BWe have no choice but to put the giant down before he can be enslaved and turned into a weapon.
english.completion: You've done all of Zangarmarsh a favor this day, $N. The spore giants may be naturally aggressive, but they're still a vital part of the ecosystem.
english.completed: Report to Naturalist Bite in the Underbog.

text.title: Warlord Kalithresh's Prized Possession
text.objectives: Kill Ghaz'an and bring his scale to Watcher Jhang.
text.description: Warlord Kalithresh has been utilizing the Underbog as a sort of breeding ground for Ghaz'an, a powerful hydra that he plans to unleash upon Zangarmarsh once it is fully grown.$B$BI fear nobody will be able to stop the naga if the beast reaches its full size. Find Ghaz'an and slay him for the good of us all.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.

english.title: Warlord Kalithresh's Prized Possession
english.objectives: Kill Ghaz'an and bring his scale to Watcher Jhang.
english.description: Warlord Kalithresh has been utilizing the Underbog as a sort of breeding ground for Ghaz'an, a powerful hydra that he plans to unleash upon Zangarmarsh once it is fully grown.$B$BI fear nobody will be able to stop the naga if the beast reaches its full size. Find Ghaz'an and slay him for the good of us all.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.

text.title: 救援远征小队
text.objectives: 探明缚地者雷葛和唤风者克劳恩到底遇到了什么麻烦，然后向观察者杰哈恩复命。
text.description: 我的另外两名远征小队成员一定就在此地某处。我们要想打败纳迦的话，就必须得到他们收集到的情报以及他们的技能。$B$B希望你能够找到缚地者雷葛和唤风者克劳恩，并确保他们的安全。
text.completion: Soon we'll all be together again, and I owe it all to you!$B$BWe'll bring the naga down before you know it, they don't stand a chance!
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.

english.title: Rescuing the Expedition
english.objectives: Discover what happened to Earthbinder Rayge and Windcaller Claw.  Then, return to Watcher Jhang.
english.description: The last members of my expedition are somewhere in here. We're going to need the knowledge they've gathered and their skills if we're to have any chance at defeating the naga.$B$BSee if you can find Earthbinder Rayge and Windcaller Claw, and make sure they're ok.
english.completion: Soon we'll all be together again, and I owe it all to you!$B$BWe'll bring the naga down before you know it, they don't stand a chance!
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.

text.title: 协助野性之力
text.objectives: 和幽暗沼泽内的观察者杰哈恩谈一谈。
text.description: 大地之环经常同塞纳里奥议会的德鲁伊们进行紧密合作。比如这一次。$B$B向北前往幽暗沼泽，和观察者杰哈恩谈一谈。她负责一支远征小队在盘牙水库的行动，抵抗纳迦以拯救赞加沼泽。
text.completion: The Underbog lies precariously on the edge of becoming another part of the Coilfang naga system. You must help us!

english.title: Defending the Wilds
english.objectives: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.
english.description: The Earthen Ring often finds itself working closely with the druids of the Cenarion Circle. Now is one such time.$B$BTravel north to the Underbog and speak with Watcher Jhang. She is in charge of an expedition in the Coilfang Reservoir to stop the naga there and save Zangarmarsh.
english.completion: The Underbog lies precariously on the edge of becoming another part of the Coilfang naga system. You must help us!

text.title: 安全第一
text.objectives: 工匠莫法鲁斯要你杀死10个虚灵盗墓者、5个虚灵巫师、5个节点潜行者和5个虚灵缚法者。$B$B全部搞定之后，激活沙法尔房间的前一个房间中的虚灵传送器。
text.description: 沙法尔手下的虚灵将我们完全隔绝在了法力陵墓外。不过我已经想好了对付他的法子。虽然我们无法从正门进入，但是陵墓内应该设有好几台传送器。$B$B我要你去替我的手下清理陵墓的通路，然后激活传送器，将我们传送到法力陵墓中。$B$B通路清理完毕后，直接激活沙法尔的房间前面那个房间中的传送器就可以了。放心吧，我不会让你白跑这一趟的……
text.completed: Return to Ethereal Transporter Control Panel at Hillsbrad Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Safety Is Job One
english.objectives: Artificer Morphalius wants you to kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders.$B$BOnce that's done, find the Ethereal Transporter in the chamber before Shaffar's and activate it.
english.description: Shaffar's ethereals have completely blocked us out of the Mana-Tombs. Thankfully, I've got a plan. While we can't go in through the front door, there are sure to be several transporters inside.$B$BI want you to clear the way for my crew first and then I want you to activate one of their transporters to teleport us inside.$B$BActivate the teleporter in the chamber right before Shaffar's chambers when the way has been cleared. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while...
english.completed: Return to Ethereal Transporter Control Panel at Hillsbrad Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 安全第一
text.objectives: Kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers, and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders, then return to Artificer Morphalius.
text.description: It's nearly safe for our men to come in here and take what's rightfully ours. The real danger now is Shaffar's personal army that he has crawling all over this place.$B$BI need you to take care of his forces for me while I regain my strength.
text.completion: Splendid! Haramad will be delighted to hear the good news! All of this ripe for his taking!
text.completed: Return to Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs.

english.title: Safety is Job One
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers, and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders, then return to Artificer Morphalius.
english.description: It's nearly safe for our men to come in here and take what's rightfully ours. The real danger now is Shaffar's personal army that he has crawling all over this place.$B$BI need you to take care of his forces for me while I regain my strength.
english.completion: Splendid! Haramad will be delighted to hear the good news! All of this ripe for his taking!
english.completed: Return to Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs.

text.title: 错综复杂的样本
text.objectives: 将潘德莫努斯的精华和塔瓦洛克之心交给“杂学家”玛姆迪。
text.description: 在深入大厅不远处，有一只名叫潘德莫努斯的生物能够从扭曲虚空中获取能量来维持和增强自身。$B$B而塔瓦洛克则位于陵墓更深处，它运用相同的虚空能量并将其转化成我前所未见的晶状结构体！$B$B为了做更加深入的研究，我必须得到这些样本。
text.progress: If you don't have what I'm looking for, stop wasting my time.
text.completion: These samples are absolutely fascinating. They'll work very nicely.
text.completed: Return to Mamdy the "Ologist" in the Mana Tombs.

english.title: Intriguing Specimens
english.objectives: Bring Pandemonius' Essence and Tavarok's Heart to Mamdy the "Ologist".
english.description: There is a creature not far inside these halls called Pandemonius who is able to twist void energies to sustain and empower itself.$B$BA bit further in lies Tavarok, a being that takes those same void energies and converts them into a crystalline structure stronger than any I've ever seen!$B$BI absolutely must obtain samples for further study.
english.progress: If you don't have what I'm looking for, stop wasting my time.
english.completion: These samples are absolutely fascinating. They'll work very nicely.
english.completed: Return to Mamdy the "Ologist" in the Mana Tombs.

text.title: 扫除竞争者
text.objectives: 将沙法尔的裹布交给工匠莫法鲁斯。
text.description: 节点亲王沙法尔的部队戒备森严，整装待发，完全不用费吹灰之力就可以洗劫这里所有一切有价值的东西。$B$B难怪节点亲王哈拉迈德对此非常不满，宣布重金悬赏沙法尔的性命。
text.progress: Were you interested in the bounty on Shaffar's head?
text.completion: I didn't honestly think a $R would be able to defeat a Nexus-Prince. You've surprised me, and you've earned the handsome reward you were promised.
text.completed: Return to Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs.
text.giverWindow: He is powerful, resourceful, and heavily guarded. Beware.

english.title: Undercutting the Competition
english.objectives: Bring Shaffar's Wrappings to Artificer Morphalius.
english.description: With his ward in place and his forces ready, Nexus-Prince Shaffar has been able to pillage this place for all it's worth without so much as an ounce of trouble.$B$BUnsurprisingly, Nexus-Prince Haramad isn't pleased by this, and has placed a hefty bounty on Shaffar's head.
english.progress: Were you interested in the bounty on Shaffar's head?
english.completion: I didn't honestly think a $R would be able to defeat a Nexus-Prince. You've surprised me, and you've earned the handsome reward you were promised.
english.completed: Return to Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs.
english.giverWindow: He is powerful, resourceful, and heavily guarded. Beware.

text.title: 葛雷克的噩梦
text.objectives: 和奥金顿法力陵墓里的工匠莫法鲁斯谈一谈。
text.description: 葛雷克昨晚做了个噩梦。$B$B一个发光的木乃伊闯进葛雷克的房间，还告诉葛雷克他要去奥金顿的法力陵墓。但是葛雷克正在努力认通缉令上的字呢！$B$B<葛雷克面露喜色。>$B$B葛雷克知道了！你去找那个发光的木乃伊然后告诉他是葛雷克叫你来的。真是完美的计划！
text.completion: That meathead send you instead?$B$B<Artificer Morphalius looks you over.>$B$BI suppose you'll have to do.

english.title: Grek's Crazy Night
english.objectives: Speak with Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun.
english.description: Grek had bad night last night.$B$BShiny mummy man came into Grek's house and told Grek that he had to go to Mana Tombs in Auchindoun. But Grek still trying to read wanted poster!$B$B<Grek's face lights up.>$B$BGrek knows! You go find shiny mummy man and tell him Grek sent you. It perfect plan!
english.completion: That meathead send you instead?$B$B<Artificer Morphalius looks you over.>$B$BI suppose you'll have to do.

text.title: 疯子埃克尔特
text.objectives: 和奥金顿法力陵墓里的工匠莫法鲁斯谈一谈。
text.description: I'm a skilled engineer, a brilliant inventor, the heart of any party, and the best dancer Azeroth has ever seen.$B$BDo they call me those things? No.$B$BBut you have one run-in with a ethereal and all of the sudden everyone and their mother calls you "the mad".$B$BI saw one right here just yesterday, I swear it! He said if I followed him to the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun there would be vast treasure and ancient knowledge awaiting me!
text.completion: I was truly hoping that the gnome I sought out would be the one to answer my call.$B$B<Artificer Morphalius looks you over.>$B$BI suppose you'll do.

english.title: Eckert the Mad
english.objectives: Speak with Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun.
english.description: I'm a skilled engineer, a brilliant inventor, the heart of any party, and the best dancer Azeroth has ever seen.$B$BDo they call me those things? No.$B$BBut you have one run-in with a ethereal and all of the sudden everyone and their mother calls you "the mad".$B$BI saw one right here just yesterday, I swear it! He said if I followed him to the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun there would be vast treasure and ancient knowledge awaiting me!
english.completion: I was truly hoping that the gnome I sought out would be the one to answer my call.$B$B<Artificer Morphalius looks you over.>$B$BI suppose you'll do.

text.title: 死亡观察者
text.objectives: 杀死死亡观察者希尔拉克，然后向德莱尼灵魂复命。
text.description: 一只阴森恐怖的生物逡巡于灵魂和现世的国度之间。它被称为希尔拉克。$B$B只有在现实世界中，它才能被杀死。请帮助我们摆脱这场梦魇。
text.completion: Perhaps now we can finally be at peace.
text.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit in the Auchenai Crypts.

english.title: The Dead Watcher
english.objectives: Kill Shirrak the Dead Watcher, then return to the Draenei Spirit.
english.description: A terrifying otherworldly being haunts both the spirit and physical worlds. We call it Shirrak.$B$BIt can only be harmed in your realm. Please help rid us of this nightmare.
english.completion: Perhaps now we can finally be at peace.
english.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit in the Auchenai Crypts.

text.title: 暴怒的灵魂
text.objectives: 干掉5个被激怒的骷髅，5个暴怒的骷髅，以及3个奥金尼通灵师，然后去找位于奥金尼地穴里的受折磨的灵魂牧师。
text.description: 奥金尼已经背弃了我们过去所尊崇的一切。他们不断地将死者复活成邪恶的仆从！$B$B这是决不能容忍的。让灵魂好好安息，然后干掉那些将灵魂变成亡灵的人。
text.completion: The dead belong in the spirit realm. Just as you belong in this one.
text.completed: Return to the Tormented Soulpriest in the Auchenai Crypts.

english.title: Raging Spirits
english.objectives: Slay 5 Angered Skeletons, 5 Raging Skeletons, and 3 Auchenai Necromancers, then return to the Tormented Soulpriest in Auchenai Crypts.
english.description: The Auchenai have turned their backs on everything we used to stand for. They've taken to raising the dead as unholy minions!$B$BThis cannot stand. Put the spirits back to rest, and massacre those responsible for raising them into undeath.
english.completion: The dead belong in the spirit realm. Just as you belong in this one.
english.completed: Return to the Tormented Soulpriest in the Auchenai Crypts.

text.title: 雪上加霜
text.objectives: 偷走3堆地狱火补给品，然后回地狱火城墙找石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 邪兽人在这里囤积了不少补给物。$B$B偷走这些东西会对他们的备战造成重大打击，而我们也将从中受益。你准备好接受这个任务了吗，$C？
text.progress: How many piles were you able to take?
text.completion: Well done! The long term effects of this attack will be far worse than slaying a few orcs could ever be.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.

english.title: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
english.objectives: Steal 3 piles of Hellfire Supplies, then return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: The fel orcs have stockpiled many of their supplies here.$B$BStealing them would be a severe blow to their war effort and a great boon to ours. Are you up to the task, $c?
english.progress: How many piles were you able to take?
english.completion: Well done! The long term effects of this attack will be far worse than slaying a few orcs could ever be.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.

text.title: 雪上加霜
text.objectives: 偷走3堆地狱火补给品，然后回地狱火城墙找高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 邪兽人在这里囤积了不少补给物。$B$B偷走这些东西会对他们的备战造成重大打击，而我们也将从中受益。你准备好接受这个任务了吗，$C？
text.progress: How many piles were you able to take?
text.completion: Well done! The long term effects of this attack will be far worse than slaying a few orcs could ever be.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.

english.title: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
english.objectives: Steal 3 piles of Hellfire Supplies, then return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: The fel orcs have stockpiled many of their supplies here.$B$BStealing them would be a severe blow to their war effort and a great boon to ours. Are you up to the task, $c?
english.progress: How many piles were you able to take?
english.completion: Well done! The long term effects of this attack will be far worse than slaying a few orcs could ever be.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.

text.title: 一切都会变好的
text.objectives: 奥金顿的奥金尼地穴外的奥德里姆斯宗父希望你能进入奥金尼地穴，跟德莱尼灵魂交谈。
text.description: 早在进入奥金尼地穴之前，你已经经历了不少冒险，$N。$B$B我是个幸运的灵魂。既没有被利维休斯所束缚，也没有变成大主教玛拉达尔邪恶的通灵实验的实验品。虽然你已经消灭了利维休斯，但玛拉达尔还继续活着，继续折磨地穴里的灵魂。$B$B我的要求很简单。进入奥金尼地穴，与里面的德莱尼灵魂交谈。你必须消灭大主教玛拉达尔。
text.completion: Welcome to the Auchenai Crypts, $N, where our two worlds meet.
text.completed: Return to Greatfather Aldrimus at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest.

english.title: Everything Will Be Alright
english.objectives: Greatfather Aldrimus standing outside the Auchenai Crypts of Auchindoun has asked that you enter the Auchenai Crypts and speak with the Draenei Spirit.
english.description: You've had quite an adventure, $N. And before you've even set foot inside of the Auchenai Crypts.$B$BI am one of the fortunate spirits. I was neither bound to Levixus nor a part of Exarch Maladaar's vile experiments in necromancy. While you have destroyed Levixus, Maladaar lives on, continuing to torment the spirits inside the crypts.$B$BWhat I ask is simple. Enter the Auchenai Crypts and speak with the Draenei Spirit there. You must destroy Exarch Maladaar.
english.completion: Welcome to the Auchenai Crypts, $N, where our two worlds meet.
english.completed: Return to Greatfather Aldrimus at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest.

text.title: 主教之陨
text.objectives: 杀死大主教玛拉达尔，然后向奥金尼地穴内的德莱尼灵魂复命。
text.description: 在地穴的最深处，大主教玛拉达尔正在进行着他那邪恶的勾当。如果我们不阻止他，他对生者和死者的世界都是严重的威胁。$B$B为了这两个世界的利益，你必须除掉他。
text.completion: You have done our realm a great service. You will not be forgotten.
text.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
text.giverWindow: It is time for him to pay.

english.title: The End of the Exarch
english.objectives: Kill Exarch Maladaar and return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
english.description: Exarch Maladaar performs his unholy work in the deepest part of the crypts. He poses a threat to both of our worlds if he is not stopped.$B$BYou must slay him for the benefit of us all, dead and alive.
english.completion: You have done our realm a great service. You will not be forgotten.
english.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
english.giverWindow: It is time for him to pay.

text.title: 主教之陨
text.objectives: 杀死大主教玛拉达尔，然后向奥金尼地穴内的德莱尼灵魂复命。
text.description: 在地穴的最深处，大主教玛拉达尔正在进行着他那邪恶的勾当。如果我们不阻止他，他对生者和死者的世界都是严重的威胁。$B$B为了这两个世界的利益，你必须除掉他。
text.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.

english.title: The End of the Exarch
english.objectives: Kill Exarch Maladaar and return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
english.description: Exarch Maladaar performs his unholy work in the deepest part of the crypts. He poses a threat to both of our worlds if he is not stopped.$B$BYou must slay him for the benefit of us all, dead and alive.
english.completed: Return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.

text.title: 塔蕾莎的计谋
text.objectives: 进入敦霍尔德城堡，将伊洛希恩交给你的燃烧弹包分别放入5间收容所内的木桶，并启动定时装置。$B$B引爆燃烧弹后，与被关押在敦霍尔德城堡地牢中的萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 原本，塔蕾莎在敦霍尔德采用声东击西的战术，帮助萨尔得以逃脱。$B$B可现在永恒之龙囚禁了塔蕾莎。如果我们不插手的话，塔蕾莎就无法使用她的计谋，萨尔也就无法逃跑了。你必须用我给你的燃烧弹烧毁收容所。
text.completion: You are friends of Taretha? So this is her new plan? Very well then...
text.completed: Return to Thrall.
text.giverWindow: He needs your help!

english.title: Taretha's Diversion
english.objectives: Travel to Durnholde Keep and set 5 incendiary charges at the barrels located inside each of the internment lodges using the Pack of Incendiary Bombs given to you by Erozion.$B$BSpeak to Thrall in the basement prison of Durnholde Keep when you have the Internment Lodges Set Ablaze.
english.description: It was Taretha who created the original diversion at Durnholde, allowing Thrall to escape.$B$BNow the Infinite have captured Taretha. The diversion will not happen without our involvement. You must use the incendiary devices that I give you and burn down the internment lodges.
english.completion: You are friends of Taretha? So this is her new plan? Very well then...
english.completed: Return to Thrall.
english.giverWindow: He needs your help!

text.title: 逃离敦霍尔德
text.objectives: 准备就绪后告知萨尔。跟随萨尔离开敦霍尔德城堡，并帮助他解救塔蕾莎，履行自己的使命。$B$B完成任务后，与旧希尔斯布莱德丘陵的伊洛希恩交谈。
text.description: 陌生人，我已经为我的同胞们打算好了。$B$B总有一天，他们将会推翻压迫者，重新崛起。他们将要打破枷锁，重建兽人部落。$B$B你准备好之后，我们就走。
text.completion: You have done a great thing, $N. Alas, the young warchief's memory of these events must be as they originally were...
text.completed: Return to Erozion in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Escape from Durnholde
english.objectives: When you are ready to proceed, let Thrall know. Follow Thrall out of Durnholde Keep and help him free Taretha and fulfill his destiny.$B$BSpeak with Erozion in Old Hillsbrad should you complete this task.
english.description: I have plans for my people, stranger.$B$BOne day, they shall overthrow their oppressors and rise as one. They will break free from the bonds that hold them and from that uprising shall be born the orcish Horde.$B$BWe will leave when you are ready.
english.completion: You have done a great thing, $N. Alas, the young warchief's memory of these events must be as they originally were...
english.completed: Return to Erozion in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: The Darkmoon Field Guide
text.description: Do you have a copy of the Darkmoon Field Guide, friend? It's a most useful book to carry with you.$B$BIt can help you find and identify valuable artifacts throughout your travels in Azeroth. Its detailed descriptions make it easy to decide if you've found your five hundredth brass button or that rare treasure the Darkmoon Faire's collectors crave.

english.title: The Darkmoon Field Guide
english.description: Do you have a copy of the Darkmoon Field Guide, friend? It's a most useful book to carry with you.$B$BIt can help you find and identify valuable artifacts throughout your travels in Azeroth. Its detailed descriptions make it easy to decide if you've found your five hundredth brass button or that rare treasure the Darkmoon Faire's collectors crave.

text.title: 兄弟反目
text.objectives: 救出拉卡。完成任务之后，向塞泰克大厅的伊斯法尔复命。
text.description: 奥金顿爆炸之后，塞泰克就从斯克提斯中分裂了出去。$B$B我的兄弟塞斯就是他们的领袖之一。他告诉我，我们必须进入废墟，迎接我们的神。$B$B不久，塞斯就因为我质疑他们而将我放逐出了大厅，但他拒绝让我带走我们的妹妹拉卡。你能帮我救救她吗？
text.completion: Knowing that Lakka is free means I can cut the rest of my ties to the Sethekk.$B$BPart of me will never forgive myself for Syth's death, but it had to be done. When I reach Skettis, I will perform the death rites for him.
text.completed: Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.

english.title: Brother Against Brother
english.objectives: Free Lakka from captivity. Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls when you've completed the rescue.
english.description: The Sethekk departed Skettis when Auchindoun exploded.$B$BMy brother, Syth, was one of their leaders and told us we had to go into the ruins and face our god.$B$BIn time, Syth had me cast out of the Halls for doubting them, but he refused to let me take our sister Lakka. Will you help me rescue her?
english.completion: Knowing that Lakka is free means I can cut the rest of my ties to the Sethekk.$B$BPart of me will never forgive myself for Syth's death, but it had to be done. When I reach Skettis, I will perform the death rites for him.
english.completed: Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.

text.title: 泰罗克的传说
text.objectives: 将泰罗克的面具和泰罗克的羽毛交给塞泰克大厅的伊斯法尔。
text.description: 泰罗克是鸦人的英雄，他在某一天神秘消失了，只留下了他的面具和长矛。$B$B黑暗编织者塞斯仍然收藏着他的面具，而利爪之王艾吉斯看守着他的长矛。$B$B这些圣物对我的族人来说意义重大，希望你能帮我们把它们夺回来。
text.progress: The relics of Terokk have been absent from Skettis for too long. Were you able to recover them from the Sethekk?
text.completion: I may never truly be forgiven for my role in the crimes of the Sethekk, but perhaps by restoring the relics of Terokk to my people, I can begin to redeem myself.
text.completed: Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.
text.giverWindow: He surely holds Terokk's Quill.

english.title: Terokk's Legacy
english.objectives: Bring Terokk's Mask and Terokk's Quill to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.
english.description: Terokk, hero of the Arakkoa, mysteriously vanished one day, leaving only his mask and spear behind.$B$BDarkweaver Syth still holds his mask and Talon King Ikiss guards his spear.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to my people if these items were returned to us.
english.progress: The relics of Terokk have been absent from Skettis for too long. Were you able to recover them from the Sethekk?
english.completion: I may never truly be forgiven for my role in the crimes of the Sethekk, but perhaps by restoring the relics of Terokk to my people, I can begin to redeem myself.
english.completed: Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.
english.giverWindow: He surely holds Terokk's Quill.

text.title: 欲望之眼
text.objectives: 塞泰克大厅的商人维嘉德要你给他带去3颗冰蓝之眼。
text.description: 我认识一个买家，对生活在这里的蓝色毒蛇之眼很有兴趣。$B$B如果你能帮我弄到这种珍稀的宝石，我可以分给你一部分利润。$B$B你看呢？
text.progress: Did you bring the eyes?
text.completion: These are marvelous. Well done!$B$BHere's your cut, as promised.
text.completed: Return to Dealer Vijad inside the Sethekk Halls.

english.title: Eyes of Desire
english.objectives: Dealer Vijad inside the Sethekk Halls wants you to bring him 3 Cobalt Eyes.
english.description: I have a buyer who is interested in the eyes of the Cobalt Serpents that have taken up residence here.$B$BIf you were to bring me some of these rare gems, I would cut you a portion of the profits.$B$BDo we have a deal?
english.progress: Did you bring the eyes?
english.completion: These are marvelous. Well done!$B$BHere's your cut, as promised.
english.completed: Return to Dealer Vijad inside the Sethekk Halls.

text.title: 达拉然的盟友
text.objectives: 骑着狮鹫前往达拉然，找到英雄之家的伊丝拉米·轻风并跟她对话。
text.description: 欢迎来到诺森德，$N。我负责安排你前往达拉然，你可以在那里与我们的盟友汇合。$B$B骑上狮鹫前往达拉然，着陆后就去我们的旅店英雄之家。第一时间找伊丝拉米·轻风，她有话跟你说。$B$B她还会帮你把炉石绑在城里，这样你就可以使用银色领地的传送门快速往返暴风城了。
text.completion: Welcome to Dalaran! This inn is part of the Silver Enclave, the headquarters of the official Alliance presence in our city.$B$BDon't forget to bind your hearthstone here for easy travel to the city and access to the portal to Stormwind next door.

english.title: Allies in Dalaran
english.objectives: Accept a gryphon ride to Dalaran and speak with Isirami Fairwind at A Hero's Welcome.
english.description: Welcome to Northrend, $N. I have been asked to arrange travel for you to Dalaran so that you can meet with our allies there.$B$BRide the gryphon to Dalaran and once you land, make your way to our inn there, A Hero's Welcome. Find Isirami Fairwind and speak with her immediately.$B$BShe can help you bind your hearthstone to the city so you can use the Silver Enclave's portal to travel back to Stormwind quickly.
english.completion: Welcome to Dalaran! This inn is part of the Silver Enclave, the headquarters of the official Alliance presence in our city.$B$BDon't forget to bind your hearthstone here for easy travel to the city and access to the portal to Stormwind next door.

text.title: 达拉然的朋友
text.objectives: 从飞行大师处飞往达拉然，并且与“肮脏的野兽”里的兽女乌达谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎来到诺森德。我受托为你安排好前往达拉然的旅程，去见一见我们在那座城市的朋友们。$B$B在你准备好飞去达拉然的时候告诉我一声。你着陆之后，去一趟“肮脏的野兽”旅店。$B$B尽快和兽女乌达取得联系。$B$B她会帮助你把炉石绑定在达拉然，你就可以很便捷地使用夺日者圣殿的传送门回到奥格瑞玛了。
text.completion: I've been expecting you! This inn is part of Sunreaver's Sanctuary, the Horde's enclave in Dalaran.$B$BDon't forget to bind your hearthstone here for easy travel to the city and access to the portal to Orgrimmar, out by the fountain.

english.title: Friends in Dalaran
english.objectives: Accept a ride to Dalaran from the flight master and speak with Uda the Beast at The Filthy Animal.
english.description: Welcome to Northrend. I have been asked to arrange travel for you to Dalaran so that you can meet our friends in the city.$B$BSpeak with me and accept a ride to Dalaran. Once you land, make your way to The Filthy Animal.$B$BMake contact with Uda the Beast immediately.$B$BShe can help you bind your hearthstone to the city so you can use the portal in Sunreaver's Sanctuary to travel back to Orgrimmar quickly.
english.completion: I've been expecting you! This inn is part of Sunreaver's Sanctuary, the Horde's enclave in Dalaran.$B$BDon't forget to bind your hearthstone here for easy travel to the city and access to the portal to Orgrimmar, out by the fountain.

text.title: 罪有应得
text.objectives: 杀死督军卡利瑟里斯，然后向蒸汽地窖内的观察者杰哈恩复命。
text.description: 督军卡利瑟里斯掌管整个蒸汽地窖的运作。$B$B我要你干掉他，$N。这个纳迦已经逼得我们别无他法，只能使用暴力。$B$B对他绝不手软。
text.completion: I wish it had not come to this, but the naga refused all attempts to negotiate.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang inside the Steamvault.
text.giverWindow: He must be stopped!

english.title: A Proper Fate
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Kalithresh and return to Watcher Jhang inside the Steamvault.
english.description: Warlord Kalithresh is in charge of the entire Steamvault operation.$B$BI need you to kill him, $N. The naga have left us with no option but violence.$B$BShow him no mercy.
english.completion: I wish it had not come to this, but the naga refused all attempts to negotiate.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang inside the Steamvault.
english.giverWindow: He must be stopped!

text.title: 遏制是关键
text.objectives: 杀死3个泥沼主宰和6个盘牙麻疯者，并取得机械师斯蒂里格的被辐射过的齿轮，然后向蒸汽地窖的博学者拜特复命。
text.description: 纳迦正在与麻风侏儒狼狈为奸，想把一种恐怖的疾病散播整个赞加沼泽。这种疾病已经在蒸汽地窖中散播开来。$B$B赶快行动，把所有受到感染的生物清除干净，并且把机械师斯蒂里格的被辐射过的齿轮拿回来交给我。
text.progress: Be as thorough as possible. The fate of Zangarmarsh depends on it.
text.completion: I'm glad we were able to contain this before it spread across all of Zangarmarsh or further. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Naturalist Bite inside the Steamvault.

english.title: Containment is Key
english.objectives: Kill 3 Bog Overlords, 6 Coilfang Lepers, and obtain an Irradiated Gear from Mekgineer Steamrigger, then return to Naturalist Bite inside the Steamvault.
english.description: The naga are working with leper gnomes to spread a horrific disease across Zangarmarsh. It's already spread throughout the Steamvault.$B$BClear out anything that's been contaminated and bring me the central gear from Mekgineer Steamrigger, quickly!
english.progress: Be as thorough as possible. The fate of Zangarmarsh depends on it.
english.completion: I'm glad we were able to contain this before it spread across all of Zangarmarsh or further. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Naturalist Bite inside the Steamvault.

text.title: 唤风者克劳恩与窃水者
text.objectives: 杀死水术师瑟丝比娅，然后向蒸汽地窖里的唤风者克劳恩复命。
text.description: 蒸汽地窖是纳迦从赞加沼泽抽取水资源行动的核心，水术师瑟丝比娅监督着这些行动的进行。$B$B如果她被除掉的话，纳迦的行动就将受到严重的打击。
text.completion: Perhaps now we can restore all of the desperately needed water to the land.
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Claw inside the Steamvault.

english.title: Windcaller Claw and the Water Thief
english.objectives: Kill Hydromancer Thespia and return to Windcaller Claw inside the Steamvault.
english.description: The Steamvault is the heart of the naga's efforts to pump the water out of Zangarmarsh, and Hydromancer Thespia personally oversees those efforts.$B$BTaking her out would seriously hinder their operation.
english.completion: Perhaps now we can restore all of the desperately needed water to the land.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Claw inside the Steamvault.

text.title: 进攻蒸汽地窖
text.objectives: 和蒸汽地窖里的观察者杰哈恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我们还未能阻止在蒸汽地窖中的纳迦的行动，他们绝大多数的抽水器械都在那里。$B$B幸好，我派遣的远征小队正在努力改变这些情况。你愿意前往蒸汽地窖援助观察者杰哈恩和他的手下吗？
text.completion: Thank the stars you're here. We need your help!

english.title: Storming the Steamvault
english.objectives: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Steamvault.
english.description: We have not as of yet been able to stop the naga in the Steamvault, where most of their pumping infrastructure is located.$B$BThankfully, the expedition I sent there is hard at work trying to change that fact. Will you travel to the Steamvault and offer Watcher Jhang and her crew your aid?
english.completion: Thank the stars you're here. We need your help!

text.title: 寻找间谍托古恩
text.objectives: 进入奥金顿的暗影迷宫，寻找间谍托古恩的下落。
text.description: 暗影议会已经杀死了我们绝大多数的间谍。托古恩虽然得以逃脱，却居然又返回这里并深入了暗影迷宫。他这么做太愚蠢了！$B$B你必须找到他。他或许是个鲁莽的家伙，但我们必须得到他收集到的情报。
text.completion: Do you think you could help me get out of this cage?  It's a bit cramped.

english.title: Find Spy To'gun
english.objectives: Locate Spy To'gun in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: The Shadow Council has already killed most of our spies, but To'gun was foolish enough to escape only to go back in!$B$BYou must find him. He may be reckless, but we need to find out what he knows.
english.completion: Do you think you could help me get out of this cage?  It's a bit cramped.

text.title: 灵魂装置
text.objectives: 偷走5台灵魂装置，把它们交给在奥金顿暗影迷宫内的间谍格利克萨。
text.description: 他们对我百般磨难，逼迫我说出所知晓的一切。$B$B他们把其他人都送去给了赫尔默，现在该轮到我了。但我什么都没有说！$B$B他们利用一种特殊装置使自己的召唤能力变得更加强大。你必须偷走他们的装置！
text.progress: Were you able to find To'gun?
text.completion: So, these are the soul devices that the Shadow Council were using to enhance their summoning power?  Intriguing.
text.completed: Return to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: The Soul Devices
english.objectives: Steal 5 Soul Devices and deliver them to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: They've been torturing me, trying to get me to tell them everything that I know.$B$BThey fed the others to Hellmaw, and I was to be next. But I told them nothing!$B$BThey're using special devices to make their summoning more powerful. You must steal these devices!
english.progress: Were you able to find To'gun?
english.completion: So, these are the soul devices that the Shadow Council were using to enhance their summoning power?  Intriguing.
english.completed: Return to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 奥金顿的麻烦
text.objectives: 返回泰罗卡森林向奥金顿暗影迷宫里的战地指挥官玛弗恩报道。
text.description: 我在奥金顿的探子给我发来了令人困扰的信息。自从多年以前的一场爆炸以后，那里就成了满是麻烦的是非之地。$B$B那里一定是又出了什么大事，因为暗影议会目前正处于紧张的备战状态。尽管细节内容尚未明确，但他们的军事准备显然在针对暗影迷宫内部。$B$B你必须前往暗影迷宫，战地指挥官玛弗恩会告诉你该做什么。
text.completion: It's about time that you arrived.$B$BMehlisah said that she would be sending help days ago.  And we've been fighting in here longer than that!

english.title: Trouble at Auchindoun
english.objectives: Report to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: I have spies within Auchindoun and they have been sending me disturbing reports.  That place has been nothing but trouble ever since it exploded a couple of years ago.$B$BSomething in there has gone horribly wrong - again - and the Shadow Council is now on a war footing.  Though the reports were lacking on details, their preparations appear to be directed inward.$B$BYou must make your way to the Shadow Labyrinth.  My field commander, Mahfuun, will fill you in on what needs to be done.
english.completion: It's about time that you arrived.$B$BMehlisah said that she would be sending help days ago.  And we've been fighting in here longer than that!

starters.name: 间谍女王梅丽萨·海克隆

text.title: 鲜血法典
text.objectives: 阅读奥金顿暗影迷宫中的鲜血法典。
text.description: 两年以前，暗影议会进行了一场召唤仪式。正是他们所召唤生物的觉醒把奥金顿化为废墟。$B$B必须要阅读鲜血法典才能确切知道发生了什么。小心行事，沃匹尔大师毕生保护着法典。
text.completion: Opening the magically-suspended tome, a sense of dread overwhelms you.$B$BSomething is most definitely wrong here!

english.title: The Codex of Blood
english.objectives: Read from the Codex of Blood in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: Two years ago the Shadow Council summoned forth a being that shattered Auchindoun in its wake.$B$BRead the Codex of Blood to find out what happened. Be warned, Grandmaster Vorpil guards it with his life.
english.completion: Opening the magically-suspended tome, a sense of dread overwhelms you.$B$BSomething is most definitely wrong here!

text.title: 深入迷宫
text.objectives: 消灭摩摩尔并通知奥金顿暗影迷宫内的战地指挥官玛弗恩。
text.description: 暗影议会在两年前召唤了一个虚空生物，现在他们失去了对它的控制。$B$B这只名叫摩摩尔的怪物已经威胁到了暗影议会，并可能闯入外部世界！
text.completion: I cringe to think what would have happened had Murmur escaped to the outside world.$B$BThank you, brave hero.
text.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: Into the Heart of the Labyrinth
english.objectives: Destroy Murmur and inform Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: The Shadow Council has lost control of the cosmic being that they summoned here almost two years ago.$B$BKnown only as Murmur, it threatens to overrun the Shadow Council and break free into the outside world!
english.completion: I cringe to think what would have happened had Murmur escaped to the outside world.$B$BThank you, brave hero.
english.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 赫尔默大使
text.objectives: Kill 18 Cabal Ritualists and Ambassador Hellmaw, then return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
text.description: 秘教徒每次发现我们的间谍，就会把他们送到赫尔默大使那里去。$B$B我们的人需要公正。把那些听命于大使的教徒杀了，然后击败赫尔默本人。$B$B他是罪有应得。
text.completion: It won't bring anyone back, but at least justice has been done.
text.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: Ambassador Hellmaw
english.objectives: Kill 18 Cabal Ritualists and Ambassador Hellmaw, then return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: When the Cabal found our spies, they fed them to Ambassador Hellmaw one by one.$B$BOur men deserve justice. Slay the ritualists binding him, then dispose of Hellmaw.$B$BIt is a most deserving fate.
english.completion: It won't bring anyone back, but at least justice has been done.
english.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 如何拯救一条生命
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克希望你能帮他带回一份邪能灰烬。
text.description: 冈尼快被一种强大的诅咒折磨死了，$N。$B$B一对神秘的火盆强化了高阶术士奈瑟库斯的能力。如果你能帮我从那个火盆中带回一份灰烬，也许还能对抗这种黑暗魔法。
text.progress: Did you bring the ember? We don't have much time!
text.completion: He was a good soldier.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: How to Save a Life
english.objectives: Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
english.description: Gunny is dying from a powerful curse, $N.$B$BGrand Warlock Nethekurse augments his power with a pair of mystical braziers. If you bring me an ember from that brazier, perhaps it can counteract the dark magic?
english.progress: Did you bring the ember? We don't have much time!
english.completion: He was a good soldier.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 邪能灰烬
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿希望你能帮他带回一份邪能灰烬。
text.description: 卡萨雷兹不该受到这样的折磨。$B$B高阶术士奈瑟库斯对他下了恶咒。如果你能从他的火盆中拿来一份灰烬，也许我们还来得及对抗这种魔法。
text.progress: Did you bring the ember? Caza'rez deserves a warrior's death.
text.completion: I will sing many songs of his glories.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: Fel Ember
english.objectives: Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
english.description: Caza'rez is dying a coward's death.$B$BGrand Warlock Netherkurse placed a terrible curse upon him. Perhaps if you were to bring me one of the embers from his braziers, we could use it to counteract the magic before it's too late?
english.progress: Did you bring the ember? Caza'rez deserves a warrior's death.
english.completion: I will sing many songs of his glories.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 安息
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的卡萨雷兹要你杀死4个碎手军团士兵、2个碎手百夫长和2个碎手勇士。
text.description: Their elite warriors are ruthless...so... powerful.$B$B<Caza'rez spits up blood.>$B$BYou have to kill them...or we will never defeat Kargath...$B$B$B$B
text.completion: Caza'rez...is no more.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: Honor the Dying
english.objectives: Caza'rez inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
english.description: Their elite warriors are ruthless...so... powerful.$B$B<Caza'rez spits up blood.>$B$BYou have to kill them...or we will never defeat Kargath...$B$B$B$B
english.completion: Caza'rez...is no more.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 最后的请求
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的冈尼要你杀死4个碎手军团士兵，2个碎手百夫长和2个碎手勇士。
text.description: 老冈尼的日子不多了……$B$B帮我最后一个忙，杀掉那些最强壮、最凶残的邪兽人。$B$B就当为了我们往日的情谊，怎么样？
text.completion: If only we could have saved him.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: One Last Favor
english.objectives: Gunny inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
english.description: Ol' Gunny doesn't have much longer...$B$BDo me one last favor, and kill the biggest, meanest fel orcs ye can find.$B$BFor old times' sake, aye?
english.completion: If only we could have saved him.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 酋长的意志
text.objectives: 把卡加斯酋长之拳带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 卡加斯曾是部落最伟大的英雄之一。$B$B可他现在成了邪恶的酋长。把那把以他的名字命名的武器给我拿来，这样他在我们的心目中就永远是那个勇士，而不是后来的那个怪物。
text.progress: Have you proof of Kargath Bladefist's defeat?
text.completion: We should not forget the orc Kargath once was, nor the lessons to be learned from his downfall.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
text.giverWindow: His will is no longer his own.

english.title: The Will of the Warchief
english.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Kargath was once one of the Horde's greatest heroes.$B$BHe now wears the false mantle of Warchief. Bring me his namesake weapon so that we can remember the champion he once was, rather than the monster he's become.
english.progress: Have you proof of Kargath Bladefist's defeat?
english.completion: We should not forget the orc Kargath once was, nor the lessons to be learned from his downfall.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.giverWindow: His will is no longer his own.

text.title: 扭转战局
text.objectives: 把卡加斯酋长之拳带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 只有一种方法能彻底终结邪兽人对联盟和荣耀堡的威胁。$B$B必须杀死他们的酋长。$B$B给我带来以他的名字命名的武器，这样我们就会永远记住他的死。
text.progress: Have you returned with proof of 'Warchief' Kargath Bladefist's demise?
text.completion: We have struck a major blow against the enemy with your help.$B$BHonor Hold is far safer than it's been in years.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
text.giverWindow: Eliminating him is a key goal in this war.

english.title: Turning the Tide
english.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: There is only one true way to end the fel orc threat to Honor Hold and the Alliance.$B$BTheir Warchief must be slain.$B$BBring me his namesake weapon, so that we can always remember his death.
english.progress: Have you returned with proof of 'Warchief' Kargath Bladefist's demise?
english.completion: We have struck a major blow against the enemy with your help.$B$BHonor Hold is far safer than it's been in years.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.giverWindow: Eliminating him is a key goal in this war.

text.title: 特殊的布
text.objectives: 杀死战争使者沃姆罗格，把他的战袍带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 战争使者沃姆罗格杀死了无数勇敢的战士，我从没见过这样的对手。他冷血狡诈，极为强大。$B$B干掉他，把他的战袍给我带来，我们可以把它做成旗帜，让敌人看看部落的怒火！
text.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
text.completion: Well done. This will show those blood crazed monsters what they're up against.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: A Very Special Cloth
english.objectives: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Warbringer O'mrogg has killed more brave soldiers than any enemy I've ever encountered. He is ruthless, cunning, and extremely powerful.$B$BTake him down and bring me his warcloth so that we may fashion it into a banner and show them the fury of the Horde!
english.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
english.completion: Well done. This will show those blood crazed monsters what they're up against.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 沃姆罗格的战袍
text.objectives: 杀死战争使者沃姆罗格，把他的战袍带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 暴风城想要看看我们在战场上的成果。$B$B与其把一个一个装尸袋拿出来，还不如把最强大的战士——战争使者沃姆罗格的战袍给他们看看。你能对付他吗？
text.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
text.completion: My superiors will be very pleased to see this. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: O'mrogg's Warcloth
english.objectives: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Stormwind wants to see proof of our successes in the war effort.$B$BRather than showing him body bags, I thought we'd present him the warcloth of O'mrogg, Kargath's fiercest warrior. Think you can handle him?
english.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
english.completion: My superiors will be very pleased to see this. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 能力越强，责任越大
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的能源舰，杀死机械领主卡帕西图斯。
text.description: <你的脑海中响起一个银铃般的声音。>$B$B能源舰使用我们一族的科技制造了魔法晶格，这种东西能提供强大的能量。$B$B我要你去消灭机械领主卡帕西图斯，这样凯尔萨斯就没法获得这种能量了。
text.completion: You have done well, $N. But more work remains to be done.
text.giverWindow: Do not be alarmed.
text.turninWindow: Our work here is not yet complete.

english.title: With Great Power, Comes Great Responsibility
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Mechano-Lord Capacitus in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: <A voice like the sound of light bells rings in your head.>$B$BThe Mechanar employs my race's technology to create manacells, objects which provide great amounts of power.$B$BI need you to eliminate Mechano-Lord Capacitus so that Kael'thas' forces cannot harvest that power.
english.completion: You have done well, $N. But more work remains to be done.
english.giverWindow: Do not be alarmed.
english.turninWindow: Our work here is not yet complete.

text.title: 计算者
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的能源舰，杀死计算者帕萨雷恩。
text.description: <清风拂过你的脸庞。>$B$B还有一个任务没完成。$B$B计算者帕萨雷恩替他的主子监督着许多行动。最近的大部分灾难都是他一手造成的。$B$B我要你去消灭他。
text.giverWindow: You must enact my will.
text.turninWindow: Hope yet remains.

english.title: The Calculator
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Pathaleon the Calculator in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: <A gentle wind caresses your face.>$B$BOne more task yet remains.$B$BPathaleon the Calculator oversees many of his master's operations. He is personally responsible for much of the recent torment that has plagued this world.$B$BI ask that you eliminate him.
english.giverWindow: You must enact my will.
english.turninWindow: Hope yet remains.

text.title: 丢失的宝物
text.objectives: 前往风暴要塞的能源舰，为阿达尔拿回军团宝箱中的光耀之怒。
text.description: 我能感觉到，我们族人的一件神器被人偷走并藏到了军团宝箱中。$B$B我们不能给他们足够的时间来发现它的力量。如果你能杀死看守者，并帮我拿回它，我将十分感激。
text.progress: You've obtained it, I assume?
text.giverWindow: We cannot let it fall into the wrong hands.
text.turninWindow: Your efforts are appreciated.

english.title: Lost Treasure
english.objectives: Retrieve the Blinding Fury for A'dal from the Cache of the Legion in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: I sense that one of my kind's artifacts has been taken and stashed away in the Cache of the Legion.$B$BWe cannot give them time to discover its power. If you would kill the Gatewatchers and retrieve it for me, I would be most grateful.
english.progress: You've obtained it, I assume?
english.giverWindow: We cannot let it fall into the wrong hands.
english.turninWindow: Your efforts are appreciated.

text.title: 拯救生态船
text.objectives: 阿达尔希望你能前往风暴要塞的生态船，杀死指挥官萨拉妮丝、高级植物学家弗雷温以及看管者索恩格林。
text.description: 凯尔萨斯在生态船的部队没能控制住里面的无数怪物。我们必须纠正他们的错误。$B$B第一步就是消灭他们的力量，使他们无法进一步造成麻烦。
text.giverWindow: Will you help me?
text.turninWindow: Now, we must deal with the experiments.

english.title: Saving the Botanica
english.objectives: A'dal wants you to kill Commander Sarannis, High Botanist Freywinn, and Thorngrin the Tender inside the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
english.description: Kael'thas' forces in the Botanica were unsuccessful in handling the numerous creatures contained within. We must take action to right their wrongs.$B$BThe first step is to eliminate their forces so that they cannot cause further problems.
english.giverWindow: Will you help me?
english.turninWindow: Now, we must deal with the experiments.

text.title: 肃清生态船
text.objectives: 阿达尔要求你杀死6个变异血肉鞭笞者，6个变异恐惧尖啸者，6个变异恐魔，然后从风暴要塞生态船的拉伊身上获得快速进化的叶子。
text.description: 似乎凯尔萨斯的军队已经污染了生态船上的标本，且都已无药可救。我不希望这些扭曲的植物像其他同类一样散布到外域的其他地方。$B$B有一株名叫拉伊的植物与众不同，我需要对其进行检测。也许我们能从它身上学到一些东西。
text.progress: I see you have obtained the frond. Very good.
text.giverWindow: We have no other choice.
text.turninWindow: This is all deeply concerning.

english.title: Culling the Herd
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to kill 6 Mutate Fleshlashers, 6 Mutate Fear-shriekers, 6 Mutate Horrors, and to obtain a Rapidly Evolving Frond from Laj in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
english.description: It seems that Kael'thas' forces have twisted the Botanica's specimens beyond saving. I do not want to see them unleashed upon Outland as so many others have.$B$BThere is one, Laj, who I would like to examine. He is different somehow. Perhaps we can learn from him.
english.progress: I see you have obtained the frond. Very good.
english.giverWindow: We have no other choice.
english.turninWindow: This is all deeply concerning.

text.title: 严峻的任务
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞，杀死生态船内的迁跃扭木。
text.description: 现在，我不得不让你去完成一个严峻的任务。$B$B迁跃扭木过去曾是生态船的守卫。可现在他已经堕落了，我们必须消灭他。
text.giverWindow: I truly wish it had not come to this.
text.turninWindow: His spirit will move on.

english.title: A Most Somber Task
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Warp Splinter in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
english.description: I must now ask you to complete a most somber task.$B$BWarp Splinter used to act as guardian to all of the Botanica. He is now impure, and must be taken down.
english.giverWindow: I truly wish it had not come to this.
english.turninWindow: His spirit will move on.

text.title: 黑色沼泽
text.objectives: 深入时光之穴，前往正在发生黑暗之门开启这一历史事件的黑色沼泽，与萨艾特谈一谈。
text.description: 永恒之龙撕下伪装，露出了阴险狡猾的真面目。他们计划杀死守护者麦迪文，阻止黑暗之门的开启。从表面上看，这对联盟来说是件好事；但是事实上，这将导致一场大灾难，直接导致艾泽拉斯世界的毁灭。$B$B你必须穿越时光通道，进入黑色沼泽。向西走，然后往南，一直走到达存放着沼泽标本的房间，途中你会遇到未来的我。与黑色沼泽的萨艾特谈谈吧。

english.title: The Black Morass
english.objectives: Travel through the Caverns of Time to the Black Morass during the opening of the Dark Portal and speak with Sa'at.
english.description: The Infinite Dragonflight have abandoned all pretense of subtlety. They plot to destroy the Guardian, Medivh, and prevent the Dark Portal from ever opening. While outwardly, this may appear a boon to the forces of the Alliance, it is in actuality catastrophic and will result in your world ending.$B$BYou must venture through the timeway leading to the Black Morass. Go west and then south, past my future self, until you reach the tunnel that houses the swamp specimens. Cross over and speak with Sa'at.

text.title: 开启黑暗之门
text.objectives: 时光之穴黑色沼泽的萨艾特要求你保护麦迪文，直到他成功开启黑暗之门。$B$B任务完成后向萨艾特复命。
text.description: 守护者麦迪文正在这里兴奋地忙碌着，想要打开黑暗之门。$B$B但沼泽四周将会出现许多裂隙。永恒之龙会涌出裂隙，试图破坏麦迪文的法力护盾，最终杀死麦迪文。$B$B消灭裂隙领主和他们的首领！保护麦迪文，直到黑暗之门成功开启。
text.end: The Dark Portal Opened
text.completed: Return to Sa'at in The Black Morass.
text.giverWindow: He must succeed in his mission!

english.title: The Opening of the Dark Portal
english.objectives: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal.$B$BReturn to Sa'at should you succeed in your task.
english.description: Here the Guardian Medivh feverishly works to open the Dark Portal.$B$BScattered across the morass, rifts will materialize. Infinite will pour out of the rifts and attempt to destroy Medivh's shields and, ultimately, Medivh.$B$BKill their rift lords and leaders until Medivh succeeds!
english.end: The Dark Portal Opened
english.completed: Return to Sa'at in The Black Morass.
english.giverWindow: He must succeed in his mission!

text.title: 黑色沼泽
text.objectives: 深入时光之穴，前往正在发生黑暗之门开启这一历史事件的黑色沼泽，与萨艾特谈一谈。
text.description: 永恒之龙撕下伪装，露出了阴险狡猾的真面目。他们计划杀死守护者麦迪文，阻止黑暗之门的开启。从表面上看，这对联盟来说是件好事；但是事实上，这将导致一场大灾难，直接导致艾泽拉斯世界的毁灭。$B$B你必须穿越时光通道，进入黑色沼泽。向西走，然后往南，一直走到达存放着沼泽标本的房间，途中你会遇到未来的我。与黑色沼泽的萨艾特谈谈吧。

english.title: The Black Morass
english.objectives: Travel through the Caverns of Time to the Black Morass during the opening of the Dark Portal and speak with Sa'at.
english.description: The Infinite Dragonflight have abandoned all pretense of subtlety. They plot to destroy the Guardian, Medivh, and prevent the Dark Portal from ever opening. While outwardly, this may appear a boon to the forces of the Alliance, it is in actuality catastrophic and will result in your world ending.$B$BYou must venture through the timeway leading to the Black Morass. Go west and then south, past my future self, until you reach the tunnel that houses the swamp specimens. Cross over and speak with Sa'at.

text.title: 自由的黑暗
text.objectives: 阿达尔要求你前往风暴要塞，杀死禁魔监狱内自由的瑟雷凯斯。
text.description: <你的脑海中响起钟鸣的声音，但听上去十分压抑。>$B$B我们囚禁了在旅途中遇到的最危险的生物。$B$B瑟雷凯斯是一个强大的虚空领主。一旦让他逃入虚空风暴，他就能从中吸收无穷无尽的虚空能量。
text.giverWindow: None of the prisoners may be allowed to escape.
text.turninWindow: Unfortunately, yet more dangerous inmates have escaped.

english.title: Unbound Darkness
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Zereketh the Unbound in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
english.description: <The sound of chimes enters your head, but it is distressed.>$B$BWe imprisoned the most dangerous beings we came across in our travels.$B$BZereketh is a powerful void lord. If he escapes into Netherstorm, he will feed off of the abundant void energy.
english.giverWindow: None of the prisoners may be allowed to escape.
english.turninWindow: Unfortunately, yet more dangerous inmates have escaped.

text.title: 等着吧达尔莉安
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的禁魔监狱，杀死天怒预言者苏克拉底和末日预言者达尔莉安。
text.description: 燃烧军团的两个头领，天怒预言者苏克拉底和末日预言者达尔莉安，正在不断召集恶魔组成一支小规模军队。$B$B不能让他们的势力再膨胀下去了，否则禁魔监狱就会成为燃烧军团的又一个要塞。
text.giverWindow: We must do all we can to stop the Legion.
text.turninWindow: The Light will prevail.

english.title: Hey There Dalliah
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to kill Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
english.description: Two powerful agents of the Burning Legion, Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer, have begun rallying the demons on board together into a small army.$B$BYou cannot let their forces grow any larger, or the Arcatraz may soon become yet another Legion stronghold.
english.giverWindow: We must do all we can to stop the Legion.
english.turninWindow: The Light will prevail.

text.title: 监狱失守
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的禁魔监狱，杀死预言者斯克瑞斯。
text.description: 预言者斯克瑞斯是禁魔监狱的麻烦之源。$B$B他腐化了监护者梅里卡尔，让他释放了不少囚徒。预言者本人迟早也会获得自由。$B$B$N，你绝不能让上古之神的仆从再度活跃起来！
text.completion: Thank you, $N. Your actions this day have prevented countless tragedies.
text.giverWindow: Be careful, he is very powerful.
text.turninWindow: Their capabilities are most unsettling.

english.title: Maximum Security Breakout
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Harbinger Skyriss in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
english.description: Harbinger Skyriss is the heart of the problem in the Arcatraz.$B$BHe corrupted Warden Mellichar and made him release many of the prisoners. It is only a matter of time before the Harbinger himself is let loose.$B$B$N, you cannot let a servant of the Old Gods live!
english.completion: Thank you, $N. Your actions this day have prevented countless tragedies.
english.giverWindow: Be careful, he is very powerful.
english.turninWindow: Their capabilities are most unsettling.

text.title: 魔导师平台
text.objectives: 瑟里斯·黎明之心希望你找到在魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔。
text.description: 我们最近向魔导师平台派遣了一支远征军，阻止那里的军团势力。$B$B然而，至今我们没有听到任何消息传来，我感到十分担心。$B$B你能否前往那里，寻找主教拉雷索尔？他是远征军的领袖。
text.completion: Dawnhearth thought we were dead? Hah!$B$BI haven't sent a report because we haven't made any progress past this point.$B$BPerhaps you can help us change that?
text.end: Speak with Exarch Larethor.

english.title: Magisters' Terrace
english.objectives: Captain Theris Dawnhearth wants you to find Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
english.description: We recently sent in an expeditionary force to the Magisters' Terrace to stop the Legion forces there.$B$BHowever, we haven't heard from them since, and I fear the worst.$B$BWill you go there and try to find Exarch Larethor? He's in charge of the expedition.
english.completion: Dawnhearth thought we were dead? Hah!$B$BI haven't sent a report because we haven't made any progress past this point.$B$BPerhaps you can help us change that?
english.end: Speak with Exarch Larethor.

text.title: 占星球
text.objectives: 塔雷斯要求你使用魔导师平台内的阳台上的宝珠。
text.description: <塔雷斯一边说话，一边痛苦地抽搐。>$B$B去……去平台上，使用那颗宝珠。$B$B……它们正在……为太阳之井输送能量……$B$B<塔雷斯艰难地喘着气。>$B$B快点……必须马上阻止他们……不要等到他们……$B$B<塔雷斯咽下了最后一口气。>
text.completed: Return to Kalecgos in Magisters' Terrace.

english.title: The Scryer's Scryer
english.objectives: Tyrith wants you to use the orb on the balcony in Magisters' Terrace.
english.description: <Tyrith winces in pain as he speaks.>$b$bGo to the terrace... use the orb.$b$b...They're...feeding the sunwell....$b$b <Tyrith gasps for breath.>$b$bHurry... They must be stopped... before they can....$b$b<Tyrith dies.>
english.completed: Return to Kalecgos in Magisters' Terrace.

text.title: 联络中断
text.objectives: 在魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔希望你能找到血精灵间谍塔雷斯。
text.description: 我们在魔导师平台安插了一个联络人，为我们收集了一段时间的情报，但现在我们与他失去了联系。$B$B他的情报对我们的任务极为关键。
text.completion: ...Come closer, $R... Listen carefully to my words....
text.end: Find Tyrith.

english.title: Severed Communications
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace wants you to find Tyrith, a blood elf spy.
english.description: We've had a contact embedded in Magisters' Terrace gathering intelligence for us for some time now, but we've lost contact with him.$b$bThe information he was collecting is vital to our mission.
english.completion: ...Come closer, $R... Listen carefully to my words....
english.end: Find Tyrith.

text.title: 大难不死
text.objectives: 卡雷苟斯希望你击败魔导师平台的凯尔萨斯。你必须带着凯尔萨斯的徽记向魔导师平台的拉雷索尔复命。
text.description: 正如你所见，燃烧军团贼心不死，仍然想利用太阳井的能量来实现他们的邪恶目的。$B$B凯尔萨斯已经从失败的阴影中走了出来，带领他们卷土重来。你必须阻止他。
text.progress: Well, $C, I must admit, I wasn't sure I'd see you again.
text.completion: <Larethor listens intently as you explain your deeds in Magisters' Terrace.>$B$BTyrith will be missed - good man, that one. Thanks to you though, his death wasn't in vain.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
text.giverWindow: This is his final hour.

english.title: Hard to Kill
english.objectives: Kalecgos has asked you to defeat Kael'thas in Magisters' Terrace. You are to take Kael's head and report back to Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
english.description: As you've now witnessed, the Legion forces work tirelessly, manipulating the Sunwell's power to achieve their malevolent ends.$b$bKael'thas has risen from the ashes of defeat and once more leads them in their efforts. He must be stopped.
english.progress: Well, $C, I must admit, I wasn't sure I'd see you again.
english.completion: <Larethor listens intently as you explain your deeds in Magisters' Terrace.>$B$BTyrith will be missed - good man, that one. Thanks to you though, his death wasn't in vain.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
english.giverWindow: This is his final hour.

text.title: 激进思维
text.objectives: 魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔要你杀死维萨鲁斯，获取它的精华。
text.description: 我们输不起这场战争。我想让我们的哨卫变得更加强大，这样这些英勇善战的男女就不会轻易牺牲了。$B$B军团掌握着一个强大的元素生物。它的精华正是我们所需要的东西。
text.progress: Were you able to get your hands on its essence?
text.completion: Excellent! I can't wait to present this project to my superiors!
text.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor.

english.title: A Radical Notion
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Vexallus and obtain its essence.
english.description: We cannot afford to lose this war. I'd like to empower our sentries so that brave men and women don't have to die.$B$BThe Legion has gotten a hold of a powerful elemental being. Its essence could be just what we need.
english.progress: Were you able to get your hands on its essence?
english.completion: Excellent! I can't wait to present this project to my superiors!
english.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor.

text.title: 扭曲的盟友
text.objectives: 魔导师平台的主教拉雷索尔要你杀死塞林·火心和女祭司德莉希亚。
text.description: 燃烧军团和凯尔萨斯的势力逐渐合流了。这令我十分担忧。$B$B从我们收集的情报来看，塞林·火心和女祭司德莉希亚正紧密协作，想将两股势力整合起来。你必须阻止她们。
text.completion: Well done, soldier. One step at a time.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace.

english.title: Twisted Associations
english.objectives: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa.
english.description: The Legion and Kael'thas' forces are becoming increasingly intertwined. This concerns me very deeply.$B$BFrom what we can gather Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa work closely together to unite the two armies. You need to stop them.
english.completion: Well done, soldier. One step at a time.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace.

text.title: 再踏征程
text.objectives: 暗影猎手塔金想要你和地狱火城墙破碎大厅内的石头守卫斯托克顿谈一谈。
text.description: 我始终在默默聆听，$C。我乃酋长之耳。$B$B我军在地狱火城墙的战备状态我也早有耳闻。现在是时候挺进邪兽人的老巢破碎大厅了。$B$B去和石头守卫斯托克顿取得联络，他负责指挥那里的行动。
text.completion: Keep your head down, or it's likely to end up on the wrong end of an arrow.

english.title: Advancing the Campaign
english.objectives: Shadow Hunter Ty'jin has asked you to speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: I mostly listen, $c. I listen so that the Warchief doesn't have to.$B$BI've heard of the status of our campaign against the Hellfire Citadel. It is time to take the Shattered Halls, seat of power for the fel orcs.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton, he's in charge there.
english.completion: Keep your head down, or it's likely to end up on the wrong end of an arrow.

text.title: 再踏征程
text.objectives: 远征军指挥官达纳斯·托尔贝恩要求你和地狱火城墙破碎大厅内的高级斥候卡德维克谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候给邪兽人最后一击了。$B$B高级斥候卡德维克正在地狱火城墙的破碎大厅里等着你。抓紧时间，邪兽人可能随时进犯荣耀堡！
text.completion: Be quiet! We'll surely be overwhelmed if they notice us now.

english.title: Advancing the Campaign
english.objectives: Force Commander Danath Trollbane has asked you to speak with Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: The time has come to lay the final blow against the fel orcs.$B$BAdvance Scout Chadwick awaits your presence inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel. Make haste, their forces could strike against Honor Hold at any moment!
english.completion: Be quiet! We'll surely be overwhelmed if they notice us now.

text.title: 我要红色木槿！
text.objectives: 收集5朵红色木槿，交给幽暗沼泽的塔苏。
text.description: 对我们来说，红色木槿的用途非常广泛。$B$B但它只生长在幽暗沼泽中，许多沼泽居民都很喜欢这种植物。$B$B如果你能帮我带些红色木槿回来，我会非常感谢的。
text.progress: Were you able to gather any hibiscus?
text.completion: These will do nicely, but we can always use more.  Perhaps you will find yourself in the Underbog again soon?
text.completed: Return to T'shu in the Underbog at Coilfang Reservoir.

english.title: Bring Me A Shrubbery!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Sanguine Hibiscus and return them to T'shu in the Underbog.
english.description: My people use sanguine hibiscus for a number of purposes.$B$BIt grows naturally only in the Underbog, and many of the bog's denizens have taken a liking to it.$B$BIf you could bring me some, I would be very grateful.

text.title: 真正的斗士
text.objectives: Speak with Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Faire.
text.description: 要成为一名格斗大师，肯定还需要些别的东西...$B$B也许经营暗月死斗场的科戈尔·碎颅会给你答案。
text.completion: Well met, $C.$B$BGaining but one trinket is not enough to make you a Master Pit Fighter.$B$BNow is the time to truly prove your steel.
text.completed: Report to Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Deathmatch at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.objectives: Speak with Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: There must be more to being a master pit fighter than this...$B$BPerhaps Korgol Crushskull who runs the Darkmoon Deathmatch at the Faire will know.
