text.title: 擒贼先擒王
text.objectives: 防御者墨尔顿要求你取得掠夺者因格瓦尔的徽记。
text.description: 维库人作战时无畏无惧，似乎他们在战斗中只求一死。他们数量庞大，个个骁勇善战，显然我们没有什么胜算。$B$B然而有一个名叫因格瓦尔的维库人备受他们尊崇。如果能够将他击败，维库人的士气必将遭到重大的打击。
text.progress: Good to see you're well, $N.$B$BWe've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
text.completion: Outstanding!$B$BThis could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for.
text.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.
text.giverWindow: Lord of Utgarde Keep.

english.title: Stealing Their Thunder
english.objectives: Defender Mordun has asked you to acquire the head of Ingvar the Plunderer.
english.description: The vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple.$b$bThere's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. Bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.
english.progress: Good to see you're well, $N.$B$BWe've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
english.completion: Outstanding!$B$BThis could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for.
english.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.
english.giverWindow: Lord of Utgarde Keep.

text.title: 削减军备
text.objectives: Defender Mordun wants you to steal 5 Vrykul Weapons
text.description: 相信我，$G小伙子:小姑娘;，维库人的武器那真是太贱了！拿得稳，砍得狠，简直要人命。$B$B我需要你在它们取了我们性命之前偷点回来！
text.progress: You pinch a load a' them vrykul axes?
text.completion: <Mordun whistles.>$B$BWill ya just look at 'em? Incredible.$B$BI half expected these neanderthals to be swingin' around clubs and throwin' rock.$B$BNo such luck...
text.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.

english.title: Disarmament
english.objectives: Defender Mordun wants you to steal 5 Vrykul Weapons
english.description: Take it from me, $g lad:lass;, them vrykul weapons be downright nasty! Deceptively well-balanced, wickedly sharp - just plain deadly.$b$bI need you to pilfer some o' them weapons before they're used on us!
english.progress: You pinch a load a' them vrykul axes?
english.completion: <Mordun whistles.>$B$BWill ya just look at 'em? Incredible.$B$BI half expected these neanderthals to be swingin' around clubs and throwin' rock.$B$BNo such luck...
english.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.

text.title: 证明你的实力
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂的团队副本内，前往永恒之眼，从缚风者哈格拉身上偷一枚地火操纵者的解码环。
text.description: 你好，$N！你的绰号——嗯，没错——“金手指”，在军团中可是十分有名呢。$B$B我们正需要你的技术来完成一件大事。但首先得确定你就是我们需要的那个人，然后我才能告诉你详情。$B$B随着战斗的进行，你会进入永恒之眼，我要你帮我从缚风者哈格拉身上偷一枚地火操纵者的解码环。你能完成这个任务吗？
text.progress: Have you completed our task?$B$BThese artifacts are crafted such that they dissolve if their bearer is killed, so only a skilled thief can acquire them.
text.completion: You've found one! You're a credit to your race, $N.$B$BRings like these are capable of decoding even the most complicated of ciphers. Unfortunately, the ring is inert until it is charged...
text.completed: Bring the ring to Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple within the Dragon Soul raid encounter.

english.title: Proving Your Worth
english.objectives: Pickpocket a cryptomancer's decoder ring from Hagara the Stormbinder at the Eye of Eternity within the Dragon Soul raid encounter.
english.description: Hello, $n! You've earned a reputation among the flight as having - shall we say - 'nimble fingers.'$B$BWe need someone of your skills for a matter of utmost delicacy. Before I reveal more, we need to know you're the right $gman:woman; for the job.$B$BWhen the course of battle takes you to the Eye of Eternity, I need you to pickpocket Hagara the Stormbinder to retrieve a cryptomancer's decoder ring. Are you up to the task?
english.progress: Have you completed our task?$B$BThese artifacts are crafted such that they dissolve if their bearer is killed, so only a skilled thief can acquire them.
english.completion: You've found one! You're a credit to your race, $N.$B$BRings like these are capable of decoding even the most complicated of ciphers. Unfortunately, the ring is inert until it is charged...
english.completed: Bring the ring to Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple within the Dragon Soul raid encounter.

text.title: 隐藏的信息
text.objectives: 为你的地火操纵者的解码环充能，然后用它来破解科拉丝塔萨的烧焦的密码。
text.description: 驻守在暮光高地朱红庇护所内的科拉丝塔萨截获了一段极为重要的密电。我会让她说明整个情况，但我们需要你的帮助才能破解这段代码！$B$B带上你的解码环去找主城的虚灵魔术师，他应该知道如何为它充能。快去找科拉丝塔萨要这份密电，然后用解码环帮她解码。快点！时间不多了……
text.progress: I was hoping Lord Afrasastrasz would find us a competent $C.$B$BWhat have you got for us, $N? Do you have a means of decrypting the message?
text.completion: What's this about? "Ravenholdt Manor?" I thought that was just a motley band of thieves up in the Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BWhat would they want with a dragon egg? More importantly, how did they find out about it?$B$BWe're going to need some answers, $N!
text.completed: Deliver the Solved Cipher to Corastrasza at the Vermillion Redoubt in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: A Hidden Message
english.objectives: Charge your Cryptomancer's Decoder Ring and use it to decode the Corastrasza's Singed Cipher.
english.description: Corastrasza, currently stationed at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands, has intercepted a coded message of grave importance. I'll let her explain the full situation, but we need your expertise to unravel the cipher!$B$BTake your decoder ring to an ethereal thaumaturge in your capital city - he should know how to charge it. Acquire the encoded cipher from Corastrasza and use the ring to decode it for her. Hurry! Time is ticking...
english.progress: I was hoping Lord Afrasastrasz would find us a competent $C.$B$BWhat have you got for us, $N? Do you have a means of decrypting the message?
english.completion: What's this about? "Ravenholdt Manor?" I thought that was just a motley band of thieves up in the Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BWhat would they want with a dragon egg? More importantly, how did they find out about it?$B$BWe're going to need some answers, $N!
english.completed: Deliver the Solved Cipher to Corastrasza at the Vermillion Redoubt in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 巫妖王之耳
text.objectives: 乌特加德城堡内的防御者墨尔顿要求你杀死凯雷塞斯王子。
text.description: 凯雷塞斯王子在嚎风峡湾充当巫妖王的耳目。$B$B我一点都不喜欢这个家伙！$B$B给他点苦头尝尝，你会让整个世界都为之叫好。
text.progress: It is good to see you again, $N.
text.completion: I bet the pale whelp felt that!$B$BThat's one more step towards yer judgment day, Arthas!
text.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.

english.title: Ears of the Lich King
english.objectives: Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep wants you to slay Prince Keleseth.
english.description: Prince Keleseth acts as Arthas' eyes and ears in the Fjord.$B$BI don't like that one bit!$B$BGo and give him a round o' pain. You'll be doing the world a favor by doing so.
english.progress: It is good to see you again, $N.
english.completion: I bet the pale whelp felt that!$B$BThat's one more step towards yer judgment day, Arthas!
english.completed: Return to Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep.

text.title: 叛徒国王之死
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布内的复国者阿扎克委派你击败阿努巴拉克。带着阿努巴拉克的破损甲壳向阿扎克复命。
text.description: 背叛者的国王阿努巴拉克深居于曾经显赫一时的艾卓-尼鲁布王国。$B$B他扭曲并玷污了我们曾经的家园，把它变成了如今这个邪恶堕落的地方。他率领着一众亡灵蛛魔军队，立誓效忠巫妖王。$B$B去终结他的统治吧。
text.progress: Is it done, $C? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
text.completion: <A fierce glow emanantes from all of Azak's eyes as he stares at the husk.>$B$BIt is DONE!$B$BYour name shall be recorded in the extensive history of our people, $R!
text.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.
text.giverWindow: The Traitor King

english.title: Death to the Traitor King
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak. You are to return to A'zak with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
english.description: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub.$b$bHe has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King.$b$bBring an end to his reign.
english.progress: Is it done, $C? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
english.completion: <A fierce glow emanantes from all of Azak's eyes as he stares at the husk.>$B$BIt is DONE!$B$BYour name shall be recorded in the extensive history of our people, $R!
english.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.
english.giverWindow: The Traitor King

text.title: 别忘了蛛卵！
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布内的复国者阿扎克要求你摧毁6个天灾蛛魔之卵。
text.description: 艾卓-尼鲁布里面布满了天灾蛛魔细心呵护的卵，它们很快就会孵化，为蛛魔军队提供新鲜血液，使得他们能够继续杀戮，不断壮大。$B$B这些蛛卵都被污秽的魔法污染了，我们的任务就是摧毁它们。
text.completion: Do not worry, $R.$B$BThe eggs they found were but a fraction of our hidden stores within Azjol-Nerub.$B$BOur mighty kingdom shall be reborn.
text.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.

english.title: Don't Forget the Eggs!
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to destroy 6 Nerubian Scourge Eggs.
english.description: Throughout Azjol-Nerub, the scourged nerubians carefully nurture eggs that will soon hatch, providing them nerubian young to slaughter and raise.$b$bThe eggs have been tainted with foul magics. Our only recourse is to dispose of them.
english.completion: Do not worry, $R.$B$BThe eggs they found were but a fraction of our hidden stores within Azjol-Nerub.$B$BOur mighty kingdom shall be reborn.
english.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.

text.title: 无面者
text.objectives: 纳尔苏深渊的拆解者基里克斯要你去杀死传令官沃拉兹和他身边的3个被遗忘的无面者。
text.description: 我的同胞们在对抗亡灵天灾的战斗中，一旦遭到失败，就会采取往深处挖洞的办法躲避敌人。可在绝望的驱使下，他们挖得太深了。$B$B我们不小心放出了一群古神的爪牙，一种名为无面者的生物。$B$B最终，我们无法面对两个如此强大的敌人。这场灾难导致我们输掉了对亡灵的战争，并最终失去了我们的家园。$B$B进入安卡赫特吧，$C，把这些无面者暴徒清除出我们的故园。
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Faceless Ones
english.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
english.description: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep.$b$bWe inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless.$b$bIn the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home.$b$bEnter Ahn'kahet, $c, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.
english.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: 守门人的护符
text.objectives: 艾卓-尼鲁布里的复国者阿扎克要求你从看门者克里克希尔那里夺回守门人的护符。
text.description: 艾卓-尼鲁布大门的看守者克里克希尔并非是一个叛徒。$B$B他在蜘蛛之战中守卫我们的家园，不敌天灾军团的入侵而殒命。$B$B以他的身份推测，通向隐秘帝国的钥匙应该就在他手里。我希望你能把钥匙夺回来，让它回到艾卓-尼鲁布人民的手中。
text.progress: Has Krik'thir's spirit been released from the curse of undeath? What of the talisman?
text.completion: Just as I suspected.$B$BMost of the empire has remained closed off since Krik'thir's final stand. Perhaps my people have already secured the depths and merely await release? Perhaps the faceless ones fester behind closed doors.$B$BOnly time will tell. The exposed upper reaches of Azjol-Nerub must first be cleansed of Arthas' taint.
text.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.

english.title: The Gatewatcher's Talisman
english.objectives: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to retrieve the Gatewatcher's Talisman from Krik'thir the Gatewatcher.
english.description: Krik'thir, guardian of the gates to Azjol-Nerub, was not a traitor.$B$BHe fell in the War of the Spider defending our home from the Scourge.$B$BAs per his station, he was in possession of the key to the hidden empire. I'd like you to retrieve it so it may be returned to its people.
english.progress: Has Krik'thir's spirit been released from the curse of undeath? What of the talisman?
english.completion: Just as I suspected.$B$BMost of the empire has remained closed off since Krik'thir's final stand. Perhaps my people have already secured the depths and merely await release? Perhaps the faceless ones fester behind closed doors.$B$BOnly time will tell. The exposed upper reaches of Azjol-Nerub must first be cleansed of Arthas' taint.
english.completed: Return to Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub.

text.title: 前往魔枢
text.objectives: 大法师伯林纳德希望你能与魔枢内的战斗法师凯特琳交谈。
text.description: 我派了战斗法师凯特琳前往魔枢调查玛里苟斯领地里的骚乱事件，可好几天过去了，她仍然音讯全无。$B$B你是否愿意去那里助她一臂之力？如果她还没有被龙吃掉的话，你应该能帮上她的忙。

english.title: Into the Nexus
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand has asked you to speak with Warmage Kaitlyn in the Nexus.
english.description: I sent Warmage Kaitlyn into the Nexus to investigate the chaos that is Malygos' domain, but she hasn't reported back in days.$B$BWould you mind going there and lending her aid? I'm certain she could use help if she hasn't been eaten by dragons.

text.title: 师生义绝
text.objectives: 安卡赫特的先知伊克塞特要求你去刺杀先知纳多克斯。
text.description: 我曾将先知纳多克斯视为我的导师。$B$B可自从我亲眼看到他残忍地杀害了我的朋友和家人，变成恶魔的仆人之后，一切都彻底改变了。$B$B请你进入地底深渊找到他，并让他为自己的罪行付出代价，$R。
text.completion: With Nadox gone, I hope to take his place as a leader of my people.$B$BThe Empire of Azjol-Nerub is destined for greatness, $R...
text.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.
text.turninWindow: Well done.

english.title: Pupil No More
english.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet has tasked you with the assassination of Elder Nadox.
english.description: I once called Elder Nadox my teacher.$B$BThat changed forever when I was forced to watch him mercilessly slaughter my friends and family as a servant of the damned.$B$BFind him within the depths and make him pay for his crimes, $r.
english.completion: With Nadox gone, I hope to take his place as a leader of my people.$B$BThe Empire of Azjol-Nerub is destined for greatness, $R...
english.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.
english.turninWindow: Well done.

text.title: 夺回安卡赫特
text.objectives: 安卡赫特的先知伊克塞特要求你杀死3个塔达拉姆之眼，1个碾骨者以及塔达拉姆王子。
text.description: 塔达拉姆王子和他的天灾大军沿用了我们过去的卫所，以抵御来自严寒深渊的原住民。$B$B去把那些卫所端掉，杀死那里的天灾守卫。我的部队会配合原住民干掉那些残兵的。
text.completion: Excellent.$B$B<You heard a series of clicking sounds.>$B$BNow to vanquish our other foe.
text.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.
text.giverWindow: Failure will not be tolerated.
text.turninWindow: I must ask one more favor of you.

english.title: Reclaiming Ahn'Kahet
english.objectives: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet wants you to kill 3 Eyes of Taldaram, a Bonegrinder, and Prince Taldaram.
english.description: Prince Taldaram and his army of Scourge use the same wards we once used to hide our empire to keep themselves safe from the native denizens of the icy depths.$B$BDeactivate the wards and slaughter the Scourge guarding them. My forces will help the natives slaughter the rest.
english.completion: Excellent.$B$B<You heard a series of clicking sounds.>$B$BNow to vanquish our other foe.
english.completed: Return to Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet.
english.giverWindow: Failure will not be tolerated.
english.turninWindow: I must ask one more favor of you.

text.title: 爵德不怕天灾
text.objectives: 达克萨隆要塞里的库塞尔要求你杀死暴龙之王爵德，并且带回它的牙齿。
text.description: 有一个疲于奔命的达卡莱巨魔告诉我，那只巨大的暴龙之王爵德对天灾的瘟疫完全免疫。$B$B如果你能够找到暴龙之王并且把它的一颗牙齿弄下来给我的话，也许我可以把它制成一把武器。
text.progress: Does the great beast exist?
text.completion: <Kurzel's eyes open wide.>$B$BWow! That's enormous!
text.completed: Return to Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep.

english.title: What the Scourge Dred
english.objectives: Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep wants you to slay King Dred and bring her his tooth.
english.description: One of the fleeing Drakkari trolls told me of a great raptor king, Dred, that was immune to the plague.$B$BIf you could find King Dred and bring me one of his teeth, perhaps I could fashion it into a weapon.
english.progress: Does the great beast exist?
english.completion: <Kurzel's eyes open wide.>$B$BWow! That's enormous!
english.completed: Return to Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep.

text.title: 谨慎行事
text.objectives: 罗宁要求你前往达拉然的紫罗兰监狱然后和辛克莱尔中尉谈一谈。
text.description: 听我说，$R。$B$B紫罗兰监狱最近发生了一起事变，这引起了我的注意。似乎蓝龙军团正准备对达拉然发动一次全面的进攻！$B$B我要你立即前往监狱，去找辛克莱尔中尉。她会告诉你整个事件的细节。$B$B还有，你要尽可能谨慎地处理这件事。不到万不得已的情况下，我并不想让这件事引起达拉然居民的恐慌。我说得够清楚了吧？$B$B好了，现在就出发吧！
text.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

english.title: Discretion is Key
english.objectives: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari.
english.description: Listen to me, $r.$b$bIt's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran!$b$bI need you to get to the prison and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari at once. She'll give you the details.$b$bThat is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear?$b$bVery well. Now, go!
english.completion: Not a moment too soon.$b$bAre you prepared to defend Dalaran, $c?

text.title: 堵截
text.objectives: 紫罗兰监狱内的辛克莱尔中尉要求你阻止蓝龙军团的入侵。当你杀死塞安妮苟萨之后再和她谈谈。
text.description: 我的部队现在举步维艰，而玛利苟斯派出的进攻者却前赴后继。$B$B我担心这仍然不是最危险的时刻。$B$B你必须坚持到他们的首领塞安妮苟萨亲自参战。只有她的死亡才能遏制住攻势，拯救达拉然。$B$B你准备好了以后就告诉我。
text.completion: Thank you, hero!$B$BDalaran is safe for another day because of your bravery.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Sinclari in the Violet Hold.

english.title: Containment
english.objectives: Lieutenant Sinclari in the Violet Hold wants you to put an end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to speak to her again once Cyanigosa is slain.
english.description: My forces are in absolute shambles, and Malygos' assailants just keep coming.$B$BI fear that the worst has yet to come.$B$BYou must engage them until their leader, Cyanigosa, comes. Only her death will stop the invasion and save Dalaran.$B$BSpeak to me again when you are ready.
english.completion: Thank you, hero!$B$BDalaran is safe for another day because of your bravery.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Sinclari in the Violet Hold.

text.title: 未竟的事业
text.objectives: 哈克娅想要你和古达克内的托玛尔谈一谈。
text.description: 阿卡里先知确实已经无法再对这个世界造成什么威胁了，但我们仍有许多事情要做。$B$B更多的阿卡里之血被用来强化了另一个人，而他才是目前真正的威胁。$B$B行动要快，$N，前往古达克和托玛尔取得联系。他会告诉你下一步该做些什么。
text.completion: Lissen up, mon. Dere be dangerous work ta be done!

english.title: Unfinished Business
english.objectives: Har'koa wants you to speak with Tol'mar in Gundrak.
english.description: While it is true that the Prophet of Akali will trouble this world no more, there yet remains work to be done.$b$bThe greater part of Akali's blood has empowered another, and it is in him that the true danger lies.$b$bQuickly, $n, make your way to Gundrak and speak with Tol'mar. He will be able to direct you further in this cause.
english.completion: Lissen up, mon. Dere be dangerous work ta be done!

text.title: 迦尔达拉之死
text.objectives: 托玛尔要求你杀死古达克内的斯拉德兰，莫拉比和迦尔达拉。
text.description: 这是我见过的最可怕的事情了。伟大的阿卡里……在我面前被杀死了。真是太恐怖了……$B$B我原本只是负责侦查而已。但我实在是无法忍受了！迦尔达拉和他的手下必须得到惩罚！$B$B为阿卡里报仇，伙计。这是义不容辞的责任！
text.completion: Ya done it?! Dey be no more?$B$BHere ya go, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
text.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Guldrak.
text.giverWindow: Da traitor deserves death!

english.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
english.objectives: Tol'mar wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
english.description: It musta been da most awful thing I ever seen. Da great Akali - slain right before my eyes. Horrible...$b$bMy job be to observe only. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.
english.completion: Ya done it?! Dey be no more?$B$BHere ya go, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
english.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Guldrak.
english.giverWindow: Da traitor deserves death!

text.title: 迦尔达拉之死
text.objectives: 记载者拜基妮要求你杀死古达克内的斯拉德兰，莫拉比和迦尔达拉。
text.description: 伟大的阿卡里被杀害了，$R。$B$B我毕生的责任是负责记录，而非战斗。但我已忍无可忍！迦尔达拉和他的手下必须得到惩罚！$B$B为阿卡里报仇，伙计。这是义不容辞的责任！
text.completion: Ya really did it?$B$BYou surpassed my expectations, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Guldrak.
text.giverWindow: Show him no mercy!

english.title: Gal'darah Must Pay
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
english.description: Da mighty Akali has been slain, $r.$b$bMy role in life be to record, not fight. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay!$b$bAvenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.
english.completion: Ya really did it?$B$BYou surpassed my expectations, mon. Take dis gift for bringin' justice to da frozen wastes.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Guldrak.
english.giverWindow: Show him no mercy!

text.title: 核实情况
text.objectives: 图基尼希望你能去找古达克的拜基妮说话。
text.description: 从古达克一直传来可怕的声响。这种声音越来越大，而且出现得越来越频繁。$B$B我有个学徒还在古达克里做记载，她已经跟随我很久了。也许你能帮我去看看她怎么了？
text.completion: To'kini be my cowardly father - too fearful to take up a position so near Gundrak... so he sent me!$B$BDis place be full of troll history. We can't let Gal'darah and his crazed followers keep it hidden forever!

english.title: Just Checkin'
english.objectives: To'kini wants you to speak to Bah'kini in Gundrak.
english.description: There have been fearsome sounds echoing from Gundrak. They have been increasing in volume and frequency of late.$b$bMy long-time student is currently recording events from inside Gundrak. Perhaps you could find the time to check in on her for me?
english.completion: To'kini be my cowardly father - too fearful to take up a position so near Gundrak... so he sent me!$B$BDis place be full of troll history. We can't let Gal'darah and his crazed followers keep it hidden forever!

text.title: 集结的信号
text.objectives: 记载者拜基妮要你从古达克弄一块达卡莱巨像的碎片回来。
text.description: 乍听之下，这个故事似乎有点老套——巨魔摧毁了他们本该膜拜的存在，获得了禁忌的力量。$B$B如果我听说的事都是真的，那么他们一定有一个特殊的魔像，一个前所未有的神秘造物！$B$B帮我弄一块魔像碎片来，我要研究一下。
text.progress: You get me a piece of dat golem, mon?
text.completion: Ahh, yeah mon! Dat be what I'm lookin' for.$B$BHere ya go - take somethin' nice for your troubles.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak.

english.title: One of a Kind
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
english.description: At first glance, it be lookin' like da same old story here - trolls tappin' into forbidden powah by destroyin' da very beings dey should be worshippin'.$b$bIf what I learned be true, den dey have a special golem - one like nuthin' created before!$b$bBring me back a piece from dat golem ta study.
english.progress: You get me a piece of dat golem, mon?
english.completion: Ahh, yeah mon! Dat be what I'm lookin' for.$B$BHere ya go - take somethin' nice for your troubles.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak.

text.title: 集结的信号
text.objectives: 托玛尔要你从古达克弄一块达卡莱巨像的碎片回来。
text.description: 要是达卡莱人肯老老实实地膜拜这些神灵，而不是摧毁了它们，这场悲剧本来是可以避免的。$B$B我听说他们有一个特别的魔像——里面灌注着禁忌的能量。$B$B给我弄一块魔像的碎片回来，这样我们就能从这里的兄弟姐妹们身上学到点东西了。
text.progress: You find da golem? I'm sure it's in there somewhere.
text.completion: Amazin'! Dis be like nothing I've ever seer before.$B$BGood work, mon.
text.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Gundrak.

english.title: One of a Kind
english.objectives: Tol'mar wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
english.description: Dis whole mess coulda been avoided if da Drakkari had worshipped da gods instead of destroyin' dem.$b$bI heard dat dey have a special golem - one imbued with forbidden powah.$b$bBring me back a piece from dat golem so we can learn from our bruddas and sistahs.
english.progress: You find da golem? I'm sure it's in there somewhere.
english.completion: Amazin'! Dis be like nothing I've ever seer before.$B$BGood work, mon.
english.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Gundrak.

text.title: 前车之鉴
text.objectives: 古达克的记载者拜基妮要你收集6块达卡莱历史石板。
text.description: 古达克看来已经完了。你也知道，这是事实。$B$B如果你有勇气的话，就去寻找历史石板吧，看看到底是什么令达卡莱帝国落得如此下场。$B$B或许有一天，我们能让它重现昔日的荣光。
text.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
text.completion: You be havin' my thanks, mon.$B$BThese will be very useful to us, I'm sure of it.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak.

english.title: For Posterity
english.objectives: Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
english.description: Gundrak looks doomed. You know dis to be true.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end.$B$BPerhaps one day we be bringin' dem back to der former glory.
english.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
english.completion: You be havin' my thanks, mon.$B$BThese will be very useful to us, I'm sure of it.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak.

text.title: 前车之鉴
text.objectives: 古达克的托玛尔要你收集6块达卡莱历史石板。
text.description: 如今，冰巨魔的土地笼罩于昔日荣光的阴影之中，辉煌不再。$B$B如果你够胆的话，就去寻找历史石板吧，看看到底是什么令达卡莱帝国落得如此下场。$B$B或许有一天，我们能将这片土地交还给新的冰霜巨魔族裔。
text.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
text.completion: We trolls been subject to da splittin' of empires for longer than some races been existin'.$B$BWe always regrow from da ruins.
text.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Gundrak.

english.title: For Posterity
english.objectives: Tol'mar in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
english.description: Da land of da ice trolls is a shadow of its former glory.$b$bIf you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end.$B$BPerhaps one day we be givin' dis land back to a new line of frost trolls.
english.progress: You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
english.completion: We trolls been subject to da splittin' of empires for longer than some races been existin'.$B$BWe always regrow from da ruins.
english.completed: Return to Tol'mar in Gundrak.

text.title: 以其人之道
text.objectives: 潜入拉文霍德庄园，找到失踪的黑龙蛋。
text.description: 这个洞穴的另一边就是拉文霍德庄园。你必须神不知鬼不觉地潜入那里！$B$B<莫奥斯塔兹对你施放了一个法术。>$B$B这样，我就能在你潜入庄园时监督你的行动，并随时与你沟通了。现在，快潜入那座庄园，找到黑龙蛋，可别被抓住了……
text.completion: So, you will join with me?$B$BGood. Very good.
text.completed: Follow Wrathion upstairs and speak with him at Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: To Catch a Thief
english.objectives: Infiltrate Ravenholdt Manor and locate the missing black dragon egg.
english.description: Just beyond this cave lies Ravenholdt Manor. You need to get inside without being seen!$B$B<Mostrasz places an enchantment on you.>$B$BThere - now I'll be able to keep an eye on you and communicate as you venture into the compound. Now sneak into that manor, locate the egg, and don't get caught...
english.completion: So, you will join with me?$B$BGood. Very good.
english.completed: Follow Wrathion upstairs and speak with him at Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 绝望的守望者
text.objectives: 岩石大厅的卡迪尔·斩铁要求你让悲伤圣女安息，并获得一滴悲伤水晶之泪。
text.description: 我很乐意为造物者以及他们的造物献出生命。$B$B可是，自从洛肯背叛之后，整个奥杜尔似乎都开始与世界为敌。尤其是悲伤圣女，她似乎已经彻底沉浸在自己全新的痛苦秩序里了。$B$B请让她安息，并将她的一滴泪水带回来给我。
text.progress: I wish there were another way, but it seems death is the maiden's only salvation now.
text.completion: <Kaldir stares into the crystal in silence for a moment.>$B$BNo being has ever felt such sincere sorrow as the Maiden of Grief has.$B$BLet us remember her spirit as we continue our efforts against Loken.
text.completed: Return to Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone.

english.title: The Forlorn Watcher
english.objectives: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to put the Maiden of Grief to rest and to obtain a Crystal Tear of Grief.
english.description: I would gladly give my life for the Makers or their creations.$B$BHowever, since Loken's betrayal it seems all of Ulduar has turned on the world. One in particular, the Maiden of Grief, seems to reel in agony at her new orders.$B$BPlease lay her to rest and bring me one of her tears.
english.progress: I wish there were another way, but it seems death is the maiden's only salvation now.
english.completion: <Kaldir stares into the crystal in silence for a moment.>$B$BNo being has ever felt such sincere sorrow as the Maiden of Grief has.$B$BLet us remember her spirit as we continue our efforts against Loken.
english.completed: Return to Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone.

text.title: 堕落的构造体
text.objectives: 岩石大厅的卡迪尔·斩铁要求你杀死3个黑暗符文巨人和克莱斯塔卢斯。
text.description: 铁矮人们正忙着雕刻巨型岩石构造体。我担心它们很快就变成铁矮人的强大武器。$B$B你必须去击败他们的监工克莱斯塔卢斯以及大厅中的黑暗符文巨人成品，否则就太迟了！
text.completion: Well done, $R.$B$BEvery weapon we can take away from Loken is a great boon to our own war effort.
text.completed: Return to Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone.

english.title: Corrupt Constructs
english.objectives: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to kill 3 Dark Rune Giants and Krystallus.
english.description: The iron dwarves are busy at work carving out massive stone constructs that I fear will soon be used as powerful weapons.$B$BYou must defeat their overseer, Krystallus, and the dark rune giants already walking the halls before it is too late!
english.completion: Well done, $R.$B$BEvery weapon we can take away from Loken is a great boon to our own war effort.
english.completed: Return to Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone.

text.title: 大赛冠军
text.objectives: 大领主提里奥·弗丁要求你完成冠军的试炼。
text.description: 随着这次大赛的举行，与巫妖王的决战离我们又近了一步。$B$B$N，拿出你的勇气与荣誉感，尽情地战斗吧。这里的每一个战士都是百里挑一的精英。$B$B我们要同心协力，阻止阿尔萨斯！
text.completion: I am honored to stand in the presence of such a fierce warrior.$B$BYou have brought honor to yourself and to your people, $N!
text.giverWindow: I have faith in you.
text.turninWindow: You bring me great hope for the success of this campaign.

english.title: Champion of the Tournament
english.objectives: Highlord Tirion Fordring has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
english.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$N, fight with valor and honor. Every fighter here has gathered for the common good.$B$BTogether, we will stop Arthas!
english.completion: I am honored to stand in the presence of such a fierce warrior.$B$BYou have brought honor to yourself and to your people, $N!
english.giverWindow: I have faith in you.
english.turninWindow: You bring me great hope for the success of this campaign.

text.title: Champion of the King
text.objectives: King Varian Wrynn has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
text.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$N, you are to represent the Alliance in this grand arena.$B$BProve yourself against Azeroth's finest. Go forward with honor.
text.giverWindow: Prepare yourself.

english.title: Champion of the King
english.objectives: King Varian Wrynn has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
english.description: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King.$B$B$N, you are to represent the Alliance in this grand arena.$B$BProve yourself against Azeroth's finest. Go forward with honor.
english.giverWindow: Prepare yourself.

text.title: 势不两立
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你击败沃尔坎。
text.description: 我就跟你直说了吧，小$R。自从与托里姆决裂之后，我的族人们已经变了。$B$B沃尔坎把我们看做眼中钉，肉中刺。他跟我们之间，只有一方能活下来。我们只想要和平，可现在看来，战争已经是我们唯一的选择了。
text.completion: Volkhan shall haunt the dreams of my people no more.$B$BContinue your efforts, little $R. In time, I am certain my people will grow to forgive Thorim.
text.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning.

english.title: Diametrically Opposed
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Volkhan.
english.description: I shall speak plainly to you, little $r. My people have not been the same since our ties with Thorim were severed.$b$bVolkhan will not rest until either he, or we, are no more. We only want peace, but it seems we have no choice but war.
english.completion: Volkhan shall haunt the dreams of my people no more.$B$BContinue your efforts, little $R. In time, I am certain my people will grow to forgive Thorim.
english.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning.

text.title: 不惜代价！
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你击败洛肯，然后将洛肯的信物带回来交给他。
text.description: 无论如何，洛肯一定得死。$B$B击败洛肯的光荣使命将由你背负。$B$B把他的信物带回来给我，我将永远感激你的义举。
text.progress: Has justice been brought to Loken?
text.completion: That vile worm is dead?$B$BYou have turned out to be a great boon to my people, little $R.$B$BPlease accept this gift in return for your loyal friendship.
text.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrinn in the Halls of Lightning.

english.title: Whatever it Takes!
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrinn in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Loken. You are then to return to Stormherald Eljrinn with Loken's Tongue.
english.description: One way or another, Loken shall fall.$b$bThe honor and glory of his defeat shall be yours.$b$bReturn to me with his lying tongue, and earn my unending gratitude.
english.progress: Has justice been brought to Loken?
english.completion: That vile worm is dead?$B$BYou have turned out to be a great boon to my people, little $R.$B$BPlease accept this gift in return for your loyal friendship.
english.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrinn in the Halls of Lightning.

text.title: 清理道路
text.objectives: 闪电大厅的风暴先驱埃尔林要求你杀死3个雷铸医师，3个雷铸战术师以及比亚格里将军。
text.description: 洛肯的大军正在加紧备战。但他们永远不会想到，自己会首先遭到攻击。$B$B进攻的时机到了。趁他们还没有发动针对全艾泽拉斯生灵的战争，先去消灭比亚格里将军和他的大军吧！
text.completion: Though few outside of us shall ever know it, you have certainly saved the world on this day.
text.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning.

english.title: Clearing the Way
english.objectives: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to kill 3 Stormforged Menders, 3 Stormforged Tacticians, and General Bjarngrim.
english.description: Loken's forces prepare for war. What they are not ready for is to be attacked themselves.$B$BNow is the moment to strike. Take out General Bjarngrim and his army, lest they mount an offensive on all life on Azeroth!
english.completion: Though few outside of us shall ever know it, you have certainly saved the world on this day.
english.completed: Return to Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning.

text.title: 风暴先驱埃尔林
text.objectives: 约库姆国王要你进入闪电大厅，与风暴先驱埃尔林谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经派出一位密使前往闪电大厅对付洛肯。$B$B但考虑到洛肯的大军实力，他肯定需要帮助。请你竭尽全力帮助他，这样我们才能彻底阻止那个叛徒。
text.completion: Our time to act is short. Loken prepares for war.

english.title: Stormherald Eljrrin
english.objectives: King Jokkum wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and speak with Stormherald Eljrrin.
english.description: I have sent an emissary to the Halls of Lightning to take the battle to Loken.$B$BHe undoubtedly needs assistance, given the strength of Loken's armies. Lend him any aid you can so that we may finally stop the traitor.
english.completion: Our time to act is short. Loken prepares for war.

text.title: 正本清源
text.objectives: 银色神官帕尔崔丝要你杀死席瓦拉·索格蕾。
text.description: 我们正在努力减轻天灾军团的战争机器给我们造成的损失。$B$B这里的维库人已经自愿加入了巫妖王的阵营，这已经妨害了我们的任务。$B$B我请求你，勇敢的战士，你必须在他们被带入永恒的黑暗之前，击败他们的精神领袖席瓦拉。
text.completion: Every soldier we deny to the Scourge is more than one life saved.$B$BThank you.
text.completed: Return to Image of Argent Confessor Paletress in Utgarde Pinnacle.
text.giverWindow: She thrives on our pain.

english.title: Working at the Source
english.objectives: Argent Confessor Paletress wants you to slay Svala Sorrowgrave.
english.description: We are hard at work ensuring that we minimize our losses to the Scourge war machine.$B$BThe vrykul here are undermining that mission by willingly joining the Lich King's ranks.$B$BPlease, brave champion, you must defeat their spiritual leader, Svala, before she leads her people into the eternal shadow!
english.completion: Every soldier we deny to the Scourge is more than one life saved.$B$BThank you.
english.completed: Return to Image of Argent Confessor Paletress in Utgarde Pinnacle.
english.giverWindow: She thrives on our pain.

text.title: 前往拉文霍德
text.objectives: 与朱红庇护所的莫奥斯塔兹谈一谈，然后与他一起飞往拉文霍德庄园。
text.description: 如果黑龙蛋在拉文霍德庄园里，那我们就不能冒险发动全面进攻了，以免误伤了它。我需要一个机灵的家伙潜入庄园，确认这一点。$B$B我说的就是你，$N。$B$B莫奥斯塔兹会帮助你潜入庄园的。到门外去跟他谈谈，然后你们就一起飞去拉文霍德吧。祝你好运！
text.completion: So far so good. Are you ready to do some spying?
text.completed: Talk to Mostrasz within the cave just outside of Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: To Ravenholdt
english.objectives: Speak to Mostrasz at the Vermillion Redoubt and fly to Ravenholdt Manor together.
english.description: If the egg is in Ravenholdt Manor, we can't risk torching it in an all-out assault. I'll need someone slippery to get in there and find out for sure.$B$BThat's you, $N.$B$BMostrasz will help you infiltrate the compound. Speak to him just outside and fly to Ravenholdt together. Good luck!
english.completion: So far so good. Are you ready to do some spying?
english.completed: Talk to Mostrasz within the cave just outside of Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 吉尔尼斯的密探
text.objectives: 在吉尔尼斯的吉尔尼斯城废墟附近找到扎佐·耀指。
text.description: 如果你想加入我的行动，追杀躲藏起来的黑龙，就得先杀死“信条”海勒姆来证明自己的能力。他正在吉尔尼斯组建部队。$B$B我们还未能渗透进他的守卫中，但我们派了一个人到那里去监视他。扎佐·耀指是一个非常机灵的奥术师，他就在吉尔尼斯主城的废墟外待命。$B$B去找到他，他会指点你找到目标的。
text.completion: Ravenholdt sent you? I hope you're a better assassin than the others.
text.completed: 在吉尔尼斯的吉尔尼斯城废墟附近找到扎佐·耀指。

english.title: Our Man in Gilneas
english.objectives: Seek out Zazzo Twinklefingers near the ruins of Gilneas City in Gilneas.
english.description: If you wish to join my cause and slaughter the black dragons in hiding, prove yourself by taking down Hiram Creed. He's amassing an army in Gilneas.$B$BWe haven't been able to slip past his defenders, but we've got a man on the scene keeping an eye on him. Zazzo Twinklefingers, a very crafty arcane mage, is waiting for us to contact him just outside of the ruins of the Gilnean capital.$B$BFind him and he'll direct you to the target.
english.completion: Ravenholdt sent you? I hope you're a better assassin than the others.
english.completed: Seek out Zazzo Twinklefingers near the ruins of Gilneas City in Gilneas.

text.title: 刺杀信条
text.objectives: 潜入吉尔尼斯城废墟，杀死躲藏在军事区中的“信条”海勒姆。
text.description: 城里的骚乱已经持续好几天了。“信条”海勒姆乔装成吉尔尼斯人，用自己的龙血感染了许多狼人。连被遗忘者都没办法把他揪出来。$B$B只有出色的刺客才能结束这场混乱！$B$B我身后这座桥的守卫相当松散。我要你悄悄闯过商业区，往南边走。你可以在军事区里找到这个“信条”。$B$B我会时刻关注你的，万一有什么麻烦，也好及时把你弄回来。$B$B……我敢说，你肯定会有麻烦的！
text.completion: Creed is finished. The Gilneans who followed his lead are on their own now - assuming his corrupted draconic blood works its way out of their system without killing them.$B$BEither way they're no longer a concern of ours.
text.completed: Talk to Zazzo Twinklefingers northeast of Gilneas City in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: Assassinate Creed
english.objectives: Stealth into the ruins of Gilneas City and slay Hiram Creed within the military district.
english.description: The city has been in chaos for days now. Hiram Creed, disguised as a Gilnean, has infected the lot of those dogs with his own draconic blood. Even the Forsaken are having trouble routing him out.$B$BOnly a surgical assassination can end this!$B$BThe bridge behind me is relatively unguarded. Slip in through merchant's square and head south - you'll find Creed in the middle of the military district.$B$BI'll keep an eye on you and pull you out if there's any trouble.$B$B...There WILL be trouble!
english.completion: Creed is finished. The Gilneans who followed his lead are on their own now - assuming his corrupted draconic blood works its way out of their system without killing them.$B$BEither way they're no longer a concern of ours.
english.completed: Talk to Zazzo Twinklefingers northeast of Gilneas City in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: 时光之末
text.objectives: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: Nozdormu, the bronze aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Horde. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
text.completion: $N, you have arrived. This is good. I apologize for bringing you to this strange place, and under such suspicious circumstances.$B$BI have a good reason for doing so.$B$BWe are going to kill Deathwing. And I require your aid.
text.completed: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The End Time
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.
english.description: Nozdormu, the bronze aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Horde. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
english.completion: $N, you have arrived. This is good. I apologize for bringing you to this strange place, and under such suspicious circumstances.$B$BI have a good reason for doing so.$B$BWe are going to kill Deathwing. And I require your aid.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.

text.title: 时光之末
text.objectives: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: Nozdormu, the bronze aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Alliance. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
text.completion: $N, you have arrived. This is good. I apologize for bringing you to this strange place, and under such suspicious circumstances.$B$BI have a good reason for doing so.$B$BWe are going to kill Deathwing. And I require your aid.
text.completed: 和时光之末中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The End Time
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.
english.description: Nozdormu, the bronze aspect, has asked for help from the champions of the Alliance. You are on his short list. I can share few other details.$b$bIt is uncharacteristic of my master to request the assistance of mortals, but I suppose that all things change with time... even the Aspect of Time himself.$b$bHe awaits you at the End Time, in the distant future. I can help you to travel there, if you so choose.
english.completion: $N, you have arrived. This is good. I apologize for bringing you to this strange place, and under such suspicious circumstances.$B$BI have a good reason for doing so.$B$BWe are going to kill Deathwing. And I require your aid.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the End Time.

text.title: 姆诺兹多
text.objectives: 杀死姆诺兹多。
text.description: 如果我们想要消灭死亡之翼，就需要借助巨龙之魂的力量。而要取得巨龙之魂，我就得把你带回一万年前的大分裂时代……但我现在无法通过那条时间流。$B$B阻止我们进入时间流的生物名叫姆诺兹多。为了实现我们消灭死亡之翼的计划，我们必须在这里，在这个扭曲的未来杀死它。$B$B而这就是我找你来的原因，$N。
text.completion: Murozond is no more. The timeways are open to me once again.
text.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the Bronze Dragonshrine in the End Time.

english.title: Murozond
english.objectives: Slay Murozond.
english.description: If we are to destroy Deathwing, we will need the power of the Dragon Soul. To obtain the Dragon Soul, I would have to take you back to the Sundering, ten thousand years in the past... but that time passage is blocked to me.$b$bThe creature that blocks us from accessing this time passage is named Murozond. He must be slain, here, in this twisted future, before we can continue our plot to unmake Deathwing.$b$bThis is why you were brought here, $N.
english.completion: Murozond is no more. The timeways are open to me once again.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the Bronze Dragonshrine in the End Time.

text.title: 备份需要
text.objectives: 在时光之末中杀死两个残影，并使用艾鲁尔米的容器备份他们的信息。
text.description: From what I understand, you intend to avoid this future. If this is true, then we must archive data from this timestrand before it is lost to us.$b$bWe believe that the most interesting and valuable elements of this future are the powerful "echoes" that roam the dragonshrines.$b$bTake this vessel with you as you silence these echoes. A portion of their energies will be archived within the Bronze Dragonflight's depository.
text.progress: Nozdormu is acting with haste. This is something that Nozdormu does not usually do.$B$BNormally I would be more thorough with my archival. However, given the circumstances, we are forced to pick and choose what we record... and to employ the help of mercenaries like you.
text.completion: <Alurmi collects the vessel from you.>$B$BI will handle these from here. Of course, they must be properly labeled, documented, and stored.
text.completed: Return to Alurmi within the End Time.

english.title: Archival Purposes
english.objectives: Slay two of the Echoes within the End Time, then allow Alurmi's Vessel to archive their information.
english.description: From what I understand, you intend to avoid this future. If this is true, then we must archive data from this timestrand before it is lost to us.$b$bWe believe that the most interesting and valuable elements of this future are the powerful "echoes" that roam the dragonshrines.$b$bTake this vessel with you as you silence these echoes. A portion of their energies will be archived within the Bronze Dragonflight's depository.
english.progress: Nozdormu is acting with haste. This is something that Nozdormu does not usually do.$B$BNormally I would be more thorough with my archival. However, given the circumstances, we are forced to pick and choose what we record... and to employ the help of mercenaries like you.
english.completion: <Alurmi collects the vessel from you.>$B$BI will handle these from here. Of course, they must be properly labeled, documented, and stored.
english.completed: Return to Alurmi within the End Time.

text.title: 永恒之井
text.objectives: 与永恒之井中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须抢在永恒龙军团的余孽动手之前，尽快采取行动。时间宝贵。$B$B我会把你从遥远的未来带回遥远的过去……带回上古之战的时代。我们的目标就是巨龙之魂，一个拥有巨大力量的神器……它的力量足以毁灭死亡之翼，并终结它对当前世界的统治。
text.completion: Let us proceed.
text.completed: 与永恒之井中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The Well of Eternity
english.objectives: Speak with Nozdormu at the Well of Eternity.
english.description: We must move quickly, before any remaining Infinite agents intervene. Time is precious.$b$bI will now take you from your distant future into your distant past... the War of the Ancients. Our goal is the Dragon Soul, an artifact of immense power... enough power to break Deathwing, and end his reign over your present.
english.completion: Let us proceed.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 无穷无尽
text.objectives: 关闭三座恶魔传送门，然后杀死佩罗萨恩。
text.description: 在我们和巨龙之魂中间，还挡着整整一个军团的恶魔。在我们继续前进之前，必须先把它们打发了。$B$B如果我计时准确的话——通常都是准确的——一个名叫伊利丹·怒风的暗夜精灵青年很快就会与我们相遇。他肯定能在我们猎杀恶魔时帮上忙。$B$B去帮助伊利丹关闭恶魔的传送门，然后杀死它们的首领佩罗萨恩吧。
text.completion: Good. We march on.
text.completed: Speak with Nozdormu near the Well of Eternity.

english.title: In Unending Numbers
english.objectives: Disable the three demon portals, then slay Peroth'arn.
english.description: Between us and the Dragon Soul lies a legion of demons. They will have to be dispatched before we proceed.$b$bIf my timing is correct - and it usually is - a young night elf named Illidan Stormrage should be crossing our path shortly. He will undoubtedly be of some use when it comes to demon hunting.$b$bHelp Illidan disable the demons' portals, then slay their leader, Peroth'arn.
english.completion: Good. We march on.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu near the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 虚荣的女王
text.objectives: 拖住艾萨拉女王。
text.description: 前方就是艾萨拉女王和她的皇家守卫了。我们的计划绝不能受一点干扰，我们承受不起这后果。所以我们必须在她插手之前先同她开战。$B$B你今天不大可能杀死艾萨拉女王；几乎没有时间流向这个方向。因此你只要能吸引她的注意力就算是胜利了，哪怕只是暂时的。
text.completion: We are but moments away from the Dragon Soul.
text.completed: 与永恒之井中的诺兹多姆谈一谈。

english.title: The Vainglorious
english.objectives: Dispatch of Queen Azshara.
english.description: Queen Azshara and her royal guard lie ahead of us. We cannot afford the possibility of any interference with our plan. So we will take the fight to her, before she has a chance to meddle.$b$bIt is quite unlikely that you will kill Queen Azshara today; very few coherent timelines exist along that branch. Consider it a victory if you are simply able to occupy her attention, however temporarily.
english.completion: We are but moments away from the Dragon Soul.
english.completed: Speak with Nozdormu at the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 通往巨龙之魂的道路
text.objectives: 杀死玛诺洛斯。
text.description: 我没法直接飞上去拿走巨龙之魂。上古之神们守护着它。$B$B更糟的是，源自永恒之井的奥术能量还强化了他们的护盾。大恶魔玛诺洛斯正守护着这些能量。$B$B你要去吸引玛诺洛斯的注意力，这样就能打破巨龙之魂与永恒之井间的联系。没有了永恒之井的力量，上古之神的护盾就会被削弱，巨龙之魂也会衰弱。$B$B然后我就能拿走它了。
text.completion: Thank you for your help, stranger.$B$BYou fight well. I hope to fight with you again in the future.
text.completed: Speak with Illidan at the Well of Eternity.

english.title: The Path to the Dragon Soul
english.objectives: Slay Mannoroth.
english.description: I cannot simply fly up and grab the Dragon Soul. The old gods protect it.$b$bTo make matters worse, their shield is strengthened by the swirling, arcane energies that emanate from the Well of Eternity, and those energies are being focused by the great demon Mannoroth.$b$bDistract Mannoroth, and the link between the Dragon Soul and the Well will be broken. Without the Well's power, the old gods' ward will be weakened, and the Dragon Soul will be vulnerable.$b$bAnd then I will take it.
english.completion: Thank you for your help, stranger.$B$BYou fight well. I hope to fight with you again in the future.
english.completed: Speak with Illidan at the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 暮光审判
text.objectives: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我们不用一直干站在这儿。你忘了吗？我们可以控制时间。尤其是你之前干掉未来的那个姆诺兹多之后。$B$B你刚才带来的巨龙之魂？它已经在萨尔手里了，就在你来的那个时代。而他需要你的帮助。$B$B你做好出发的准备了吗？
text.completion: You've arrived.$B$BGood, let us begin.
text.completed: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Hour of Twilight
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.
english.description: There's no need to stand around here forever. Have you forgotten? We can CONTROL TIME. Especially since you got rid of that Murozond fellow, back in the future.$b$bThat Dragon Soul that you just liberated? Thrall already has it, back in your present day. And he's going to need your help.$b$bYou ready to go?
english.completion: You've arrived.$B$BGood, let us begin.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.

text.title: 进军龙眠神殿！
text.objectives: 护送萨尔安全抵达龙眠神殿。
text.description: 巨龙之魂……这件强大的武器足以击败死亡之翼。多亏了你，它终于安全地落到了我们手中。$B$B来吧！守护巨龙们在等着我们。我们必须将巨龙之魂送到位于龙骨荒野中心的龙眠神殿。
text.completion: I owe my life to you, heroes.$B$BNow that we hold the Dragon Soul safely within Wyrmrest, it may be that all of Azeroth owes their lives to you.
text.completed: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。

english.title: To Wyrmrest!
english.objectives: Escort Thrall safely to Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: The Dragon Soul... a weapon with enough power to defeat Deathwing. Thanks to you, it is now safely in our hands.$b$bCome! The aspects await us. We must bring the Dragon Soul to Wyrmrest Temple, in the center of Dragonblight.
english.completion: I owe my life to you, heroes.$B$BNow that we hold the Dragon Soul safely within Wyrmrest, it may be that all of Azeroth owes their lives to you.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.

text.title: 记录时间流
text.objectives: 杀死一个军团恶魔，一个皇家侍女以及禁卫队长瓦罗森，然后用艾鲁尔米的容器收集他们的信息。
text.description: 你是……$N，对吧？你以前帮我们做过档案记录。呃，从技术上说，那应该是在未来，不过我相信你明白，时间总是相对的。$B$B我还需要更多的档案信息。虽然你和诺兹多姆不打算像在时光之末那样改写这条时间流，但更多的数据对我们总是有好处的。$B$B我需要的信息包括禁卫队长瓦罗森，艾萨拉的一个漂亮小侍女，还有……嗯……噢，那个巨大的恶魔守卫怎么样？它就在这条阶梯底下。
text.completion: We rarely enjoy the opportunity to employ a brave $C like you. Our archive grows more thorough, thanks to your efforts.
text.completed: Bring Alurmi's Vessel back to Alurmi near the Well of Eternity.

english.title: Documenting the Timeways
english.objectives: Slay a Legion Demon, a Royal Handmaiden, and Captain Varo'then, then allow Alurmi's Vessel to archive their information.
english.description: You... $N, was it? You assisted with our archival in the past. Well, technically it was the future, but I believe you understand. Time is highly relative.$b$bI require more information for our archive. While you and Nozdormu don't intend to overwrite this timestrand, as you did in the End Time, we can still benefit from more data.$b$bI require information on Captain Varo'then, one of Azshara's pretty little handmaidens, and... hmm... oh, how about that big felguard, just down those stairs?
english.completion: We rarely enjoy the opportunity to employ a brave $C like you. Our archive grows more thorough, thanks to your efforts.
english.completed: Bring Alurmi's Vessel back to Alurmi near the Well of Eternity.

text.title: 暮光先知
text.objectives: 找到并揭露暮光先知的身份。
text.description: 这封信件的内容如下：$B$B“暮光审判已经降临。救世萨满萨尔正带着巨龙之魂赶往龙眠神殿，那是对我们光荣的主最后的威胁。”$B$B“阻止萨尔，我们就能赢得这场战争。我会在附近注视着你们。”$B$B   ——暮光先知
text.completion: It is truly as we foresaw: Benedictus was the Twilight Prophet. And now he is no more.$B$BWe dealt a mighty bow to the Twilight's Hammer today. Let us hope that it was a deathblow.
text.completed: 与暮光审判中的萨尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Twilight Prophet
english.objectives: Find and unmask the Twilight Prophet.
english.description: The missive reads as follows:$b$b"The Hour of Twilight is upon us. The world-shaman Thrall approaches Wyrmrest with the Dragon Soul in hand, feebly whimpering one final threat to destroy our glorious master."$b$b"Stop Thrall, and we win our war. I will be watching you from nearby."$b$b   ~ The Twilight Prophet
english.completion: It is truly as we foresaw: Benedictus was the Twilight Prophet. And now he is no more.$B$BWe dealt a mighty bow to the Twilight's Hammer today. Let us hope that it was a deathblow.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Hour of Twilight.

text.title: 任务完成
text.objectives: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.description: Prince Wrathion will be pleased to hear that you've succeeded. You should report back to him at Ravenholdt Manor.$B$BThe Prince has been known to be extremely generous to those who help him.
text.completion: That's wonderful news, $N. Creed was not the most powerful of the remaining black dragons, but his manipulation of the Gilneans was truly diabolical.$B$BI've prepared a reward for you. These blades may not look like much at present, but in the right hands they may yet awaken.$B$BPerhaps in YOUR hands...
text.completed: Report your success to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 收集宝石簇
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂团队副本内，从怪物身上收集源质宝石簇，并取得333颗暗影宝石。
text.description: The daggers I have given you are lifeless shells. They can do great things, once they are given a means to contain the power I have in mind.$B$BI need for you to acquire Shadowy Gems for me. The facets of these unusual stones are like windows into the infinite. They are often used by minions of the Twilight's Hammer to control the most powerful of elementals.$B$BA great battle is raging around Wyrmrest temple. Collect Elementium Gem Clusters from Deathwing's minions and bring the gems to me.
text.progress: How many gems have you collected?$B$BAre my father's minions as twisted as he?
text.completion: Ah, do you see how they shimmer? Many fine gems sparkle in the light, but only these seem to sparkle with darkness.$B$BI'll perform an enchantment on these while you are on your next mission.$B$BAre you ready?
text.completed: Bring the Shadowy Gems to Prince Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: Our Man in Karazhan
text.objectives: Report to Zazzo Twinklefingers in the ruins just southeast of Karazhan.
text.description: Your next target is the Black Dragon Nalice, who is engaged in some sort of arcane debauchery beneath the ruined tower of Karazhan.$B$BYour primary mission is to destroy her, but if you can bring me back a vial of her blood, I'll be able to use it to augment the power of the daggers I've given you.$B$BYour accomplice Zazzo has already been dispatched to the scene and awaits you there. He'll have more details.
text.completion: Madness. Insanity!$B$BI don't know what Nalice is up to down there, but the entire basement radiates with diabolical arcane energy. She's got an entire cult worshipping her as a goddess.$B$BIf we're going to take her out, we have to do it soon. I hope you're ready for this!
text.completed: Report to Zazzo Twinklefingers in the ruins just southeast of Karazhan.

text.title: Blood of the Betrayer
text.objectives: Sneak into the Master's Cellar in the ruins around Karazhan, defeat Nalice, and acquire a Vial of Black Dragonsblood.
text.description: I've pinpointed Nalice to the Master's Cellar, an extended basement you'll find in the ruins up ahead.$B$BDragon cultists are everywhere, and Nalice has set up some strange arcane storage devices throughout the area. Perhaps you can use those to your advantage?$B$BSneak past the cultists, obliterate Nalice, and grab a vial of her blood for Wrathion.$B$BI'll keep my eyes on you and pull you out if you get into any trouble. But I'm NOT coming in there with you!
text.progress: Nalice. Dead?
text.completion: You did it? She's dead? Unbelievable! You're some kind of miracle-worker!$B$BHere, let me see that blood. I can preserve its energies in an arcane matrix for your trip back...
text.completed: Take the vial to Zazzo Twinklefingers at Karazhan in Deadwind Pass.

text.title: 旗开得胜
text.objectives: 黑暗游侠玛尔拉要求你进入乌特加德城堡，杀死凯雷塞斯王子。
text.description: 乌特加德的部队是在凯雷塞斯王子的建议下组建起来的，他是天灾军团的萨莱因大使。$B$B我们不能让他继续给维库人出谋划策了。去让他闭嘴吧。
text.completion: Revenge feels good.  To think that this is but a taste of what's to come.$B$BArthas will get what he deserves soon enough.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Marrah inside Utgarde Keep.
text.giverWindow: Blood-Prince of the San'layn

english.title: A Score to Settle
english.objectives: Dark Ranger Marrah wants you to slay Prince Keleseth inside Utgarde Keep.
english.description: Utgarde's forces are organizing under the advisory of Prince Keleseth, a san'layn ambassador of the Scourge.$B$BWe cannot allow the vrykul to benefit from his counsel any further. Silence him.
english.completion: Revenge feels good.  To think that this is but a taste of what's to come.$B$BArthas will get what he deserves soon enough.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Marrah inside Utgarde Keep.

text.title: 深渊中的胜利
text.objectives: 将一瓶密封的黑龙血以及你的双匕恐惧与复仇一起交给希尔斯布莱德丘陵的拉文霍德庄园里的拉希奥。
text.description: <扎佐对装鲜血的瓶子施放了一个魔法，然后迅速把它还给了你，仿佛这瓶子有毒一般。>$B$B完成了！你得尽快把它和你那两把匕首一起交给拉希奥。$B$B我不知道他打算用它来做什么。我也就是私下跟你说说，有时那条小龙让我觉得很恐怖。祝你好运！
text.progress: Ah, you've returned! I no longer sense Nalice's presence. Is she dead? Or has she somehow eluded us both?
text.completion: You are, indeed, a master of your craft. Nalice is dead, and it is time you are rewarded for your efforts.$B$B<Wrathion takes the vial from you, his face a mask of equal parts reverence and revulsion. He drops the gems you collected one-by-one into the blood, muttering an incantation.>$B$B<Without warning he pours the blood over the blades of the daggers, and the steel seems to writhe and twist as though alive. When the smoke clears, the daggers have altered their shape.>

english.objectives: Take the Vial of Preserved Dragonsblood, along with your daggers Fear and Vengeance, to Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: <Zazzo performs an enchantment on the vial of blood, then quickly hands it back to you, as though it's toxic.>$B$BDone! You'll want to get this back to Wrathion as soon as possible, along with those two daggers of yours.$B$BI don't know what he plans to do with this stuff. Between you and me, sometimes that little dragon kid creeps me out. Good luck!

text.title: 磨利你的牙
text.objectives: 在巨龙之魂团队副本内，从怪物身上收集60个源质宝石簇。
text.description: 你知道我为什么要你去刺杀黑龙，却放过那些凡人吗？因为那不是他们的错。他们必须掌握自己的命运，摆脱我的黑龙同胞们的操纵。$B$B我们的任务已经接近完成了，现在你也该去追寻你自己的命运了。我可以继续强化你的武器，可光靠你收集来的暗影宝石已经不够了。我需要完整的宝石簇。你可以从我父亲的爪牙身上找到宝石簇……
text.progress: How many clusters have you acquired?$B$BThe tenacity of your race continues to inspire me!
text.completion: You have done it! No doubt you placed yourself and your allies in great peril to acquire these. Your sacrifices will be rewarded in time. I will use these as the foundation of a powerful enchantment for you.$B$BBut we will need one additional catalyst. Are you ready for your final and most dangerous mission, $C?
text.completed: Bring the clusters to Wrathion in Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Sharpening Your Fangs
english.objectives: Collect 60 Elementium Gem Clusters from creatures in the Dragon Soul Raid encounter.
english.description: Do you understand why I have you assassinate the dragons, yet spare the mortals? It isn't their fault. They must seek out their own destiny, free from the meddling of my kind.$B$BWe are nearing the end of our mission, and it is time for you to seek out your own destiny as well. I can continue to augment your weapons, but collecting shadowy gems won't be enough. My work will require entire clusters. Gather them from my father's minions...

text.title: Patricide
text.objectives: 销毁死亡之翼并获取死亡之翼的片段。
text.description: Your next target has claimed the lives of all of my other assassins. I need you to kill my father himself.$B$BYou must destroy Deathwing.$B$BWe are out of time. His madness has already corrupted all the others of my kind, and his darkness will consume the world if he is not stopped.$B$BIf you by some miracle succeed, and can retrieve for me a piece of him - perhaps a fragment of the armor he uses to disguise his true chaotic nature - the reward I give you will be without equal.
text.progress: What of my father?
text.completion: I can feel it - like a dark shadow lifted from the land. Dead. My father is dead!$B$B<Wrathion takes the jaw fragment from you. His hands and face blur as he recites a dark enchantment, the gem clusters you collected earlier orbiting around his head. The jawpiece suddenly shatters, and with a terrible hissing sound your twin daggers awaken.>$B$BYour reward is ready. Take them, quickly. You will need them momentarily...
text.completed: Take the Fragment of Deathwing's Jaw, along with your daggers The Sleeper and The Dreamer, to Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
text.objectives: 去火焰之地夺回诺达希尔的分枝。
text.description: 我有责任对你的发现进行调查，$R，这也就意味着我的任务现在只能交给你了。$B$B一股远非天然生成的强大魔力将我引来此地，我这才发现事态大为不妙。$B$B有人将诺达希尔的一根树枝折了下来，带到了火焰之地的深处。在那里，敌人正利用它进行邪恶的仪式，以腐蚀诺达希尔，试图用大火烧毁它。$B$B你必须想办法干扰仪式，将世界之树的树枝夺回来。
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
english.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
english.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 净化达克萨隆
text.objectives: 达库鲁要求你前往达克萨隆，并对他的火盆使用达库鲁的药剂。使用达库鲁的药剂需要消耗5份耐久魔精。
text.description: 嘿，朋友，你来了啊！这太好了，朋友！$B$B达克萨隆里面那些肮脏的亡灵很快就将被清理干净，让她恢复原有的高贵。为了报答你的帮助，达克萨隆里面最珍贵的财宝都将归你了，朋友！$B$B等你到达它的顶端之后，就可以开始召唤我，我会启动整个仪式。$B$B唉，可惜召唤我还需要付出一点代价。你必须从达克萨隆中的幸存者身上收集一些魔精。
text.completion: We done a great thing, mon! And dis just be da beginning....$b$bSeek me out in Zul'Drak when da time be right.$b$bDere be a war to be won, mon!

english.title: Cleansing Drak'Tharon
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to use Drakuru's Elixir at his brazier inside Drak'Tharon. Using Drakuru's Elixir there will require 5 Enduring Mojo.
english.description: 'Ey, mon, you be here! Dis is good, mon!$b$bDrak'Tharon soon be cleansed of them foul undead and restored to her noble purpose. In return for your help, the keep's most valuable treasures be yours, mon!$b$bOnce ya be reachin' its top, ya must summon me, and I'll perform the ritual.$b$bAlas, my summonin' will be comin' at a cost. Ya must collect mojo from the survivors.
english.completion: We done a great thing, mon! And dis just be da beginning....$b$bSeek me out in Zul'Drak when da time be right.$b$bDere be a war to be won, mon!
